tei:div.tei:p: tho ba ༷tre hā bla pa'i4de 'i ste /— ba 1 ————༷ ༷ 46waX wa—— sna ne stoX ri rdzob dzra ༄ ༄—— — — swāsnyog mgusal sto rne ༷4 4 5 canasti /rmengazhesaX nga bye phes rdo na — —
༄4/ /kun gzig paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' rtsom gces bsgrigs/bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs/
rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/byams pa bstan 'dzin/par gzhi byus 'god pa/tshe ring dbyangs skyid/ bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs nas dpar bskrun zhus/

sngon brjod/ra༅༅/ /gangs ljongs bod mi mang gi rang dbang 'thab rtsod 'di ni phyi'i btsan 'dzul dang / mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs/ mi rigs bran bkol bcas la ngo rgol byed pa'i rlabs chen 'thab rtsod cig yin/ 'das pa'i lo bcu phrag bzhi brgal ba'i dus yun ring rgya dmar gzhung gis bod mi mang la bcings 'grol thob tshul dang / bod yar rgyas dang mi mang rnams spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bde skyid phun sum phogs pa'i 'tsho bar yongs spyod rgyu byung yod tshul sogs rang nyid kyi chab srid dgos 'khor bstun nas rdzun gtam 'khyog bshad kyi dril bsgrags yig cha deb grangs sa ya 'ga' zhig rgyal khab phyi nang la 'grems spel byas yod pa red/ rang re btsan byol bod gzhung dmangs nas kyang 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i dbu khrid 'og bod dang bod mi mang gi rang da bang 'thab rtsod kyi lo rgyus rgyab rten dang /dngos yod bden pa'i gnas tshul 'dzam gling thog dril bsgrags byas yod cing /lhag par bod gangs can ljongs su 'tsho gnas byed bzhin yod pa'i ser skya mi mang rnams nas lhag bsam dang snying stobs 'gyur ba med par rgya dmar gyi dbang sgyur 'og sdod 'dod med pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal po bstan te snga 'gyel rjes mthud kyi ngo rgol las 'gul mi rabs rgyun mthud kyis spel ba bcas kyis 'dzam gling gi mi mang rnams bod rgya'i 'thab rtsod kyi gnad don 'di'i thad su zhig bden pa yin dang / su zhig rdzun ma yin gsal po shes thub pa byung ste bod don la rgyab skyor byed mkhan lo re bzhin je mang du song nas rang re'i 'thab rtsod la rgyal khab chen po thob yod/lhag par deng skabs bod don bden mtha' gsal la nye ba'i rnam pa bzang po zhig gron par brten pha rol po'i snying la mi bzod pa'i dngangs skrag chen po byung ste sngar bas gdug rtsub dang g.yo sgyu ldab 'gyur gyis rang rer dma' 'bebs dang 'khyog ka

bshad tshad las brgal ba byas te phyogs gnyis bar gyi 'thab rtsod 'di sngar bas rno ngar che zhing gting je zab tu 'gro ba'i gnas tshul tshang mas mthong gsal yin/ de ltar gnyan 'phrang shin tu che ba'i dus skabs 'dir 'das pa'i lo sum cu lhag tsam ring rgya nag gzhung gi gsang rgya dam pos mi rnams kyi shes su ma bcug pa'i gal che'i lo rgyus kyi yig cha zhig ste kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas phyi lo 1962lor rgya nag gi srid slon kre'u zhen le brgyud rgya nag gzhung la phul gnang ba'i yig 'byu khri bdun gyi snyan zhu zhes pa de'i bsgyur yig rgya yig gi ngo bshus shig snga lo dbyin ji'i rgyal sa lon khon la yod pa'i bod gnas gsar spel khang la 'byor yod pa 'di ni rang rer masan na bkra shis pa'i las don chen po zhig yin/ yig 'byu khri bdun gyi snyan zhu ni kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis phyi lo 1959 lor bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang zer ba'i gtso 'dzin las tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes nas lo gsum phyag las gnang ring bod mi mang gi bde sdug la thugs khur chen po bzhes pa dang / bod mi mang phogs kyi ngos nas kyang rang nyid sger gyi bde sdug gcig pu ma yin par bod dang / bod mi rigs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bcas chags 'jig gi gnad don la thug pa'i don dngos dang sems nang gi skad cha rnams kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po cher blo gtad yid ches chen pos zhus pa bcas bod kyi 'das pa'i lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa'i shin tu ya nga ba'i skyo gnas kyi lo rgyus rnams phyogs bsdoms gnang ba zhig red/mdor na yig 'byu khri tsho bdun gyi don tshan re rer bod mi mang gi zungs khrag dron mo rgyug yod la/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas kyang 'di'i don du sku srog la ltos med kyis sku las bskyon te dbu'i dpral ba nas phebs pa'i rngul chu'i thigs phreng gi byin gyis brlabs pa bcas kyi lo rgyus yig cha shin tu gal che zhig yin pas bde sung bod gnas nyams zhib khang nas cha tshang par bskrun gnang yod pa red/ 'di ga phyi dril las khungs nas rgyal spyi'i thog gi rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kha

kyi dgos gtug gi re ba slong ched khri bdun yig cha'i gtso gnad snying bsdus dang /de rjes lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang gzhan dbang btsan po'i 'og stabs bstun thabs mkhas kyis gnang ba'i gsung bshad khag gsum dang / lhag par dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gshegs khar chab srid kyi gnad don dang / chos lugs kyi gnad don slo ra rgya skad dang bod skad thog gnang ba'i dgongs pa can gyi bka' slob gsung bshad khag gnyis bcas yig thog phab sgyur zhus te deb 'di ched mngags phyogs sgrig zhus pa yin/ de lugs rgya che'i slog pa po rnams kyis kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi bka' drin brjed med snying la bcangs nas gang gi thugs bzhed 'grub thabs dang / mi ring bar 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis gangs ljongs chos kyi zhing sar dgyes 'dzom yong ba'i dus kyi cha rkyen bzang po bskrun ched rang nus gang yod legs skyes su 'bul rgyu'i re ba dang yid ches byed bzhin yod/ bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs nas phyi lo 1998 zla 1 tshes 28 la /

dkar chagargya nag gzhung la phul ba'i snyan zhu yig 'byu khri bdun gyi nang don snying bsdus/ 1 29(1962 zla 5 tshes 18 nyin/)kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas lha ldan smon lam chen mor gsung chos thog stsal ba'i bka' slob/ 30452(1986 lo'i zla 2 tshes 24 nyin/)rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus phyogs skabs drug pa'i phogs chen thengs lnga par zhugs mkhan bod kyi 'thus mi'i tshogs chung gros bsdur thog gnang ba'i gsung bshad/ 53481(phyi lo 1987 zla 3 tshes 28 nyin )bod kyi rig par zhib 'jug byed pa'i rmang gzhi ni bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gnyis yin/ 82 90(phyi lo 1988 zla tshes nyin/)ma 'ongs par kha phyogs skabs lo rgyus kyi nyams myong gtan nas brjid mi rung / 91—118(phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 23 nyin/)chos lugs dang / mi rigs kyi las don thad kyi g.yon thal lam phyogs gtsang sel byed dgos pa dang / sprul sku'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byed phyogs/ 119 149(phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 24 nyin/)

rgya nag gzhung la phul ba'i snyan zhu yig 'bru khri bdun gyi nang don snying bsdus/(1962 zla 5 tshes 18 nyin/)ra༅༅/ /thugs brtse mtshungs med srid rlon spre'u en le mchog la/ ched zhu/srid slon sku nyid rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi mang bde thabs dang / gal che'i rgyal srid mdzad don gyi thugs brel shin tu che na'ang / gus par bong ba gser gzigs kyi thugs khur tshad med kyis mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i bka' drin la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu dang / de ring gi rnyed par dka' ba'i go skabs bzang po 'di brgyud ngos nas sger sems spangs te tang gi mtshan mthong dang mi dmangs kyi khe phan la dmigs te nga rang mtsho sngon dang / zi khron/ yun nan sogs zhing chen khag tu 'tshams 'dri lta skor byed skabs dngos brgyud ci rigs nas shes rtogs byung ba'i mnga' khul de dag gi bod rigs sa khul gyi bde sdug gnas lugs krung dbyang la snyan seng zhu dgos pa khag dang / don gnad de dag gzhir byas pa'i da phyin las don gnang phyogs thad thugs snang dgos nges kyi bsam 'char bcas nga tsho'i bod kyi gnas tshul gal che khag snyan zhur phul ba lags na/ dkyil che'i thugs dgongs su mnga' ba zhu rgyu yin zhes dang / de rjes rgya nag gzhung gis bod la slob grwa gsar 'dzugs byas pa dang / mi mang la sman yon ma dgos pa'i sman bcos mthun rkyen bskrun pa/ bod kyi rjes lus lam lugs la 'gyur ba btang nas mi rabs mang pos mthong myong med pa'i mdun bskyod chen po byung ste 'das pa'i lo gsum nang lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring byung myong med pa'i rgyal kha thob yod pa der bod mi sas dga' tshor chen po byed kyi yod pa red/ 'on kyang zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong 1

ba dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul spel ba'i skabs su 'byung mi 'os pa dang mi legs pa'i skyon dang nor 'khrul yang byung yod/ de dag gi nang nas ngas shes rtogs byung ba'i yig cha kha shas kyi rtsa don rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul dang 1 dpe mtshan rang bzhin ldan pa'i don gnad tshabs che kha shas snyan seng zhu rgyu yin/zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba'i gnad don skor/phyi lo 1959 lor zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong skabs zing 'khrug nang zhugs mkhan mo chab srid bog nas tshur 'gugs thabs su khong mor mi byed pa bzhi'i srid byus lag len bstar rgyu gtan 'bebs byas yod kyang / dngos su lag len bstar skabs drag chas spangs te mgo btags zhu cu/khan tshor mi byed pa bzhi'i srid byus lag len ma bstar bar mi mang por dza drag gi 'thab rtsod dang /'dzin bzung / btson 'jug sogs byas te rdung rdeg phog yod pa dang / khong tshor thag gcod byed skabs las byed pa tshos 'khon 'dzin chen po byas te mthong chung dang sla bcos kyi byed thabs spyad nas/ khong tsho'i gnas tshul la zhib 'jug gting zab kyis dbye 'byed ma byas par tshang mar thag gcod nan po byas pa sogs kyis rkyen pas bod kyi zing 'khrug de gzhi rgya che zhing / mi 'bor mang ba/ dus yun ring ba sogs kyi gnas tshul byung yod ces dang / dmag dpung dang las byed pa tshos 1959 lo'i dus zing skabs dang / de rjes chab srid kyi las 'gul khag nang zing 'khrug tu zhugs mkhan gyi mi rtsad gcod byed skabs gang byung gis mi 'bor chen la sdug spyong mnang ga cod btang yod/ dper na dmangs gatsho'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul nang las byed pa mos mgo bde skabs 'tshal gyi hur brtson can 2

zer ba'i mi de phos skad cha gang bshad tshang ma bden par ngos 'dzin byas te/ mi ji tsam mang bar nag nyes lci po 'gol thub na de tsam gyi las 'gul gting zab byung yod par ngos 'dzin byas nas/ bod kyi sa khul gang sar sgro ba lta bu'i chab srid las 'gul gyi rlung 'tshub cig bslangs yod pa red/ skabs der sa khul 'ga' zhig tu de snga zing 'khrug nang zhugs mkhan la zhag po gcig gnas tshang g.yar mkhan de tso tshang ma log spyod par ngos 'dzin byas te rdung rdeg btang ba dang / tha na 1957 lo dang 1958 lor bod kyi shar phyogs mdo ltod smad khul la zing 'khrug langs pa de skabs khams pa dang a mdo ba 'grul bzhud byed mkhan la nas tshang g.yar mkhan tshang ma log spyod pa dang ngan 'brel byed mkhan yin pa'i zhwa mo ga yogs te 'thab 'dzing btang yod pa dang / grong gseb 'ga' zhig nang zing 'khrug dang rtsa ba nas 'brel ba med pa'i mi la'ang zhwa mo gang byung g.yogs nas 'thab 'dzing btang ba dang / 'dzin bzung byas pa/ rgyu dngos 'phrog bcom byas pa sogs kyi gnas tshul ji snyed cig byung yod/ bod mi tshos rang gi mig gi mdun la byung ba'i gnas tshul de tshor lta bzhin du rang gis rang la yid mi ches pa'i gnas tshul mang po byung yod ces dang /gzhung gi las byed pa tshos bod mi mang por nyes ming sna tshogs btags nas 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas pa'i gnas tshul bod mi tshos mthong skabs tshang ma hang sangs kyi yod/ bod rang skyong ljongs zer ba'i khul gyi btson pa'i grangs 'bor gyis bod mi'i grangs 'bor gyi brgya cha 'ga' zhig zin yod pa 'di 'dra'i grangs 'bor ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa zhig red ces dang / btson pa'i 'tsho ba'i skor la/ bod dmag khul khang zer ba'i khongs kyi btson khang nang yod pa'i bod kyi mtho rim mi sna de mor rtsa khrims gzhir bzung lag bstar byed kyi yod pa las 1 de min btson khang gzhan la yod pa'i btson pa tsho'i ngas ba dang 'phrod mun

bsten sogs la do snang spu tsam mi byed pa'i thog btson srung ba chos khong sbyor 'jigs skul byed pa dang / rang snang gang dran gyis nyes dung gtong ba/ gnam gshis tsha grang dang / sa chu 'phrod min sogs la ma bltas par btson pa sa btsan shed kyis sdod yul gnas slo yang yang byed du bcug par brten btson pa mang po zhig sa chu mi 'phrod pa dang / gyon gos kyis lus po mi drod pa/ khang pa'am yang na sdod gur grang lhags 'gog thub pa zhig med pa/ lto chas grod pa 'grangs pa za rgyu med pa sogs ha cang ya nga ba'i gnas su gyar yod par ma zad/ nyin ltar snga langs phyi nyal gyi ngal rtsol tshod med bskul te sdug sbyong btang ba dang / cha rkyen ha cang tha zhan gyi gnas tshul 'og btson pa 'das grongs song ba'i grangs 'bor ha cang mtho po red/ nga rang ngo ma bod kyi sa khul khag la gnas tshul lta zhib byed par 'gro skabs shin tu ya nga ba'i gnas tshul de tsho mthong dus rang dbang med par sems la skyo snang tshad med skyes pa dang dus mtshungs btson pa de mor mnar gcod de lta bu gtong dgos don gang yin nam/ de ltar ma btang na 'grig gi med pa yin nam zhes rang gis rang la dri ba mi byed ka med yong gi 'dug ces dang / 1959lo'i dus zing mjug 'gril tsam la ma'o tse tung gis bod kyi mi 'bor ha cang nyung nyung yin pas mi gsod mi dgos pa gtso don dang / yang na nyung tsam las gsod mi dgos pa'i srid byus zhig lag len bstar dgos/ dper na/ zing 'khrug gi 'go gtso lha klu dang / slo bzang bkra shis lta bu'i mi de tsho ma bsad na 'grig gi red ces gsungs yod/ 'on kyang don dngos thog de las ldog ste bod kyi sa khul gang sar bod mi bsad pa'i mi ros khengs nas bod mi'i khyim tshang stong phrag mang po'i pha ma bu phrug dang bza' mi nye 'brel pho sdug bsngal gyi nang lhung du bcug yod/btson khang nang yod pa tshor yang nag nyes che chung dbye ba 'byed thabs med pa chags yod pa dang / lhag par bskyar zhib zer ba'i las 'gul skabs bod mi 'bor chen zhig 'dzin bzung byas pa de tsho mang po zhig btson khang nang bkres ltogs dang 4

sdug spyong mnar gcod sogs kyi 'og 'das grongs song yod/ 1961 lor btson pa khag gcig slod 'grol btang yod kyang / da dung btson pa ha cang mang po yod cing / skabs de'i krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi spyi phyogs las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa kre dza ming gis 'das grongs song ba rnams phud btson pa slod 'grol mjug bsgril rjes da dung bod rang skyong ljongs khongs kyi btson khang khag na nga btson pa chig khri lhag tsam mu mthud btson 'jug bya rgyu yin zhes snyan seng zhus byung / mi grangs khri 120 las med pa'i bod ljongs su mi khri gcig lhag tsam btson 'jug byas na mang drags pa red/ skabs der 'dzin bzung khongs ma tshud pa'i bod mi mang po zhig la zing 'khrug dang 'brel ba yod pa'i nyes ming sna tshogs bkal te mang phogs khrod 'thab 'dzing btang ba dang / dngos yod gnas tshul la zhib dpyad ma byas par gzhung gi las byed pa'i ngan skul 'og bsam med hur brtson can zer ba de tshos gang bshad ltar rgyu dngos btsan len byas pa sogs mi mang por brdab gsig chen po btang yod pa red/bod rang skyong ljongs kyi phyi rol du yod pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen dang / gan su'u zhing chen/ yun nan zhing chen/ zi khron zhing chen bcas kyi khongs su yod pa'i bod kyi sa khul khag gi gnas stangs ni de bas ya nga ba zhig yod cing / sa khul de tsho'i nang g.yon gyi nor 'khrul srid byus lag len bstar ba'i dus yun bod rang skyong ljongs nang las ha cang gis ring ba dang nyen tshabs kyang shin tu chen po byung yod 1 ngos rang khams dang a mdo'i sa khul la bskyod skabs bod mi rgan gzhon tshang mas nga thug ma thag rang dbang med par mig nas mchi ma btang ste sems nang gi sdug bsngal rnams gsal po brjod kyi 'dug khong tsho'i mig mchi mas khengs pa'i yid shin tu skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur mthong skabs slo dang ldan pa zhig yin phyin sa khul de tsho'i nyen tshabs kyi gnas tshul gsal po shes rgyu red ces dang / gong gsal sa khul de tsho nas bod mi ji tsam 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas yod pa ngas 5

zhib phra mi shes kyang / spyi yongs nas tshod dpag byas na sa khul de tsho re re nas mi chig khri lhag tsam re 'dzin bzung byas yod cing / gal te mi de dag tshang ma dgra bor ngos 'dzin byas na/ bod mi'i nang nas rgya nag gzhung la dga' zhen byed mkhan spud dang / rgas 'khogs/ phru gu/ 'phros lhag skyes pa re zung bcas las med pa chags rgyu red ces dang / 1957 41959 lo bar byung ba'i dus zing de tsho'i nang bod mi rigs la mtha' yas pa'i god chags dang gyong gun byung nas/bod mi rigs 'di sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i nang lhung zhing / bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa'i dka' ngal de lta bu 'phrad pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig ni/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod kyi sa khul de tsho'i nang zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i srid byus yang dag pa zhig lag bstar byas med pa 'di dang 'brel ba ha cang chen po yod pa red/dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur dang / sa zhing bgo bsha'/'brog khul du rgol gsum gnyis phan/ gral rim dbye zhib bcas kyi gnad don skor/dmangs ba/tso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul spel skabs las byed pa tshos rgya che'i bod mi mang tshogs kyi dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur las 'gul gyi don snying ngos 'dzin yang dag pa byung yod med la brtag dpyad ma byas par/ rgyu dngos kyi 'dod rngams che zhing las byed pas yid ches thob ched ngo tsha khrel med kyis mi gzhan la gang byung nag med nyes 'gel byed mkhan hur brtson can zer ba'i mi ngan khram pa 'ga' zhig gis bshad pa'i skad cha bod mi yongs kyi bsam tshul yin par ngos 'dzin byas pa dang / dngos yod gnas tshul la zhib dpyad ma byas par snang med hol rgyug gis gnad don thag gcod byas te don med mi mang la dka' ngal ha cang chen po 6

bzos yod/ lhag par las 'gul de'i skabs las byed pa'i khrod du dga' ba drug gi spyod tshul ngan pa zhig dar khyab byung ba ni/ zang zing la da ga' ba dang / snang med hol rgyur byed rgyu dga' ba/ ngo dga' sprel lad la dga' ba/ don med don rkyen bsgo rgyur dga' ba/ nyes med nyes 'dzugs byed rgyur dga' ba/ mi la rdung rdeg gtong rgyur dga' ba bcas red ces dang /las byed pa tshos dngos yod kyi dka' ngal la bsam gzhigs kyis tang gi srid byus gzhir bzung gnad don thag gcod bya rgyu'i tshab la/ ngo tsha khrel med dang spyod tshul tha shal yin pa'i bod mi khag gcig gsar brje'i rjes su 'brang mkhan la ngos 'dzin byas pa des/ gzhung gi yang dag pa'i srid byus mang phogs nang lag len bstar rgyur gnod skyon chen po bzos yod pa red/ spyod tshul ha cang zhan pa'i hur brtson can de tsho ni dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul nang gso skyong byas pa zhig yin pas/ mi de tsho'i legs nyes spus tshad nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi legs nyes spus tshad mtshon gyi yod par ma zad/ skabs de'i gzhung gi las byed pa dang / sa gnas kyi 'go khrid tsho'i las ka byed stangs kyi spus tshad kyang mtshon gyi yod ces dang / chab srid slob sbyong bya rgyu ni mi mang gi bsam blo'i go rtogs mtho ru gtong ba'i go skabs dang thabs lam bzang shos shig yin mod/ 'on kyang las byed pa dang hur brtson can zer ba de zos slob bhyong gi sags 'du'i thog mi la gang byung gi kha rdung gtong ba dang / nyes med nyes 'gel gyi tha tshig sgrogs pa sogs byas pa'i rkyen gyis skabs der slob sbyong la yong dgos zer ba'i skad cha thos ma thag mi tshang ma'i sems la zhed snang dang yid thang chad pa'i tshor snang zhig yong gi yod pa dang / rang nyid la rdung rdeg gang zhig phog yong bsam nas sems khral byed kyi yod pa red/ der brten chab srid kyi slob sbyong de tsho brgyud nas rang gi 'jig rten lta bar bsgyur bkod btang ste mi gsar pa zhig bya rgyu'i tshab la de las ldog pa'i bsam slo gtong dgos byung yod pa red/7

zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang nas lo gnyis gsum nang bod kyi zhing 'brog khul dang / grong khyer/ dgon sde khag bcas kyi nang gzhung gi las byed pa tshos dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed skabs ngo tsha khrel med kyi rdzun gtam shod mkhan hur brtson can zer ba de phyo gtso bo'i lag cha zhig la brtsis nas bod spyod btang yod pa de ni slo pham byed dgos pa zhig yin/ gang yin zhe na/ hur brtson can zer ba de tsho la la ni rang gi lo rgyus gtsang ma med pas de dag sbas skungs byed ched mi gzhan la nyes 'dzugs byed mkhan yin pa dang / la la ni las byed par sprel lad bshad nas gzhi rim las byed nang 'dzul thabs byed mkhan yin pa/ 'ga' zhig ni mi gzhan gyi rgyu dngos ham zos bya rgyur brngams nas gsar brje'i go rtogs mtho po yod tshul gyi rnam pa bstan te las 'gul de'i nang zhugs pa de 'dra red/ mi de mas dmang gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs zing 'khrug nang zhugs mkhan ther 'don dang / gral rim dbye zhib/ de bzhin sa zhing bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul bcas tshang ma'i nang rdzun gtam shod pa dang / mi la 'jigs skul byed pa/ nyes rdung gtong ba sogs kyi bya thabs brgyud nas spyi tshogs yongs la brdab gsig chen po bzos yod/thog mar mang gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed skabs gzhung nas zing 'khrug nang ma zhugs pa'i zhing bdag dang 'brog bdag rnams kyi sa zhing dang thon skyed yo chas glu nyo bya rgyu'i srid byus gtan 'bebs byas yod/ 'on kyang dngos su lag len byed pa'i bya rim nang las byed pa chos zing 'khrug nang zhugs yod med rtsad gcod zhib nan ma byas par mi mang po zhig la log spyod pa dang / zing 'khrug dang 'brel ba yod pa sogs kyi nyes med nyes 'gel byas te khong tsho'i rgyu dngos tshang ma gzhung bzhes btang yod pa dang / gral rim gtan 'khel bzo skabs kyang las byed pa chos don dngos zhib phra'i brtag dpyad ma byas par las 'gul de 'jigs skul dang /'thab rtsod/ 'tshab 'tshub bcas kyi sgo nas bya rgyu 'di thabs shes bzang shos su 8

brtsis nas/ rdung rdeg gtong yal yin pa dngos ra 'phrod min la ma ltos par mi ༄mang po zhig la rdung rdeg gtong rgyu dang / ji tsam 'thab 'dzings kyi zogs 'du mang ba tshogs thub na de tsam gyi las 'gul gting zab po byung yod par ngos 'dzin byas te de snga'i rgan po dang / hrū dpon/ dgon sde khag gi dma' rim las sne byed myong mkhan bcas tshang ma gral rim mnga' bdag dang / mnga' tshab la bskyal te khong tsho'i rgyu dngos gzhung bzhes btang ba smos ci/ da dung 'thab 'dzings dang sdug sbyong tshad med btang ba sogs nor 'khrul gyi las ka mang po byas yod pa red/grong khyer dang grong gseb khag nang mnga' bdag dang mnga' tshab tshor 'thab 'dzings gtong skabs las byed pa tshos hur brtson can zer ba'i mi de tshos bshad pa'i skad cha bden pa yin min dbye zhib ma byas par mi mang gi blo mig ni dngas shing gsal ba zhig red zer ba'i 'bod tshig 'og hur brtson can zer ba de tshor ngan skul dang rgyab skyor byas nas mi mang por dung rdeg tshad med btang yod pa de hrū mthong skabs mi rnams rang gis rang la yid ma ches pa'i gnas tshul yong gi yod/ yang mi mang nang bsam blo'i 'thab rtsod byed skabs 'thab rtsod bya yul der don dngos 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa'i gnad don med pa'am/ yang na gnad don chung ngu zhig las med kyang / nyes med nyes 'gel dang chung chung chen po bzos nas 'thab 'dzings drag po btang yod/ las byed pa tshos de dag bkag 'gog bya rgyu las ldog ste hur brtson can zer ba de zor bsngags brjod byed pa dang / bya dga' sprad nas mi de tsho ni gsar brje pa lhad med dang mig dpe 'os pa zhig la ngos 'dzin byas yod pa red/ las byed pa'i skul slong 'og 'thab 'dzings kyi tshogs 'du 'go tshugs ma thag hur brtson can zer ba de chos skad shugs chen pos mi gzhan la kha rdung gtong ba dang / 'jigs snang bskul ba/ skra nas 'then pa/ dog rgyag gzhu ba/ sha gcus rgyag pa/ mgo la lde mig dang rgyug pa zhu ba sogs byas te 'thab 'dzings gtong yul gyi mi de'i kha dang sna nas khrag thon te dran med du brgyal 9

ba dang / rkang lag bcag pa/ tha na mi 'ga' zhig 'thab 'dzings gtong sa de rang la shi ba'i gnas tshul yang byung yod/ de lta bu'i sdug sbyong mnar gcod btang ba ma bzod par mi mang po zhig 'u thug thabs zad kyis phyi rgyal la bros byol 'gro dgos byung yod/ gros lcol du 'gro ma thub pa'i mi mang po zhig bzod bsran byed thabs bral te chu la mchongs pa dang / de min gyi bya thabs spyad nas rang shi rgyag dgos byung yod/ de 'dra'i skyo gnas mthong skabs slo dang ldan pa'i mi zhig yin phyin rang bzhin rgya nag gzhung la re thag chod pa dang / dogs pa mi skye ba zhig gal yong srid dam/dgon sde btor bshig dang grwa btsun la mnar gcod btang ba'i skor/dgon sder dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byed skabs gtan 'bebs byas pa'i srid byus ni ngo rgol gsum yin zhing / 'di 'thus tshang yong ched rtsis rgyag gsum zhes pa lag len bstar ba red/ 'on kyang zhib phra'i lag bstar byed skabs rmongs dad sel dgos zer ba'i 'og chos lugs la ngo rgol byed dgos pa dang gcigasku gsung thugs rten med pa bzo dgos pa dang gnyis/ thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs kyis grwa btsun skya bab tu bcug rgyu dang gsum bcas red/ de dag ni gtso bo'i las 'gan chags yod pa dang / ngo rgol gsum dang rtsis gsum de ni nyes can spyang ki gsod pa las/ nyes med lug gsod par rngams pa'i rang bzhin du gyur yod/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi rjes su gzhung gi las byed tshos grwa btsun rnams bcings 'grol thob pa dang / chos dad rang mos kyi dbang cha thob ste rang 'gul ngang so so'i khyim la phyir log byas nas/ deng skabs dgon pa'i nang grwa btsun nyung shas las sdod mkhan med pa red zer ba sogs kyi shod tshul 10

de dag la nga rang tshud pa'i bod mi brgya cha dgu bcus rtsa ba nas mos mthun byed thabs med 1 las byed pa ltos dgon sder yod pa'i grwa btsun hrū skya bab tu 'jug rgyu 'di khong tsho'i las 'gan gtso bo zhig la ngos 'dzin byas yod pa dang / nyin mtshan bstud de chab srid slob sbyong la khag btags nas 'du khang nang chos lugs ni slongs dad dang dug yin pa sogs kyi slob gso dril bsgrags shugs che byas nas btsan shed kyis dge 'dun pa nang khul phan tshun skyon brjod dang zer 'don byed du bcug nas dgon sde tshang ma'i nang 'thab rtsod kyi rba rlabs shig 'phyur du bcug yod/ de skabs mu mthud chos la dad pa byed 'dod yod ces shod mkhan gyi grwa btsun rnams la slongs dad byed mkhan red zer ba dang / gsar brjer dga' zhen med mkhan red zer ba sogs kyi zhwa mo ga yogs nas bzod par dka' ba'i 'thab 'dzings btang yod / bya thabs gdug rtsub che shos ni grwa btsun rnams btsan shed kyis skya bab tu bcug pa de red/ slob sbyong phyogs 'du'i skabs grwa btsun mi re ngo rer skya bab kyi yin nam/ yang na mu mthud dgon par sdod kyi yin zhes btsan shed kyis skad cha dris pa dang / gal te dgon par mu mthud sdod 'dod yod brjod na/ las byed pa dang hur brtson can zer ba de tshos khyod la slob gso yag po thebs kyi 'dug klad pa'i nang gi slongs dad sel mi 'dug ces bshad de rtsub spyod chen pos 'thab 'dzings gtong ba dang / tha na bkag nyar dang 'dzin bzung byas pa'i gnas tshul yang byung yod/ de lta bu'i btsan shed 'og lcags las grub pa'i mi zhig yin na ma gtogs/ mu mthud dgon pa'i nang sdod 'dod yod brjod mkhan su zhig yong gi red dam/ lo na drug cu brgal zin pa'i dge 'dun pa bgres song de tso yang rang nyid kyi mi tshe mang che ba bskyal sa'i dgon pa 'di'i nang mu mthud sdod thabs bral ba mthong ste skya bab rgyu khas len mi byed ka med byung yod pa dang / rang nyid skyes sa'i grong tshor phyir log byed skabs lo na mtho bas bza' tshang sgrig mkhan med la/thon skyed ngal rtsol nang zhugs mi thub pa bcas kyis lus sems gnyis gar dka' 11

ngal bsam brjod las 'das pa zhig byung yod/ de bas tshabs che ba zhig la dgon sde 'ga' zhig nang las byed pas gzhogs gcig la gra pa tsho star bsgrigs nas bzhag pa dang / gzhogs gcig la btsun ma dang de min spud tsho star bsgrigs nas bzhag te snga rting thon rim bzhin bza' tshang bsgrig tu bcug pa'i gnas tshul byung yod/bod shar phyogs khams dang a mdo khul gyi dgon sde khag gi gnas stangs ni de bas yid skyo dgos pa zhig yod/ sa khul de tsho'i nang 1957 lo tsam nas dgon sde khag gtor bzhig gtong 'go btsugs te dge 'dun pa rnams la dka' sdug tshad med 'phrad yod par ma zad/ grwa btsun mang po btsan shed kyis skya bab tu bcug yod/ dge 'dun pa tsho'i mchu to lheb tsam gnang ba las byed dang hur brtson can tshos mthong na kha ton byed kyi 'dug ces nyes 'dzugs byas te gsar brjer ngo rgol par byas pa ltar rdung rdeg gtong gi yod pa red/ zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ste ḍo/ gnyis gsum las ma song ba de'i ring bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khul du yod pa'i spru/dan pa chen po bzhis gtsos dgon sde nyung shas shig ma gtogs mang che bar gtor skyon chen po btang yod/ rgya rigs las byed pas bkod pa btang ba dang / bod rigs las byed pas skul ma byas pa'i 'og bsam med hur brtson can zer ba khag gcig gis mi mang gi ming kha la 'khyer/ mi mang gi gdong 'bag gyon nas dgon pa'i nang gi sku brnyan gtor ba dang / mchod rten bshig pa/ dpe cha mer sreg btang ba sogs gtor bshig gi rba rlabs shig sa khul gang sar 'phyur nas grangs las 'das pa'i rtsa che'i sku brnyan dang / phyag dpe mer sreg pa dang chu la bskyur ba/ gser zangs kyi sku brnyan rnams bzhu lugs byas te dngos po gzhan bzos pa sogs dgon pa mang che bar gnod skyon tshabs che byung yod/ skabs der gzhung gi mong khang khag gis gser zangs kyi dngos po dang / rin po che'i rigs nyo gi yod pa 'di ni sa gnas bod mi bsam med nyung shas la dgon pa'i rtsa che'i sku brnyan rku ma brku rgyur skul ma btang ba zhig red/ thang ga dang phyag dpe khag 12

gcig lham mthil bzo byed kyi rgyu char btang yod pa 'di 'dra ni rig tsho ma zin pa'i spyon pa zhig yin kyang byed mi phod pa'i las ka red/ dgon pa gtor shul de tsho ni dmag 'khrug skabs me sgrogs kyi gtor bshig chen po btang ba ltar gang sar gyang ros khengs te mig gis blta mi bzod pa zhig la gyur yod/dge 'dun pa'i grangs 'bor mang drags pa des bod kyi mi 'bor 'phel rgyas dang / spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed 'dzugs skrun la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs kyi yod na grangs 'bor nyung du gtong rgyu dang spus ka legs su gtong rgyu ni dgos nges shig red / 'on kyang de ltar byed pa la thog mar las byed pa tshos rang gi klad pa'i nang gi g.yon thal gyi bsam slo gtsang sel byas te/ chos lugs nang gi zhan cha dang legs cha gnyis lug gang yin dang spyang bi gang yin dbye ba yag po byed dgos pa yin / dgon sde khag gi sgrig gzhi dang grwa btsun gyi spyod lam leg sa bcos gtong ba'i las don 'go ma btsugs gong chos lugs kyi las don la rgyus mnga' yod pa'i mi sna rnams kyi bsam 'char bsdu len byas te 'brel yod mi tshang ma dang gros mol gzab nan byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog gzhi nas bsgyur bcos kyi srid byus rnams lag bstar byed dgos pa red/ 'on kyang dgon sde khag nang bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul spel skabs las byed pa tshos chos lugs kyi las don nang yod pa'i zhan cha rnams med par bzos nas chos lugs la bsgyur bcos bya rgyu'i bya ba rgyab tu bskyur te / chos dang chos phyogs kyi byed sgo mtha' dag la dgag pa brgyab nas chos rtsa med gtong rgyu 'di las 'gul gyi dmigs yul la ngos 'dzin byas yod/ las byed pa 'ga' zhig gis dgon pa'i nang gi mgo bde skabs 'tshol ba hur brtson can 'ga' zhig gis bshad pa'i skad cha de grwa btsun tshang ma'i bsam tshul yin par nor 'khrul gyis yid ches byas te/ da ni chos lugs la dgag pa brgyab ste chos lugs rtsa med bzo ba'i cha rkyen smin 'dug snyam nas/ ngo rgol gsum dang zhib bsher gsum gyi las 'gul gyi kha phyogs de chos lugs la ngo rgol bya rgyu'i thog bzhag yod/13

nor 'khrul gyi bsam blo 'di'i mdzub khrid 'og rtsub spyod kyi bya thabs 'dra min lag len bstar bar brten dgon sde smos ci/ mi tshang ma'i sems nang bzod thabs bral ba'i thabs sdug gi gnas tshul mang po byung yod/ mi rnams kyi dad pa dang dga' zhen chen po byed yul gyi nang chos nyams chag chen po bzos pa dang chabs cig de la dad pa byed du ma bcug pa'i rkyen gyis mi mang po zhig gi sems nang chos lugs la dga' zhen dang dad gus sngar bas shugs che ru song yod/ mi mang mang tshogs kyi bsam blor 'gog gnon byas pa dang / mi mang gi 'dod tshul dang rgyab 'gal byas par brten de ni rang nyid grogs med khyer rkyang du lus pa dang / las don la pham nyes yong ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig tu gyur yod/dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi rjes su dgon sde mang che ba'i grwa btsun rnams la ltos slob gnyer bya rgyu'i go skabs phar bzhag tha na dgon par gnas thabs bral ba'i gnas tshul byung yod/ bkra shis lhun po'i gnas stangs phran bu ya ga pa yod pa phud/ de byings la dge 'dun nyung shas las lhag med pa dang / don dngos thog dgon pa'i ngo bor 'gyur ldog phyin nas 'tsho gnas thub pa'i dgon pa de hrū yang chos byed sa'i sgrig 'dzugs shig yin pa'i mtshan nyid mi ldan pa bzos yod/dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs mi gzhan gyi rgyu dngos la ham sems can dang /dbang cha 'dzin rgyu'i ham sems can gyi grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis spyo ba ltar chos la ngo zhol byangag pa dang / da ge 'dun pa gzhan la rdung rdeg btang bar brten las byed pa mos mi de tsho ni gsar brje'i las 'gul gyi rkang 'dzin pa snying stobs can zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byas pa dang / las 'gul mjug sgril skabs mi de tsho dgon pa'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer khang gi 'go khrid rgan gzhon gyi 'os mir bton te dge 'dun pa rnams la khong tsho 'go khrid du 'os 'dems byed du bcug yod/ skabs der mi 'ga' zhig bsam blo'i go rtogs mtho po med pa'am/ yang na 'jigs snang gi dbang gis skad cha drang po shod ma nus par hur brtson can de tsho dmangs gtso 14

bdag gnyer khang gi 'go khrid la ma bdams ka med byung yod/ dgon pa re zung gi dmangs gtso bdag gnyer khang yag po yod pa phud/ de min brgya cha 90la dge 'dun pas dga' po bya rgyu phar bzhag ngo rgol byas yod pa red/srid gzhung nas chos dad rang mos yin zhes dril bsgrags shugs che byed kyi yod / 'on kyang chos byed pa la grwa btsun dang / sku brnyan/ phyag dpe/ dgon pa bcas dgos pa yin/ de dag la gtor bshig btang nas cos dad rang mos yin zhes brjod na/ de ni mi zhig gi kha'i mdun la yod pa'i zas tshang ma phyogs nas da dung kho la zas yag po bzo zhes bshad pa dang gcig pa ma red dam zhes dang /dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur ma byas gong bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sa khul la dgon pa che chung khyon bsdoms/ 2500 lhag tsam yod/ de rjes dgon pa 70las lhag med/ lo gnyis gsum nang dgon pa brgya cha 97 tsam gtor shig btang yod/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gong grwa btsun khyon bsdoms 110000yod pa dang / de'i nang nas grwa btsun khri gcig tsam phyi rgyal la bros gyol du phyin pa de dag phud/ bcos bsgyur rjes la grwa btsun bsdoms 7000 lhag tsam las med par lo gnyis gsum nang grwa btsun brgya cha 93 tsam nyung du phyin yod/bod shar phyogs mdo smad khul gyi gnas stangs ni de bas zhan pa yod cing / mdo smad khul gyi dgon pa brgya cha 98 4 99 bar gtor bshig btang yod pa dang /'phros lhag dgon pa nyung shas kyi dbang cha yang chos lugs la smyo ba ltar ngo rgol byed mkhan mi 'ga' zhig la sprad yod pas/ don dngos thog dgon pa de tsho chos byed sa'i lte gnas shig nas chos la ngo rgol byed sa'i lte gnas shig la gyur yod pa red/zhing 'brog bon skyed dang mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i gnad don skor/bod kyi smad phyogs sa khul gyi ngal rtsol nus pa yod pa'i skyes pa mang po zhig 15

dus zing skabs rkyen 'das song ba dang / mang po zhig gzhung gis 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas stabs khyim tshang nang spud dang phru gu ma gtogs lhag med/ khong tsho'i rtsa ba'i lus stobs dang nus shugs skyes pa mo nang bzhin med par brten thon skyed nang nus pa 'don mi thub pa dang / rang gi brtse ba'i pha dang bza' zla sogs 'dzin bzung byas pa'i sems sdug gis mnar te ngal rtsol thon skyed nang zhugs mi thub pa bcas kyis skabs shig ring thon skyed la gnod skyon chen po byung yo da ces da nga / 1959 62 lo bar lo gsum ring bod kyi sa khul mang che bar gnam gshis yag po bstan nas rang byung bgegs bar byung med/ 'on kyang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul dang / zhing 'brog khul la rogs res phyogs chung 'dzugs skabs las byed pa zos rnying pa tshang ma rjes lus dang / gsar pa tshang ma sngon thon yin par ngos 'dzin byas te/ rang snang gang dran gyis thon skyed la bkod pa btang nas dngos yod gnas tshul dang ma 'tshams pa'i sa gnas 'ga' zhig gi nyams myong ngo sprod byas pa dang / btsan shed kyis nyin re ngal rtsol dus yun ring po byed du bcug pa sogs mi mang la brdab gsig chen po btang yod/gzhung gis rgyal gces gzhung 'byu mang po de tsam sprod mi dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs byas yod kyang / sa gnas kyi las byed pa tshos rang nyid la byas rjes dang ngo so yong ched grong gseb phan tshun bar gzhung 'byu 'bul mang nyung 'gran bsdur byed du bcug pa dang / lo re'i 'byu rigs thon tshad dngos yod gnas tshul las brgal ba'i 'ud sgrog byas te gong rim la thon skyed yag po byung tshul snyan seng rdzun ma zhus pa dang / rang gis 'ud sgrog byas pa dang gnas tshul rdzun zhu byas pa'i skyon mtshang sba 'gebs byed ched thon tshad rdzun zhu byas pa'i grangs 'bor gzhir bzung mi mang gi lag nas gzhung 'byu bsdu len byas stabs/ zhing pa rnams la son rtsa dang /bza' 'byu/ sgo phyugs kyi gzan chag bcas phran bu las lhag med par thon skyed byas pa'i 'byu rigs mang che ba dang / tha na de sngon gsog 'jog byas pa'i 'byu 16

rigs rnams kyang gzhung 'byur sprod dgos byung ste zhing pa rnams la bza' 'byu mi ldang ba'i dka' ngal mang po byung yod/ sa khul 'ga' zhig nang bza' 'byu ma ldang ba'i skyen gyis mi ltogs shi thebs pa'i ha cang thabs sdug dang yid skyo ba'i gnas tshul thon yod/ de lnga'i bod kyi spyi mogs de ches mun nag dang / ches kla klo yin rung / spyir btang nas bshad na bza' 'byu mi ldang ba'i dka' ngal de tsam med/lhag par bod mi tshang ma nang chos la dad pa byed mkhan yin stabs/ mi drag zhan tshang mar sbyin pa gtong rgyu'i goms gshis bzang po zhig yod par brten lto slong nas 'tsho ba skyel thub kyi yod pas/ bod la ltogs shi thebs pa'i gnas tshul byung myong med la/ ltogs shi thebs pa'i gnas tshul nga mos mthong myong yang med/bod kyi smad phyogs khul du gzhung gi las byed pa zos zhing 'brog mi mang la gang byung gi bka' gtong ba dang / bka 'a de tshor skyon brjod byas na de 'phral tshogs chen bsdu bskong byas te nyes ming sna tshogs btags nas rdung rdeg gtong gi yod stabs/ mi mang tsho las byed pa dang 'go khrid tshos bshad pa'i skad char sung brtsi bya rgyu las gzhan gyi thabs shes med par gyur yod/ gnas stang sa de 'dra'i 'og las byed pa tshos zhing 'brog mi mang gi thon 'bab mang che ba rgyal gces gzhung 'byu zer ba sogs khral la bsdu len byas te sa khul de tsho'i mi rer bza' 'byu rgya ma bcu las lhag gi med/ sa khul 'ga' zhig nang bza' 'a bru nyung nyung de tsam yang med par gyur yod/ sa khul de tshor skabs der mi mang spyi khang btsugs nas grong tsho so so'i nang spyi thab 'dzugs skabs mi mang tsho spyi thab nang zhugs 'dod yod med la ma ltos par las byed pas btsan she kyis mi tshang ma spyi thab khongs zhugs su bcug yod/ spyi thab de tsho'i nang bza' 'byu ldang nges med rkyen mis za mi lo ba'i sngo tshal dang / mi'i pho bas 'ju mi thub pa'i shing gi pags pa dang / lcang ma'i lo ma sogs la 'byu rigs phran bu bsres te phag pa'i lto chas lta bu zhig mi mang la ster gyi yod cing / de yang grod pa rgyags nges shig yod pa ma red/ gnas 17

tshul de 'dra da phan bod kyi lo rgyus nang rtsa ba nas byung myong med la/ de ltar bkres ltogs kyi mnar ba'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra de snga bod mi tsho'i rmi lam la'ang byung myong med pa zhig red/ za rgyu med pa'i rkyen gyis mi'i lus stobs ha cang zhan por gyur pa'i gnas tshul 'og cham nad sogs 'go nad yang po de 'dras kyang grong tsho'i mi mang po 'das grongs song yod pa red/de snga zhing 'brog bar la sha mar dang 'byu rigs brje tshong byed pa'i srol rgyun zhig yod kyang / skabs der zhing 'brog brje mong byed mtshams chad de 'brog par bza' 'byu med pa dang / zhing par sha mar dang tshwa bul sogs chad nas mi mang gi hrū bar dka' ngal ha cang chen po 'phrad yod/ thabs shes gzhan med pa'i gnas tshul 'og zhing pa tshos sgo phyugs dang rmos mdzo bshas nas za dgos byung zhing / des rkyen pas thon skyed la gnod skyon chen po byung yod pa red/ de bzhin grong khyer nang gi tshong pa mang che ba thing 'khrug nang zhugs yod stabs khag gcig 'dzin bzung gis btson khang du bcug yod pa dang / khag gcig phyi rgyal la bros lcol 'gro dgos byung yod/ skabs der gzhung gi sang khang dang las khungs khag gis mi mang la dngos zog mkho 'don 'thus tshang byed mi thub pa'i khar/ nyin re'i dgos mkho phyi rgyal nas nang 'dren byed mi thub pa sogs kyis dngos zog nyo sa med pa'i dka' ngal chen po 'phrad yod pa dang / yang las byed pas khyim chang so so'i dngos yod gnas tshul la zhib 'jug ma byas par khyim tshang gi nang rten rgyu dngos tshang ma sang gi mang rtsa'i thog bsnan te btsan shed kyis khyod la ma rtsa chen po 'dug ces u tshugs byed pa dang / do bdag nas ma rtsa chen po med lugs kyi 'grel bshad byas na/ khyod kyi klad par bsgyur bkod thebs mi 'dug ces 'jigs skul dang kha rdung btang nas gnon shugs sprad yod/ skabs de'i dpya khral ni tshong gi khe bzang ji byung gzhir ma bzung bar ma rtsa gzhi bzung brgya cha bgos pa ltar sprod dgos kyi yod pas/ tshong pa phos khe bzang byung ba rnams sprad kyang des ma ldang 18

bar ma rtsa nas kyang sprod dgos kyi yod stabs tshong pa mang po zhig ma rtsa stongs nas 'cho thabs med par gyur pa dang / des rkyen pas grong khyer mi mang la dngos zog ldang nges mkho 'don byed mkhan med pa dang / zog gong 'phar ba sogs kyis sems khral dang dka' ngal chen po byung yod pa red/bod kyi skad yig dang goms srol sogs gtor shig btang ba'i gnad don skor/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur dang bskyar zhib las 'gul skabs gsar brje chen po gsum byed dgos zer ba ste/ gtor bshig chen po dang / ther 'don chen po / 'dzugs skrun chen po bcas la brten nas bod kyi skad yig dang / mi rigs kyi goms srol rnams las 'gul de'i kha gtad du brtsis te bod mi rigs kyi skad yig dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos rnams rjes lus dang /phan med la ngos 'dzin byas nas bod skad rgyag mkhan la mthong chung dang / bod chas myon mkhan la 'phya dmod khrel sgod byed pa/ tha na khang par dkar rag gsol ba dang / thog khar dar lcog 'dzugs pa/ chang sa'i rten 'brel dang / bod kyi srol rgyun dus chen khag gshin po'i 'das mchod/ bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i lus rtsal byed sgo sogs tshang ma dgos mkho med pa dang / rjes lus la ngos 'dzin byas te med pa bzo thabs byas yod pa red/mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi thob thang nang gi gal che shos ni mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig bed spyod bya rgyu 'di red/ 'on kyang bod nang bod kyi skad yig la mthong chung gis bed spyod med pa bzos stabs skad yig la nyams chag chen po byung yod/ dper na bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang nang gi kru'u 19

rin rgan gzhon gyis mtshon pa'i bod mi mang che bas rgya yig 'bri klog thub kyi med rung / yig cha tshang ma bod yig thog ma bzos par rgya yig kho na yin zhing / de tsho'i nang nas nga mos nges par blta dgos nges kha shas ma gtogs yig sgyur byed kyi med / de ltar rig gzhung dang goms srol la mthong chung byas pa'i rkyen gyis bod rigs las byed pas rgya chas gyon na ma gtogs mi gral la ma tshud pa lta bu chags pa dang / rgya chas gyon skabs mang phyogs nas khong tshor rgya mi brdzus ma zhes ming 'dogs brgyab yod pa red/ de bzhin dbus nas sa gnas bar gyi gzhung gi las khungs khag dang 0/ slob grwa che chung khag gi nang bod kyi skad yig 'di phan thogs yod med kyi thad la rang snang gang dran gyis thag gcod byas te/ bod kyi skad yig ni tha snyad mi ldang ba dang / gnas tshul go brda mi 'phrod pa/ nus pa med pa red zer ba sogs la kha g.yar te bod kyi skad yig ni rjes lus dang ches dman pa red zer nas dma' 'bebs byed kyi yod pa red/ bod kyi skad yig la tha snyad gsar pa'i rigs ma ldang ba'i skyon yod kyang / 'dzam gling 'og gi skad yig tshang ma mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig nas phan tshun legs cha len res byas te yar rgyas btang ba sha stag red/ bod kyi skad yig la 'di lta bu'i dmang 'bebs dang mthong chung byas pa ni/ bod mi rigs la mthong chung dang dma' 'bebs byas pa zhig red/ da lta bod yig la thob 'os pa'i chab srid kyi gnas bab cig med pa dang / bod yig 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur 'dzin pa'i thabs shes lugs mthun zhig med pa bcas kyi rgyu mtshan 'di gnyis la brten nas bod rigs na gzhon mang po zhig gis bod yig 'di rob tsam shes na 'grigs pa las/ mthar phyin pa zhig bslab 'dod byed kyi med pa dang / 'go khrid tshos kyang der do snang bya rgyu ldang gi med pa bcas kyis bod yig gi mdun lam la nyen kha slebs yod pa 'di ni bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas thad kyi chag sgo chen po zhig yin/mas sngon dang / kun su/ zi khron/ yun nan bcas zhing chen bzhi'i 20

khongs su yod pa'i bod sa khul gye bod mi hrū dang / de bzhin bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khongs su yod pa'i bod mi tsho bcas tshang ma mi rigs gcig dang / skad yig gcig chos lugs rig gzhung bcas gcig yin pas nga tsho'i bar gyi brtse sems dang la rgya ni ha cang gting zab po yod/ nga tsho phan tshun ga dus 'phrad kyang dka' ngal la sems 'khur byed res byed kyi yod/ bod rigs kyi sa khul gang zhig gi mi tsho bde skyid 'tsha bar longs spyod rgyu yod na de la yid smon dang rang nyid la byung ba ltar gyi dga' tshor byed kyi yod/ gal te bod rigs kyi sa khul gang zhig la bgegs bar byus nyes sogs mi shis pa byung na/ de ni nga tsho bod mi tshang mar byung ba ltar sems 'tshab chen po byed par ma zad/ gdung sems mnyam bskyed kyang byed kyi yod/ der brten dbus gzhung gis bod rigs kyi sa khul gang zhig la 'dzin pa'i srid byus legs nyes des bod rigs kyi sa khul tshang mar shugs rkyen chen po thebs kyi yod/ bod rigs kyi sa khul gang zhig la nor 'khrul gyi srid byus lag len bstar ba'i nyen tshabs kyi gyong gun de nga tsho bod mi tshang mar byung ba'i gyong gun zhig la ngos 'a dzin byed kyi yod/ der brten dbus gzhung nas bod mi rigs yongs kyi khe phan dang mthun pa'i thun mong gi srid byus shig lag len bstar rgyu'i re ba yod/da phan bod kyi las don nang thabs sdug gi gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i mang po byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni rgya rig sa las byed pa tshos bod la rtsa ba'i thog nas ngos 'dzin yang dag pa zhig byed thub med pa de yin/ rgya rigs las byed pa de tsho'i nang rgya rigs chen po'i ring lugs kyi bsam slo shugs che yod cing / mi de mos rang nyid mi rigs gzhan pa sus kyang 'gran thabs med pa'i phul byung gi mi rigs shig yin bsam nas nga rgyal khengs dregs byed pa dang / mi rigs phyogs lhung gi lta bas bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos rnams snang med du 'grog pa/ bod mi rigs kyi thob thang dang khe phan ched du skad cha bshad na/ de la sa gnas mi rigs ring 21

lugs red zer ba'i zhwa mo g.yogs nas rdung rdeg gtong gi yod pa red/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin yang mi rigs de ni rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i skad yig dang / rig gzhung / cha lugs/ yul goms gshis lugs bcas las grub pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang mig sngar bod kyi skad yig dang / rig gzhung /cha lugs/ goms gshis sogs rim pas med par bzos dang bzo bzhin pa red/gal te mi rigs kyi byong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnams med pa chags na/ mi rigs de yang rtsa brlags song nas mi rigs gzhan zhig tu 'gyur rgyu red/ yang lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i dus mjug tu bod mi mang po zhig dus zing nang rkyen 'das song ba dang / mang po zhig btson du tshud nas mnar gcod 'og shi ba bcas kyi thog zhing 'brog sa khul du rgya che'i mi mang la bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad de bkres ltogs dang / ngal gdub/ dngangs skrag sogs kyi rkyen ngan sna tshogs 'og dus min 'chi god mang po byung ste lo shas nang bod mi'i mi 'bor je nyung du phyin yod pa 'dis bod mi rigs 'tsha gnas thub min gyi nyen kha chen po bzos yod/ der brten bod kyi sa khul mang po'i bod mi chos thabs shes gang yong gis las byed pa tsho'i bkag rgya las thar ba byas te sa khul so so'i dka' ngal rnams nga la shod par yong gi 'dug khong zos nga mthong ma thag rang dbang med par mig chu btang ste lung pa'i nang gi bka' sdug rnams brjod pa dang / klo ltobs che ba'i 'ga' zhig gis ngu skad drag po dang bcas nga tsho bod lung pa'i mi rnams ltogs shi thebs kyi 'dug chos dang sku gsung thugs rten tshang ma rtsa med bzos song / da nga tsho gangs can bod mi rigs 'di yang rtsa med bzo gi ma red dam zhes brjod kyi 'dugasnyan zhu 'di'i nang ngos nas bod khul gyi gnas tshul thabs sdug rnams gnad bsdus kyis ngo sgrod zhus yod/ zhib phra zhus na yig 'bru khri hrū bcu phrag gis kyang tshang ma zhu mi thub pa zhig yin/ ngas tang dang mi mang gi ched du sger gyi khe phan 22

slos btang nas slobs pa chen po'i ngang snyan zhu 'di bris pa yin la/ de ni nga'i lo rgyus thog gi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba legs po zhig kyang yin/ rang gi las 'gan 'thus tshang ngang bsgrub rgyu yin pa 'dir sku nyid kyi zab yangs dri ma med pa'i thugs kyis gzigs par 'tshal/ paṇa chen er te ni cos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu stag zla 3 tshes 14 spyi lo 1962 lo'i zla 5 tshes 18 bzang por phul//7gong gsal snyan zhu dang 'brel yod gnas tshul dang /kun gzigs rin po cher sku ngal chen po byung ba'i skor/phyi lo 1962 lo'i zla 5 pa'i zla stod kyi mtshan mo zhig pe cing du yod pa'i kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs gnas gzi ma chung nang kun gzigs rin po che mchog dang / gang gi yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis yig 'byu khri bdun gyi gal che'i snyan zhu 'di rgya nag gzhung gi 'go khrid mor phul dang ma phul spor bka' bsdur gnang yod cing / skabs der yongs 'dzin mchog nas kun gzigs rin po cher sku phyag lan gsum phul gnang ste/ bod gangs can pa'i lha skal dang bod 'bangs yongs kyi 'di phyi'i 7skyabs gnas 7gong sa skyabs mgon ta la'i bla ma mchog re zhig bstan 'gro'i don du phyi rgyal la chibs bsgyur ma gnang ka med gyur pa dang / da lta 'dir bod mi mang gi re ltos zhu yul gang nyid las med pas/gal te 'dis rkyen pas sku nyid la 'gal rkyen byung na/ bod mi mang gi re ba'i rgyab rten su la bcol dgos sam zhes spyan chab bsil te cis kyang snyan zhu 'di 'bul rgyu phyir 'then gnang rogs zhes lhag bsam chen pos zhus gnang yod pa red/ 'on kyang kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po mchog nas yig cha 'di'i gal che'i rang bzhin 23

dang / lhag par bod kyi da lta'i gnas stangs thabs sdug 'di dag legs bcos yong ched 'bad brtson gnang rgyu ni gang nyid kyi sku'i phrag par babs pa'i thugs 'gan g.yol thabs med pa zhig yin pa sogs thabs mkhas kyi 'grel bshad gnang bar brten mthar yongs 'dzin mchog nas yig cha 'di 'bul rgyur mos mthun gnang yod pa red/ srid blon kre'u en le byang shar khul la lta zhib tu so nga nas phyir 'khor ma thag 1962 phyi zla 5 tshes 18 nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs re ltar pe cing du mjal 'phrad zhus yod/ skabs der kun gzigs rin po che mchog nas da phan sku ngal khyad bsad kyis bris pa gnang ba'i snyan zhu'i bod yig ma yig dang / rgya yig tu bsgyur pa'i ngo bshus gcig bcas srid slon kre'u zhen ler phul nas snyan zhu 'di 'bri gnang dgos pa'i dmigs yul dang / de'i nang don sogs ngo sprod phran bu zhus gnang yod cing / skabs der mjal 'phrad gnang sar bod sdod rgya dpon krang cing wu dang / wang chi ma'i/ krang go twa sogs yod pa ltar khong chos paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi dgongs 'char de tshor mos mthun ma zhus par brten mjal 'phrad gnang sa de rang la rtsod gleng chen po zhig byung yod red / 1962 zla 6 par rgya nag dbus gzhung gis yig cha 'di lcags par brgyab nas gzhung gi yig cha'i khongs bkod de ches mtho'i 'go khrid nang khul la 'grems spel byas yod pa dang / 'go khrid mi sna li wu han dang / u lan phu /theng kran sogs kyis paṇa chen rin po cher mjal 'phrad zhus te yig cha de skor bka' bsdur zhus yod par ma zad/ ma'o tse tung gis kyang yig cha'i snor paṇa chen mchog dang dmigs bsal mjal 'phrad kyis bka' mol zhus yod pa red/ skabs nge dag tu kun gzigs rin po che mchog nas rgya nag gzhung gi ches mtho'i 'go khrid rnams la bod kyi gnas stangs thabs sdug de tsho'i skor sba gsang med pa'i gsa' bshad gnang ba dang / bod nang yod pa'i rgya rigs 'go khrid las byed kyis gtso/ pa'i khong tsho'i byed stangs la skyon brjod shugs che gnang yod/ lhag par rgya nas 24

tsho / ci gubye /ba ༵༷4rngorteX khu —— — —tsho la/ wa rto ——— gyi/rtsa bye /— ༷/ — — — 5/ rdo pa hoX — — —————— — 5 wa — — — rjeX bye ci/ ciX | / — — — ——4༷ phyi lo 1964 lo'i zla 9 tshes 1 8 nas dus yun nyin 47 tshogs nga 'e bod rang skyo nga ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang gi rgya che'i mosas 'du the ngas bdun pa'i thog kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po cher 'thab 'dzings drag pos 'o brgyal bzo ba'in pa/ // ༷ ——— — — — — gi / re / — ༷ —༷ chi wa ——— — ——— / ga trebye rte —// tsho /—— — — sdo ji sgyu bye/ ——— — —————mi lha zlo tsā/rtsa /smre mos / ji rte — —— 7— — — — —sde //0 77ri// pa / ciX rā rā zi shā rdo ci rwa tsho ste dze/ji /— — — — rdo ———— ( tre ci sku rtsi ༷༷ |༷ — — ——1 ཿni — ——— —1—— / rdo zhe cha —— — — ཿ ji che ——— — ———— — ——— — ba ༷

gzhung gis bod la 'dzin pa'i srid byus kyi rtsa ba'i gnad don kha shas thad gang nyid kyi gzigs tshul gsal po gsungs yod pa red/snyan zhu de phul gnang rjes dbus gzhung gi 'go khrid 'ga' zhig gis thog mar bod kyi las don la bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu'i bsam 'char bton pa dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las khungs kyi 'go 'dzin li thu han dang / zhi krung zhun sogs kyis bod kyi las don la bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu'i yig cha khag bzhi tsam bzos yod pa red/ der brten paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas gang nyid kyi snyan zhu der gzhung gi dpon rigs tshos do snang byas te bod kyi las don la rtsa ba'i bsgyur bcos shig gtong rgyu dang / dka' sdug gis nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i bod mi rnams sdug bsngal gyi gnas las skyob thabs gnang ba'i gang nyid kyi 'bad brtson la grub 'bras thob rgyu red dgongs te spro ba chen pos phyi zla da pa'i nang bod la phyir phebs gnang yod pa red de nas dus tshod ring po ma song bar mtsho kha'i grong khyer spe da'i had zer ba ri dmar po'i tshogs pa'i dbus chab srid lhan khang gi tshogs 'du slong tshogs byas pa de'i thog ma'o tse tung ngo mas paṇa chen rin po che'i snyan zhur do snang byas te bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu'i bsam blo yod mkhan dpon rigs khag gcig la skyon brjod shugs che byas pa dang / 'go khrid khag gci ga gis paṇa chen rin po che'i snyan zhu deshā ri bltas nas paṇa chen gyi mjug ma bkyag ste gnam la thug gi yod pa red ces zur za ngan smras byas yod pa red/ ma'o tse tung gis kyang krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid krang cing wu la khyod chos paṇa chen de bod mi rigs kyi gtso 'dzin zhig la gso skyong byed rtsis yod dam/ ngas bltas na paṇa chen gyis bod mi rigs kyi gtso 'dzin zhig byed thub kyi ma red ces bshad yod pa red/ gong gsal tshogs 'du'i gnas tshul bod la 'byor ma thag krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang nang gi rgya mi 'go khrid mi sna tsho'i bsam par da phan paṇa chen rin po ches khong tsho'i las ka byed phyogs la skyon brjod mang po gnang yod pa de dag gi 'khon lan 154

slog pa'i dus chod slebs song bsam nas dga' thag chod pa dang / de nas bzungachogs 'du gal che khag la paṇa chen rin po che phebs rgyu bkag 'gog byas pa red/lo de'i phyi zla 10 par bod las don u yon lhan khang zer bas paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi nye dus kyi gsung bshad kha shas nang nor 'khrul tshabs che yod pa de dag la 'ib bsher byed dgos zhes bshad yod pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas skyon brjod de tsho zhal bzhes gnang med pa red/phyi lo 1962 lo nas bzung paṇa chen rin po che mchog gzhung gi phogs 'du khag sogs chab srid kyi las don nang zhugs su ma bcug pa'i gnas tshul 'og lo gnyis ring lha sa'i bzhugs khri gling khar yod pa'i rdo je pho brang nang zhal 'don dang /mo sdi pra 'bebs/ mnal lam brtag pa sogs chos phyogs kyi mdzad pas dus 'das nas bzhugs pa las gzhan gyi phyag las med pa red/ 1964 lor rgya nag gzhung gis gtsang bsher bzhi dang / slob gso chen po gsum zer ba'i las 'gul spel ba dang / phyi zla 9 tshes 18 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang gi u yon tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thengs bdun pa zer ba skong 'tshogs byas nas tshogs 'du nyin zhe bdun phogs pa de'i ring paṇa chen rin po che mchog la yig 'byu khri bdun gyi snyan zhu'i thad skyon brjod shugs che zhus yod pa red/ skabs der kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas mi nga ni bsam rgyu mang la bya rgyu nyung ba'i mi zhig yin zhes bka' lan 'di u tshugs mtha' skyel gnang ba las mi de tsho'i skyon brjod zhal bzhes rtsa ba nas gnang med/ der brten gzhung gi 'go khrid dpon rigs g.yo sgyu dang gdug rtsub gnyis ldan de tshos bkra shis lhun po dgon pa'i bla ma klad med 'ga' zhig dang / de min hur brtson can zer ba khag gcig ngan skul byas te kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog la nyin bstud nas 'thab 'dzings byed du bcug pa dang / mi de hrū yang gcig nas gzhan dbang la gyar ba dang / gnyis nas rang nyid la ming gnas yong rgyu'i re bas dkar nag go ldog 27

gi ham shed rdzun gtam mang po bshad pa dang 'brel paṇa che na rin po che mchog la de dag khas len gnang dgos pa'i drag rtsub chen po byas par ma zad/ tha na lag pa bkyag nas sku la gnod 'tshe btang yod pa red/ phogs 'du de'i bog nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog la khong ni zhing bran bdag po'i ro langs kyi las 'gul spel mkhan dang / gung khran tang la ngo rgol dang / mi mang la ngo rgol / spyi zogs ring lugs la ngo rgol bcas gnang mkhan red zer ba'i nag nyes kyi dbu zhwa chen po zhig g.yog yod pa red/1964 lo'i lo mjug tu rgya nag pe cing du skabs gsum pa'i rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs dang po phyogs pa de'i thog srid blon kre'u zhen les 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis la yod pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang zer ba'i dbu 'dzin gyi ming tsam gyi mtshan gnas de yang med pa bzos pa'i khyab bsgrags byas yod pa dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog pe cing du btsan khrid zhus pa red/ de nas mi ring bar rig gnas gsar brje zer ba'i 'dre rlung langs shing / skabs der mi stong phrag mang po'i khrod du kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog la 'thab 'dzings btang ba dang / skabs re dmar sung dmag zer ba'i mi ngan de mos paṇa chen rin po che mchog gi bzhugs gnas su 'dzul nas paṇa chen rin po che mchog thag pas bsdams te mi tshogs kyi khrod du khrid nas g.yas 'then g.yon 'then byed pa dang / thu lu 'debs pa/ nyes rdung phul ba sog sa byas pa'i skabs de'i bya spyod rnamus dngos su mthong na smos ci/ gnas tshul thos pa tsam yang bod mi rnams kyi sems kyis bzod thabs bral nas rang dbang med par mig chu shor gyi yod pa red / gang ltar 1964 1978 lo'i bar pe cing du thog mar bzhugs gnas gzim shag tu bzang btson lta bur bzhugs dgos byung ba dang / de rjes btson khang nang lo dgu dang zla ba bdun bzhugs da gos byung ba 28

de'i ring sku ngal tshad las 'das pa byung ba gang gi sku gzugs kyi rma shul nas gsal po mjal rgyu yod/ 1980 lo'i lo stod du rgya nag gi mi rabs gsar pa'i 'go khrid hu'u ya'o pang gis gtso 'gan khur nas bod kyi las don skor gyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du thengs dang po slong 'tshogs byed skabs kun gzig paṇa chen rin po che mchog gdan 'dren zhus yod cing / paṇa chen rin po che mcho ga nas kyang tshogs 'du de'i thog slar yang bod la byung ba'i thabs sdug gi gnas tshul de tsho'i skor sba gsang med par gsungs nas skyon brjod gnang ba dang chabs cig las don byed phyogs gang mgyogs legs cha'i 'gyur ba gtong dgos pa'i re ba 'don pa gnang yod pa red/ tshogs 'du grol rjes khong nyid dang 'dra ba'i dung rdeg chen po phog myong ba'i 'go khrid mi sna 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal lags dang bod kyi las don skor bka' mol gnang skabs / bod mi mang gi dka' sdug gnas tshul de mo mthong skabs sems nang gi khong khro mnan mi thub par rang dbang med par skad cha shod dgos kyi 'dug ngas yig 'byu khri bdun gyi snyan zhu de'i nang skad cha drang po bshad pa'i rkyen gyis btson khang gi nga lo dgu dang zla ba bdun sdod dgos byung / yin na'ang nga'i rang gshis 'di bcos thub kyi mi 'dug la/ bsgyur bcos gtong rgyu'i 'dod pa'ang med ces gsungs yod pa red/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis dus bab shin tu dza drag 'og sku ngal dang nyen khar ma 'dzems par bris gnang ba'i yig 'bru khri pho bdun gyi snyan zhu de ni rgya nag gzhung gis bod la btsan 'dzul dbang sgyur byas rjes byung ba'i bod mi mang gi khrag dang mig chu'i lo rgyus kyi bden dpang gal che zhig red la/kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gi sku tshe'i mdzad pa'i nang gi brjid rlabs shin tu che ba'i le'u zhig kyang yin to// / /29

kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas lha ldan smon lam chen mor gsung chos thog stsal ba'i bka' slob/(1986 lo'i zla 2 tshes 24 nyin/)ko༅༅/ /da res lha sa'i smon lam chen mo lo nyi shu'i ring bar chad pa de rgyun mthud gnang yas kyi tshogs tshogs rgyu yod pa dang / de bzhin sngar gyi chos phyogs mdzad sgo tshang ma bskyar gso/ lhag par du'ang lha rams pa tshos dam bca' bzhag nas lha rams gtong rgyu yod pa 'di ltar byung ba ni rang gzhan tshang ma ha cang sems dga' dgos pa dang / yid dad 'os pa/ sems spro ba/ dga' zhing mgu nas thal mo sbyar dgos nga/'i gnas tshul zhig red/ lha sa'i smon lam 'di nyid ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos thog mar btsugs pa gnang ba'i chos kyi mdzad sgo rlabs che zhing / gal che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin/ de ni lo ngo lnga brgya lhag tsam ring rtsa ba'i cha nas bar ma chad par byung yod/ 1959 lo'i dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi rjes su'ang phal cher smon lam ni chos kyi byed sgo zhig rang yin par nges gtan byas te mu mthud tshugs pa red/ yin na'ang bkra mi shis par drug cu re drug tsam la g.yon thal lam phyogs kyi shugs rkyen dbang gis lha sa'i smon lam rgyun chad pa dang / mtshams bzhag pa red/ 1986 lor bskyar gso byas pa red/ de ni tang krung dbyang nas thugs 'khur rlabs chen gnang ba dang / tang gi cod dad rang mos kyi srid byus ni kha zhe gnyis med yin pa ma 'di ni kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas lo nyi shu'i ring rgyun chad pa'i lha ldan smon lam chen mo bskyar gso gnang ste me stag zla 1 tshes 15 nyin gsung chos ra bar sngar lam gsung zos stsal skabs kyi bka' slob yin/30

gtogs mi la mgo bskor gtong yas kyi 'dra chags ma yin pa/ chos dad rang mos kyi srid byus cha tshang ba lag len bstar yas/ tang gi chos lugs kyi srid byus rnams gom pa re re bzhin lag len bstar ba'i dan rtags kyi rtags mtshan red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas nga tsho bod mi rigs 'di ni rtsa ba'i cha nas yongs rdzogs nang pa'i chos la dad pa byed mkhan song tsang / bod kyi sa khul du cos lugs kyi gnad don 'di ni mi rigs kyi gnad don dang 'brel yod pa yin dus/ chos kyi mdzad sgo rlabs chen 'di dag bskyar gso dang gong spel btang na mi rigs kyi goms gshis dang / mi rigs 'di nyid kyi dad 'dun dang goms srol la sogs par brtsi 'jog dang cha 'jog byas pa yin/ da res bskyar gso byas pa 'di la chos kyi gnad don tsam du ma zad/ mi rigs kyi gnad don yang yod pa yin/ de ni ha cang gi gal chen po yin/ don gnad 'di'i brgyud rim nang du klo mthun wu cing twa yis dbus pa'i ljongs tang ud gsar pa 'di nyid kyis hur brtson chen po'i rgyab skyor dang mthun 'gyur gnang yod/ der brten nga tshos nges par du thog mar tang krung dbyang la thugs rje che zhu yas dang / gnyis su ljongs tang ud la'ang thugs rje che zhu yas yin/ kha sngon bod tshes 8 nyin ljongs tang ud dang / ljongs mi mang 'thus mi'i tshogs chen gyi rgyun las khang / ljongs mi mang srid gzhung /ljongs chab srid gros tshogs bcas khong tsho mnyam du dge 'dun pa tshor phyag 'gyed phul ba dang bsnyen bkur zhus/ dbu khrid rnam pa tsho tshang ma sbyin bdag gi phogs gral du phebs/ las khungs chen mo bzhi'i drung yig chen mo tsho sgos slor la phebs pa bcas de dag ni lo rgyus thog ma byung ba zhig red/ sngon ma lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i nang phyag 'gyed phul ba dang bsnyen bkur zhus yod kyang dbu khrid tsho tshang ma phebs pa byung yod pa ma red/ der brten da res kyi 'di ni ha cang gi gal chen po zhig yin pa red/ ngas khyed rang tshor zhu dgos pa zhig la gung khran tang rang gi lam lug thog nas bshad na chos 'a dad pa yod pa ma red/ sngon chad ching rgyal rabs 31 — —

kyi skabs su gong mas 'gyed phul ba de 'dra byung yod/ de dag ni gong ma kho rang tsho chos la dad pa yod pa red/ der brten bsnyen bkur zhus pa der ya mtshan rgyu med/ gung khran tang chos la dad pa med/ yin na'ang srid byus thog chos dad rang mos yod/ cos kyi drang bden gyi bya ba la rgyun ldan gyi srung skyob yod/ mi rigs kyi yul goms gshis lugs la brtsi 'jog byas nas tshang mar sku 'gye da phul ba dang / pos skor la bskyod pa/ sbyin bdag gi gral la bsdad pa bcas 'di 'dra ni sngar gyi g.yon thal lam phyogs kyi srid byus skabs su bsam blor rtsa ba nas 'khor thabs yod pa ma red/ rnam pa tshos 'di'i don dag ha cang gal chen po yin pa tshang mas mkhyen pa gnang rogs / da res gsol ja dang bzhes thug thog phyag 'gyed kyang sgor 10 re phul yod/ ngas de nyin khong tsho hru'u ci rnam pa tshor zhu rgyu byung / gang ltar rang re'i rgyal khab dpal 'byor thog ha cang phyug po min / lhag par bod la mtshon na dpal 'byor thog dka' ngal yod pa'i skabs su'ang rgyal khab nas dngul phul te 'gyed gnang ba 'di chen po red/ rgyal khab gcig gi ngos nas mtshon na sgor 10 chen po ma red/ 'on kyang sgor mang nyung 'di gnad 'gag ma yin par sgor gcig gnang na'ang 'dra/ sgor khri gcig gnang na'ang 'dra de'i gtso bo ni tang dang srid gzhung nas rang re'i chos dad la brtsi 'jog gnang gi yod pa dang / gus brtsi gnang gi yod pa/ bod mi rigs kyi yul goms gshis lugs la cha 'jog byed kyi yod pa/ bod mi rigs la cha mthong byed kyi yod pa bcas mtshon de yin/ de'i thog nges par du tshang mas dga' tshor gnang dgos/ rgyu mtshan de brgyud nas tshang mas tang la dga' zhen dang / rang re'i rlabs chen mes rgyal la dga' zhen/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la dga' zhen/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur dang mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs sdon brgyab ste mthun sgril dang phyug po shes dpal ldan pa'i bod ljongs gsar pa zhig 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du legs skyes 'bul thub pa gnang dgos zhes zhu rgyu yin/32

gnyis nas da res lha sa'i smon lam la nga rang yong nas 'gan tshang ma 'khur te gtso skyong byas pa yin la/ nga rang la shes bya yon tan dang nus pa gang yang med kyang tang dang / lhag par bod mi mang nas nga la yis ches gnang ba dang /rang nyid nas 'jon na'ang red ma 'jon na'ang red da res kyi las ka 'di byed dgos kyi 'dug nga'i re ba la mi ring bar 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa bod la phebs rgyu byung nas lha sa'i smon lam la sogs pa'i chos kyi mdzad sgo de tsho'i gtso skyong gnang rgyu'i skal pa bzang po yong ba'i smon 'dun byed kyi yod/ khong nas nye char rgya gar du dus 'a khor dbang chen gnang ba de 'dra byung 'dug de dag ni shin tu nas bstan 'gro'i don chen rlabs po che red/ 7rgyal ba rin po che dang nga gnyis ni chos grogs yin / nga pho gnyis kyi bar mi mthun pa de 'dra gang yang med/ yin na'ang sdeng skabs mi re zung nas dkrog gtam bzos te sngar gyi gzhung bla dang de 'dra'i dam sol gyi skad cha shod mkhan tog tsam yong gi 'dug ngas khong tshor zhu yas la de 'dra ma bshad na yag po 'dug de ltar brjod tshe de ni dge med skyon gyur dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bod mi rigs tshang mar gnod skyon ma gtogs yong gi ma re da/ ngas mi rigs mthun sgril byed dgos zhes brjod kyi yod/mi rigs kyi mthun sgril 'di ngas cha gsum la dbye gi yod/ cha dang po ni nga tsho rgya bod ri gas kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon rgyag dgos/ bod la mtshan na nga chos nges par du rgya rigs slo mthun la brtsi 'jog byed dgos pa dang / khong tshor mthun sgril dang rogs ram byed dgos pa yin/ khong tsho ni rang gi pha yul nas ring du bral te bod la rogs ram byed par phebs pa red/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas khong tsho yin na'ang nga hrū bod mi rigs la lhag bsam rnam dag dang / kha zhe gnyis med kyi thog nas zhabs 'degs bsgrub dgos pa ma gtogs/ yang nga tsho dpon po byed par yong ba yin mdog mdog dang / nga hrū khyed tsho'i dpon po yin mdog mdo ga 'di 'dra gnang na yag po rtsa ba nas med/ nga tsho 'dra mnyam 33

gyi rmang gzhi'i rdzog nas rgya bod mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la nges par du shugs snon rgyag dgos/ gnyis pa ni bod mi rigs dang mi rigs chung khag gzhan bar gyi mthun sgril yin/ bod nang mi rigs chung ba mon dang / klo pa/ kha che de min gzhan dag nas yong ba'i mi rigs kyang yod pa red/ gsum pa ni nga tsho bod mi rigs nang khul nges par du mthun sgril byed dgos pa yin/ bod mi rigs nang khul mthun sgril byed rgyu 'di ha cang gal chen po yin/ ngas snga bar phyi gsum du bod nang khul gyi mthu na sgril la sems 'khur byed kyi yod la/ gnad don yod pa'i bya ba tshang mar ngo rgol dang dgag pa rgyag gi yod/ 'on kyang blo pham dang sems ma bde ba'i sdug bsngal yong ba zhig la/ deng gi srid byus bzang po 'di'i 'og tu yang bsam blo rnying pa dang na tsha rnying pa mang po zhig langs nas gtsang zhen dang dbus zhen zer ba dang / yang gzhung dang bla brang zer ba'i skad cha dzor po de 'dra yar slong ba dang / yang khams pa dang / a mdo/ bod pa/zhes gcig bshad kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra'i gnas tshul mang po go thos yong bzhin pa 'di yag po rtsa ba nas ma red/ rang cag tshang ma pha sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa' dang / ma srin mo brag srin gyi rgyud pa gcig las byung ba'i bod kha ba can pa yin pas/ phar phyogs tshur phyogs byas na dge mtshan rtsa ba nyid nas med/nga tsho bod kyi lo rgyus la bltas na'ang rgyal po glang dar ma nas bzung ste bod 'di nang khul kha thor phyin pa la brten nas bod 'di yag po byung med/ yang nam zhig bod nang khul du 'grigs po dang mthun po byung ba'i skabs su bod mi rigs rang nyid kyang yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba/ kha bral du phyin na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la god chags dang / mi rigs yin na'ang nyams rgud 'gro ba/ mi mang hrū yang sdug bsngal myong ba de 'dra'i gnas tshul yod pa yin pas tshang mas phyogs zhen rtsa ba nas ma gnang rogs gnang / dgon pa nang khul yin na'ang nga dang khyod ces brjod rgyu med/ 34

sngon chad g.yon thal lam phyogs kyi 'og tu tshang ma mnan nas 'jog skabs tshig gcig brjod yas med la/ tshig gcig kyang shod thub kyi med/ da cha skyid po byung dus na tsha rnying pa de tsho yar 'phar na yag po med pas 'di tshang ma'i thugs la 'jags pa gnang rogs/ tshang ma yag po byung na bod 'di nyid gzhi nas yar rgyas yong ba dang / mi rigs 'di nyid kyang sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud thub pa / mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi sa khul gzhan dang 'dra bar gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yong ba/ rang re'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa slar gso'i bya ba 'di tsho yang yag po sgrub thub pa bcas yong rgyu yin pa tshang ma'i thugs la 'jags pa gnang rogs/ deng skabs phyogs zhen gyi skad cha 'di mang du mang du 'gro gi 'dug pas nga rang skyid po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug la/ dge mtshan khyon nas med pas 'di tsho tshang ma'i thugs la 'jags pa gnang rogs zhes zhu yas gcig 'di yin/de nas zhu yas gzhan zhig la gong du ngas zhus pa bzhin dge bcu'i tshul khrims la gnas dgos/ lus kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa dang / ma sbyin pa len pa/'dod pas log par g.yem pa/ de'i thog gtso bo zhu yas chang dang tha mag gi skor yin / de tsho dar khyab ha cang chen po 'dug la/ gnod tshabs kyang ha cang chen po yod/ bar lam nas tha mag 'di gsar brje'i bya ba zhig la brtsis nas tha mag 'then dgos kyi med na'ang tha mag 'then nas kha yang kyog kyog byas te bsdad kyi yod/tha mag la dge mtshan gang yang med/ deng skabs 'dzam gling thog brjod pa'i e ṭi'i nad zer ba 'di la bod skad la skran nad zer/ de 'gog thabs su yo rab tu mkhas pa mang po zhig gis tshogs 'du tshogs nas gnas tshul dang por tha mag de 'gog dgos kyi 'dug ces brjod yod/ sngon thon gyi mi tshos tha mag bkag dgos zhes brjod yod/ tha mag 'then pa 'di sngon thon gang yang min/ chos phyogs nas bshad na sangs rgyas sku mya ngan 'ad sa te lo brgya tsam gyi rjes su bdud kyi rigs su skyes pa'i byed zhig gi zla mtshan las dug ha lo zer ba de skyes nas des smon 35

lam log pa brgyab ste dug de phyin chad sus 'then yang bsod nams zad nas lus la nad dang / lung par bkra mi shis pa/ char chu mi 'bab pa/ nad yams sogs yong ba shog ces smon lam brgyab ste byung ba yin pa gsungs yod/ deng skabs kyi tshan rig thog nas bshad na'ang na tsha mang po yong ba dang / dpal 'byor thog nas bshad na'ang dngul phran bu yod pa de tha mag gi thog la btang / tha mag yag pa de tsho ni lkog nyo byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ ltag sgo brgyud na ma gtogs rag gi med/ byas tsang cos dang 'jig rten gang gi thog na sa kyang tha mag 'di yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug lha rab byung na tha mag 'then rgyu med/ gal te 'then mkhan tshos kyang nyung du gtong thub na yag po red/ nyung du nyung du btang nas mjug tu gcod thub pa byed dgos/ lhag par du yang grwa pa mos tha mag 'then na ha cang sdug chags red/ tha mag 'then mkhan med dam/ yod srid pa red/ grwa pa tshos tha mag 'then na yag po rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ sngon sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su rbud gcig gi lag pa gcig la chang zhig 'khyer ba dang / lag pa gcig la ra zhig 'khrid de dge sbyong zhig la khyed kyi chang 'di 'thung dang / yang na ra 'di gsod/ de min na nga la 'dod pa spyod dgos zhes brjod stabs/ dge sbyong des 'dod pa spyad na rang nyid la pham pa yong rgyu dang / ra bsad na srog gcod kyi nyes pa yong rgyu/ de las chang de 'thung na phran bu legs pa bsams te sgo bo lags kyis chang de yag thag chod cig 'thungs pa 'dra 'dug de rjes kho chang gis bzi nas ra de bsad pa dang / spud der yang 'dod pa spyad de tha ma sdig pa gsum ga tshang ba red/ 'di 'dra gzhung nas gsungs yod pa red/ song tsang chang zer ba 'di yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug chang ni nga mo nang pa sangs rgyas pas bkag yod par ma zad/ chos lugs gzhan dag kha che dang de min tshang ma'i nang nas bkag yod pa dang / chos lugs tshang mas chang 'di yag po min par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa red/ song tsang bod la yin 36

na'ang 'di 'dra rang red/ chang 'thung mkhan ni ha cang gi thabs skyo po red/ mi 'ga' shas snga dro nas 'go btsugs te phyi dro'i ba ra nyin gang chang 'thung ste sdod pa de ltar byas na las ka dang slob spyong gang 'dra byas te yong gi red dam/ song tsang de rigs rtsa ba nas yag po ma red/ lhag par du yang rab tu byung ba mos chang 'thu nga na/ sangs rgyas kyis srog dang bsdo sa kyang chang ma 'thung zhes gsungs yod pas de rigs rtsa ba nas ma gnang rogs/ chang 'thung na sdig pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chen po yod pa dang / chang 'thung mkhan la sdig pa yod la/ chang glud mkha na la'ang sdig pa yod/ tshe 'dir nad mang la rlung rta rgud pa/ tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa/ nad dang 'byung pos thub pa/ phyi ma ngan song du tū nga ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa yod pa chos phyogs nas bshad yod pa red/'jig rten gyi ngos nas bshad na'ang shes gsal yin/ mi tshang gcig gi nang chang 'thung nas rgyag res kho na rgyag gin bsdad na mi tshang de la bkra mi shis pa yo nga rgyu yin/ las ka 'thus shor ba dang / pha ma sogs la gus zhabs med ge kau bza' tshang bar la mi mthun pa pa sogs yong gi red/ mo ṭar gtong mkhan rigs kyis chang 'thung ba ni mgo rnyog rang red/ a tsi 'grims 'grul gyi cha rkyen nang du chang 'thung chog gi yod pa ma red/ nga lto bod la ga re byas pa yin nam / mo ṭar gtong mkhan de chos kyang chang rgyags tshad 'thungs nas mo ṭar de 'khyor 'khyor mi'i sgang la smyon pa nang bzhin gtong ba dang / brdung ga rgyag pa de dag gis so so rang nyid la dka' ngal bzo bar ma zad/ mi gzhan la'ang dka' ngal bzo gi yod pas de tsho ni ha cang gi goms gshis ngan pa red/ chos dang 'jig rten gang nas bltas kyang yag po rtsa ba nas med/ song tsang nga'i re ba la lha rab byung na chang gcod thub pa dang / yongs rdzogs lam seng gcod thub kyi med na'ang 'bor chen 'thung ba 'di yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug chang la tshad byas re nyung du btang nas rim bzhin gcod thub pa'i phyogs la 'bad brtson byed dgos/37

lhag par rab tu byung ba phor mchod chang rtsa ba nas ma mchod rogs gnang zhu gi yin/skabs re grwa pa chos a rag shel dam de 'dra bzung nas bsdad kyi med pa'i nges pa med / 'di 'dra rtsa ba nas ma gnang rogs/ nga mos sngon gyon dam pa'i rnam thar / rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len zhes ya rabs spyod bzang la yar blta dgos pa las mar blta rgyu med/ kha mig yar blta byed dgos zhes sangs rgyas kyis gsungs yod la/ sngon byon gyi dam pa rnams kyis kyang de ltar gsungs yod/deng dus chab srid kyi thog nas kyang spyi phyogs ring lugs kyi spyod bzang dang /gung khran ring lugs kyi spyod bzang gi gus zhabs byed yas kyi dril bsgrags gnang gi yod/ nga cho bod la cha bzhag na sngon chos rgyal rnams kyis gtan la phab pa'i mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug la sogs pa yod pa yin/ de dag ni rang re'i mi rigs rang nyid kyi srol rgyun bzang po yin/ chos dang 'jig rten gang du yin na'ang spyi tshogs nang ya rabs kyi spyod pa dang ldan pa zhig dang / ya rabs kyi spyode par 'jug par byed pa la dang po thog mar so so rang gi pha mar gus zhabs bya rgyu 'di shin tu gal chen po yin/ chos kyi nang byang chub kyi sems 'gyong dus sems can thams cad mar shes pa dang / de dag gi drin dran par byas te mar shes/ drin dran / drin gzo'i bsam pa bcas bskyed de sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub dgos pa red/ deng skabs mi 'ga' zhig gis so so'i pha ma la'ang gus zhabs mi byed pa dang / pha mar brtse sems bcang rgyu phar bzhag pha ma'i 'gram par gzhu grabs byed kyi yod/ de 'dra byas na 'grig gi red dam/ pha ma la gus zhabs byed dgos la/ mi rgan par yang gus zhabs byed dgos/ kha lag yag pa zhig yod na pha ma la phul da gos pa dang / dug log yag pa zhig yod na pha ma la phul dgos pa red/ pha ma hrū sdod sa yin na'ang yag sa'i nang 'jog dgos pa yin/ de 'dra min par kha lag yag pa de so so dang so so'i a lces zas/ pha mar sdug pa de sprad/ khang pa yag pa de'i nang so so bsdad/ sdug pa der pha 38

sla bzhag de min deng skabs kyi mi kha shas kyis so so slob grwar song nas las byed pa 'dra byas/ pha ma grong gseb pa byas te dug log dkar po zhig gyon nas so so'i phru gur blta bar yong skabs kho ngo tsha nas 'di so so'i pha ma yin zhes shod nus kyi med pa dang / kho rang las byed pa che ge mo zhe po gcig yin zer gyi yod pa red/ rdzig yas ga re yod pa red dam/ pha ma 'di las skyes pa'i phru gu red/bo rang rdzig po de 'dra dgos kyi yod na pad ma las rdzus te skyes na 'grigs kyi red/deng skabs mi khyad mtshar de 'dra 'dug wa ye/ pha ma la nges par gus zhabs byed dgos pa yin/ tshang mas rgya skad slog brnyan ming la shis yis ming zer ba 'di gzigs myong yod kyi red/ kho rang gnyis kyis mog thug zas/ pha rma la ma smos pa'i lo tog za ru bcug phru gu chung chung zhig yod pa des ma shes ji ra spo bo lags 'di bzhes nas ga re yong / nang la mog thug yod ces brjod nas mog thug 'khyer yong bar brten spo bo lags kyis shes pa'i lo rgyus kyi slog brnyan zhis yod pa red/ bya ba dngos kyi nang la de 'dra byed mkhan yod pa las med si mi na/ slog brnyan 'khrab pa gcig pu ma red/ de 'dra'i bya ba rtsa ba nas bya rgyu mee da/ pha mar nges par gus zhabs byed dgos/de bzhin mi rgan rabs tsho la yang gus zhabs byed dgos pa red/ pha ma dang rgon rabs la gus zhabs bya rgyu 'di ni chos kyi thog nas dge ba chen po bsags si ra rme zad/ 'jig rten gyi thog nas mi rigs shig la mtshon na ya rabs kyi spyod dku yo da pa dang / 'jig rten gyi spyi tshogs 'di yang mgo dang mjug yod pa zhig chasas rgyur ha cang gal chen po yin/ don dngos so so sger la mtshon na'ang kun tsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ gang yin zhe na so so rang nyid kyang rgas rgyu red/ so rtso ma/ rgas par ji srid bar gzhon pa byas te sdod kyi yin nam/ de 'dra su yang bsnga da yas yod pa ma red/ nam zhig so so rang rgad ོ chags yong dus rang nas so so'i pha mar da lta byas pa ltar phru gus rang la byas yong dus mig chu shor rgyu 39

red / spyi tshogs nang ya rabs kyi spyod pa rgan pa tshos kyang yag po byas/ gzhon pa tshos kyang zhabs phyi zhus/ de ltar byas na rjes su so so rgad dus so so'i phru gyu tshos so sor yag po byed kyi red/ de ltar rgyun mthud nas 'gro dus spyi tshogs de yag po zhig yong gi red/ da lta'i dus mod la pha ma la gus zhabs zhu yas 'di chos dang 'jig rten gang nas bsam yang ha cang gal chen po yin pa 'di tshang ma'i thugs la 'jags pa gnang dgos/ bza' tshang gi bar la yang 'grigs nge dang mthun po byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ gcig gis gcig la rgyag res sha stas brgyab nas phar mgo bskor btang / tshur mgo skor btang / rgyag res brgyang byas na yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug de nas so so'i phru gu bu phrug la slob gso yas po brgyab/ phru gu chung ngu'i dus ni ras dkar po dang 'dra bas chos ga re brgyab kyang de rang len gyi yod/ der brten khong tshor bslab bya yag po brgyab/ chung dus nas ya rabs kyi spyod par 'jug pa dang / chung dus nas pha mar gus zhabs yod pa/ rgan pa la yang zhe sa dang gus zhabs yod pa/ phru gu nang tshags rgyas res mi rgyag pa/ nyam thag yin na de la phan sems dang rogs ram bya rgyu/ mi sdug bsngal can yod na de dag la snying rje dang phan thogs kyi bya ba byed thub ji yon tan sbyang rgyur dga' po dang / bag med g.yeng ba'i bya bar mi dga' ba/ ma gzhi phru gu zer ba de rtsed mor dga' po yod/ de yang lus sems bde thang la phan thogs yod pa'i rtsed mo la zhugs dgos pa yin/ de min rgyag res rgyag pa dang / rku ma brku ba/ tha mag 'then pa de 'dra'i ngan pa'i lam du mi zhugs pa nang la dus thog log nas gad 'phyis byed pa dang pha mar la zhabs phyi zhu ba/ de rigs chung dus nas slob sbyong yag po sgrod dgos/ de ltar byas tshe chos phyogs nas bshad na phru gu de yar 'tshar yong dus spyod pa yag po yong ba dang / dngos dang shugs su dge ba'i bag chags mang po bzhag nas 'jig rten phyi ma ngan song 'a mi ltung ba dang / bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i sems dang sa lam gyi rtogs ji 40

thams cad rim bzhin grol thub pa/ 'jig rten gyi ngos nas bshad na spyi tsogs la phan thogs yod pa dang / lung par phan thogs yod pa/ tshang ma la dge mtshan yod/ bod ljongasalugasar pa'i 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du nus pa 'don thub pa de 'dra yong gi red/ de min goms gshis ngan pa mang po 'jags na sdig pa'i las gsog par ma zad/ kho rang btson khang nang 'gro dgos yas dang / tha ma srog la nyen kha 'phrad srid pa sogs yong gi red/ der brten phru gu zer ba 'di la chung dus nas bdag po yag po brgyab/ bslab bya yag po brgyab byed dgos pa yin/ pha ma kha shas kyis bdag po khyon nas ma brgyab pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis gces lang la btang ba de 'dra byed kyi yod/ ngas 'dir dpe zhig zhus na/sngar rgya nag la gtam rgyud cig 'dug phru gu gnyis khrims la thug nas srog thog gi nyes pa gtong gi yin zhes bshad yod pa dang / phru gu gcig gi a mas phru gu der ha cang gi gces po byas te phru gu des ga re byed kyi yin brjod kyang de byed du bcug nas gces lang btang / za yas dgos zer na'ang 'dra/ gyon yas dgos zer na'ang 'dra/ gang dgos zer na'ang phru gu de rang ma gtogs med stabs 'o sa ga re byed dgos zer ba byed du bcug pa red/ rjes su phru gu de ma rabs tsha ru phyin nas rku ma brkus/ gang byung mang byung byas te mi yang bsad par brten rma tha' ma kho 'dzin bzung byas nas srog thog gi nyes chad btang ba red/ sngar gyi khrims la srog thog gi nyes pa gtong skabs khyed rang la lab rgyu dang byed rgyu ga re yod ces re 'dun zhu rgyu yod na de tsho so so'i mdun de rang du byed 'jug gi yod pa red/'os ma shi gong la a ma thug chog pa gnang rogs gnang / a ma dang thug 'phrad cig byed kyi yin zhus par 'di 'grigs kyi red ces bshad nas kho rang gi a ma de dru sa nas thug bcug pa red/ khros a ma la de ring nga gsod kyi red/ der brten nga rang phru gu song tsang a ma khyed rang gi nu ma de nu dgos kyi 'dug ces bshad pa/ra brten/ a mas de rang 'grig gi red ces nu ma nu ru bcug pa red/ de 41
