ma thag tu phru gu des a ma'i nu mar so brgyab ste a ma'i nu ma bkog pa red/ bud med kyi nu ma bkog na shi gi red pa/ khos nga la de ring srog thog gi nyes pa 'phog yas 'di a ma khyed rang gis bzos song / khyed rang gis sngon chad nga la spyong brdar yag po zhig sprad yod na/ nga la nyi ma de ring gi chags sgo 'di yong gi ma red/ khyed rang gis nga la byams po byas/ lto yag pa thams cad ster /gyon pa yag pa thams cad g.yogs/ dngul sprad/ ga re byed kyi yin zer na'ang byed du bcug pa ra brten mtha' ma 'dir nga khrims la thug nas srog thog gi nyes pa byung ba red ces bshad yod/ song tsang pha ma phos phru gu la zhe drag gces spras che drags na skyon ma gtogs yod pa ma red/ pha ma tsho phru gur don dam pa'i gces kyi yod na ya rabs kyi spyod pa dang / yon tan slob sgrong sprod dgos pa dang / phru gu ltos kyang yon tan slob sbyong byed dgos pa red/ yon tan slob sbyong byed skabs nga rang tsho tshang ma bod rigs yin pas sngon la bod yig yag po spyong dgos/ deng skabs bod rigs tsho la bod yig sgrong dgos zhes ngas skad 'dzer 'dzer gang sar phyin nas bshad yod/ tog tsam yag tu phyin 'dug kyang da dung yang yag po rang mi 'dug 'dod pa tshims pa zhig mi 'dug der brten tshang mas bod yig 'di yag po sbyangs pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog nas rgya yig dang rgya skad yag po sbyong dgos/ de nas rang la yon tan dang 'jon thang yod na phyi rgyal gyi skad yig slob dgos pa red/ de'i thog nga tsho bod rang gi snyan ngag dang /sum rtags/ bod kyi lo rgyus la sogs pa bod rang gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag tshang ma la slob sbyong yag po byed dgos pa dang chabs cig tshan rig gi yon tan spyi dang / bye brag dngos khams rig pa dang / rdzas 'gyur rig pa/ rtsis kyi rig pa zer ba de dag tshang ma sbyangs nas nga tsho'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid sngon thon gyi mi rigs nang tshud thub pa zhig byed dgos/ nga tsho da lta nang bzhin 'brog pa byas te g.yag 'ded yas dang / zhing pa byas te 'byu 'debs yas de 'dra tsam 42

zhig ma gtogs gzhan dag gang yang mgo ma chos mkhan de 'dra rang ma yin pa/ nga chos gang ltar tshan rig gi bya ba de dag kyang byed thub pa zhig yong ba gnang rogs/gnyis nas slob phrug tsho gnas tshad mtho ru phyin na nga rgyal byed pa dang / rang don gyi bsam blo sngon 'gog rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ thog mar zhing 'brog khul nas yong ba'i mi lha sa dang / mes rgyal nang sa la slob sbyong byas te thon mkhan de dag zhing 'brog khul la gtong dgos pa red/ khong tsho 'di khul grong khyer nang gi las byed byas nas grong khyer che sa nas chung sar 'gro thub kyi med la/grong khyer chung sa nas grong gseb la de bas 'gro thub kyi med/ ngas gong du zhus pa ltar so so'i pha ma dang gnyen tshan tshos thug par yong skabs de dag la gus zhabs mi byed pa de 'dra byed kyi yod pa red/ ngo tsha nas so so'i pha yul gyi mi dang pha mar yang sne len byed thub kyi med pa red/ de 'dra'i spyod ngan rtsa ba nas ma byed rogs / yon tan shes tshar ba'i rjes su nges par so so'i lung par sha zhen bya rgyu dang / lhag don du yang so so'i lung pa gang btsog sa dang / chags sgo yod sa de dag la phyin nas lung pa yar rgyas 'gro thub pa byas na/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis khyed rang tsho'i ched du 'gro song btang ba de dag la don 'bras byung bar ma zad / so so'i pha ma red tshang mas phru gu slob grwar btang ste yon tan sbyangs pa de dag don dang ldan pa byung ba red/ 'di tshang ma'i thugs la 'jags pa gnang rogs gnang / gang ltar na gzhon zer ba 'di snga dro'i nyi ma lta bu chags yod pas go skabs 'di ha cang rtsa ba chen po dang rin thang ldan pa yin/ de 'dra song tsang khyed rang tsho slob sbyong yag po dang / las ka hur thag byed dgos/ nga rang mtshams re yong skabs mang po zhus yod/ nga pho bod mi rigs rang nyid la sgyu rtsal dang / rig rtsal/ gzhas zhabs bro de tsho phun sum zogs po yod/mi rigs kyi chas gos la sogs pa de tsho yang phun sum tshogs po yod pa 'di dag la dang dod byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ chas ya ma gzugs dang / gzhas dang de 43

tsho yang phyi rgyal gyi cha tshang bslabs 'dug zer yas med kyang / phyi rgyal gyi byed stangs 'ga' re yag po med/ de bzhin deng skabs brnyan 'phrin 'khor lo'i nang dzor po sdug chags de 'dra yod/ de tsho blta yas la rbad de nam langs nas mtshan mo'i gung la dngul mang po sprad/ bde 'jags kyi khrims la'ang zhed snang med pa de hrū khyon nas yag po mi 'dug ngas de dag zhu skabs nang khul nas la las bka' bkyon tog tsam tog tsam gnang gi 'dug bka' bkyon gnang min la ma ltos par nga ni de dag lab kyi yin da/ ngas bod spyi'i rtsa don gyi ched du ma bshad rang bshad red/ ngas kha sang 'dir ḍi si ko (deng dus phyi rgyal gyi zhabs bro )brgyab na yag po ma red lab pa yin yang / paṇa chen gyis khri'i sgang la ḍi si ko rgyag gi 'dug ces shod mkhan byung 'dug ngas khong tshor ḍi si ko rgyag rgyu yod pa ma red ces bshad pa 'di kho tshos khri'i sgang ḍi si ko rgyag gi 'dug ces brjod 'dug ngas bod spyi'i don du bshad pa yin/ nga tsho bod mi mang ḍi si ko brgyab nas nam mkhar 'phung thub kyi ma red/ nga tshos las ka hur thag 'bad thag byed pa dang /yon tan sbyangs te nga tsho sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral du tshud thub pa byed dgos pa yin/ḍi si ko sogs phyi rgyal gyi 'tsho ba'i nang gi dza re dzor re de tshor nga tshos yar blta bya rgyu bzhag nas dor dgos pa yin/ shes song ngam/khyed rang tsho bod mi rigs la zhen khog yod pa zhig dang / bod kyi bde skyid bsam mkhan zhig yin na sha 61) kha nas gtam snyan med zer ba ltar ngas zhus par gsan rogs gnang / da ga se kha rgyags pa bshad de bsdad na da ga red/ kun spyod bzang po dgos/ chos zer ba 'di gtso che shos rang rgyud ma rungs pa 'di 'dul dgros pa dang / spyod pa yag po byed dgos pa yin/ de 'dra song tsang ngas gong du bshad pa'i skad cha 'di dag 'jig rten ngos nas bshad na'ang 'dra/ chos kyi ngos nas bshad na'ang 'dra tshang mar rgyu mtshan yod pa yin/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs 44

su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes sdig pa'i las spangs/dge ba'i las bsgrubs/ rang gi sems rgyud ma rungs pa 'dul/ de dag ni sangs kyi bstan pa yin pas 'gro lugs sdod lugs tshang ma yag po zhig byas na chos dngos su ma byas na'ang zhor la dkar po dge ba'i las mang po zhig gsog pa dang /rang gi byed stangs dang sdod stangs yag po zhig ma byas na zhor la sdig pa'i las tshabs chen po mang po gsog gi red/ de dag tshang mas mkhyen pa gnang nas nga tsho'i spyi tshogs 'di nyid ya rabs kyi spyod par 'jug thub pa zhig gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin / dge 'dun rnam pa tsho da lta tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid byus 'og dgon pa tsho chos sgo phye ste tshogs tshogs rgyu byung ba dang / slob gnyer yang rim bzhin tshugs te ha cang yag po chags yod/ yin na'ang nga tsho'i las ka 'di 'go rtsom tsam las da lta mjug skyel rgyu bsdad yod/ de 'dra song tsang ngas khyed rang tshor zhu yas la lhag par khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba yin pas so thar gyi sdom pa khas blangs pa rnams tshul bzhin du srung / grwa pa mo grwa pa'i bzo 'dra po dang /dgon pa tsho dgon pa'i bzo 'dra po dgos pa ma gtogs skya min ser min/ dgon min khyim min de 'dra ma gnang rogs gnang / grwa pa tshos thos bsam sgom gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum yag po gnang dgos/ cos 'chad mkhan chos yag po 'chad/ rtsod mkhan tshos kyang gzhung chen bka' pod lngar rtsod pa yag po gnang / de ring 'dir lha rams pa drug tsam yod/ da lo rtsa ba'i cha nas tshad mtho po gtso bor bzung yod/ phyin chad kyang lha rams pa zer ba 'di grangs 'bor lon rung ma yon rung dngos gnas tshad dang ldan pa ma gtogs tshad ma longs pa 'jug rgyu min/ lha rams pa btang tshar ba'i rjes la spyi tshogs thog shes yon can la sogs pa'i thob thang sprod rgyu yin/ der brten tshang mas slob gnyer yag po gnang rogs/ 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa/ rtsom pa bcas gnang 45

dgos pa yin/ sngon chad nga tsho'i gdan sa'i dge bshes mor yi ge yag po ma sbyang rgyu'i goms gshis med/ de ni yag po mi 'dug rang cag gi rje yab sras gsum tshang ma rtsod pa la mkhas pa dang / 'chad pa la mkhas pa yin par ma zad/rtsom pa la yang mkhas pa yin/ rang cag la rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum pod bcu phrag mang po yod pa 'di dag ni ra nga re'i bsod nams kyi rten yin pa tsam du ma zad/ rang cag gi blang dor lam ston dang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i gzhung zhig kyang yin/ gal te rje yab sras gsum gyis phyag bris gnang mkhyen gyi med pa dang / rtsom yang gnang mkhyen gyi med na nga tshor deng skabs yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum 'di dag blta yas yong gi ma red/ dpe de bzhin du rtsom ma shes na de la lag rjes yod pa ma red/ der brten phyi rabs kyi gdul byar phan pa'i ched du nges par du rtsom gnang dgos pa red/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum zer ba 'di kha bral thabs med pa zhig red/ chos 'chad thub pa dang / rtsod thub pa byung na/ gdul bya rab tu byung ba rnams smos med pa dang / 'jig rten khyim pa tsho la'ang blang dor gyi gnad mang po bstan nas bstan pa 'phel ba la sogs par phan thogs chen po yod/ rtsod pa shes na gzhung chen gyi gnad rnams gting zab po shes thub pa dang / lung 'dren pa sogs pha rol gyi khas mi len pa yong dus rtsod pa brgyab ste de dag tshar gcod thub pa yong ba dang / rtsom brgyab thub na rang gi chos kyi yon tan rnams gzhung la bkod de phyi rabs kyi mi tshor rjesasu slob sbyong byed yas dang / bstan pa 'dzin yas la ha cang phan thogs chen po yod/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gnang yas la tshang mas 'bad brtson gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/de dang chabs cig cho ga phyag len dang / dgon pa'i 'don rta dbyangs de dag tshang ma yag po yong ba gnang rogs/ de ltar ma byung na sags shig phogs na'ang mi kha shas kyis gdong 'dir 'o 'o 'o zer skad ba rgyab/ rgyab la bzhugs mkhan tshang ma zhal btsums nas bzhugs na mi tshos bltas na'ang yag po med/ gdong gral 46

la sdod mkhan mi kha shas kyis skad chen po brgyab ste 'o 'o 'o zer nas skyor gyi yod pa red de/ rgyab tu sdod mkhan tshar gsung yas med par spyan chen po zhig gzigs nas bzhugs na yag po med/ der brten chos spyod de pho yag po mkhyen pa gnang /chos ra'i nang rtsod thub pa dang / tshogs la 'don pa gsung thub pa/ sngags kyi dbang lung dang / rjes gnang / mdo sngags gang la yang lung khrid dang / bshad khrid gnang ste/ de dag gi brgyud pa spel nas gong mthor 'gro thub pa gnang rgyu ha cang gal chen po red/ skad cha 'di ri bo dge lugs pa tsam du ma zad/ sa skya dang / rnying ma/ bka' brgyud pa sogs chos brgyud gang dang gang yin na'ang nga'i skad cha 'di gcig pa yin/ nga rang la mtshon na rang nyid dge lugs pa yin/ yin na'ang ngas grub mtha' tshang mar ris med zhu gi yod/ ris med zhu dgos don ni chos phyogs nas bltas na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa red/ khag so so la bzhed srol tog tsam mi 'dra ba yod pa ma gtogs tshang ma gcig pa red/ srid byus kyi thog nas bshad na tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid byus phyogs lhung med pa dang / 'dra mnyam zhig tshang mar lag len bstar dgos pa yin/ dgon pa gang dang gang yin na'ang yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba'i thad ngas tshang mar sems 'khur zhu gi yod/ yin na'ang ngas gsal po byas te zhu dgos don la/ dgon pa tshor cos lugs tshang ma bsres te byed dgos zhus pa rtsa ba nas min/ dge lugs pa yin na dge lugs pa gtsang gtsang dang / bka' brgyud pa yin na bka' brgyud pa gtsang gtsang /rnying ma yin na rnying ma gtsang gtsang / sa skya pa yin na sa skya gtsang gtsang bcas gnang rogs/ tshang ma bsres te grub mtha' tshang ma yar rub rub bzos pa de 'dra dgos zhu gi med/ da lta bod kyi dge lugs gdan sa che ba bzhi dang / de min chos lugs gzhan dag gi gdan sa tsho bskyar gso yar rgyas yong yas dang / de dag gi chos 'chad nyan yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro yas la tang gis thugs 'khur ha 47

cang chen po gnang gi yod la/ nga rang yin na'ang rang gi nus pas lcogs tshod la dpags pa'i zhabs 'degs zhu gi yod/ chos lugs gzhan dag mos kho rang dge lugs pa song tsang dge lugs par yag pa byas/ nga tsho la ga re byas yong ngam snyam pa de 'dra'i thugs dogs rtsa ba nas gnang mi dgos/ ngas gang yong ci yong zhus yong / khyed rang tshos kyang yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro yas la 'bad brtson gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ dgon par bzhugs mkhan grwa pa chos 'dul khrims gtsang ma dang / sgrig lam kun spyod yag po gnang rgyu 'di ha cang gal chen po yin/chab srid thog nas bshad na chos dad rang mos red/ chos dad rang mos red kyang / chos dad rang mos ni rang nyid grwa pa byed dang mi byed dang / chos la dad pa byed dang mi byed kyi rang dbang de red/ chos la dad pa byas na'ang rang dbang red la/ chos la dad pa ma byas na'ang rang dbang red/ yin na'ang dgon pa'i nang bsdad de chos byed mi sna'i ming 'khur nas chos rang byed dgos pa ma gtogs nga rang dbang yin/ de ring nga tshogs la phyin nas 'gyed blangs/ sang nyin mar thon nas chang 'thung 'khyams nas sdod chog pa yin dgongs na 'grigs kyi ma red/ dpe cha bzhag na slob grwa zhig la mtshon na'ang der sgrig khrims shig yod / slob grwar 'dzul yas kho rang gi rang dbang yin kyang / slob grwar 'dzul phyin de'i sgrig khrin/sa 'khur dgos kyi red/ bzo pa zhig yin na'ang de rang red/ tang shog gcig yin na'ang de rang red / tshogs pa gcig yin na'ang de rang red/ nga tsho dgon pa de ltar min pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yod/ de tsho tshang ma'i thugs la 'jags pa gnang rogs/ da res lha sa'i smon lam ha cang gi yag po 'tshogs pa red/ yin na'ang 'di'i nang phebs mkhan mang che bas sngon ma'i tshogs kyi 'gro stangs de tsho mkhyen gyi med pa 'dra/ da res tshogs chen zhal ngo la'ang dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha de tsam med pa byas/ der brten kha shas kyis tshogs gral nas bzhengs te phebs mkhan 'dug yang nyi mas 'tshig 48

tsang nyi mar ma bzhugs par bsil sar bzhugs par phebs mkhan de 'dra yang byung 'dug gnas tshul de tsho ni ma 'grigs pa red ces kha sang kha par btang ste de 'dra byas na 'grigs kyi ma red bshad yod/ phyin chad nas bzung dgon pa tshang mar sgrig lam kun spyod yod pa zhig byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ mgo med mjug med byas na 'grigs kyi ma red/ dgon par grwa pa gnang tshar ba'i rjes su sangs rgyas kyi 'dul ba nas ji ltar gsungs pa dang / dgon pa rang rang gi lam lugs la brtsi dgos/ nga tshos med pa bzo yas ni bka' bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dmigs bsal dbang cha dang / bshu gzhog gi lam lugs de yin/ yin na'ang chos khri/ mas de dag yod dgos pa red/ chos khrims med na dgon pa gang 'dra zhig yong gi red dam/ dgon pa'i nang gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dmigs bsal dbang cha dang bshu gzhog lam lugs zer ba de dag dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs med pa bzos pa red/ de ni 'grigs pa dang yang dag pa zhig red/ nga chos bskyar gso byas na 'grigs kyi ma re da/ yin na'ang dgon pa'i nang sgrig lam kun spyod yod dgos pa dang / de yang yag po yong ba zhig byed dgos pa ma gtogs/ mgo med mjug med byas na ga nas yong gi red dam/ dad ldan skye bos gang 'dra byas te bsod nams gsog thub kyi re da dam/ 7rgyal ba shakya thub pas khyim pa sun 'byin gyi bya ba ma byed gsungs yod/ so so rang gi byed stangs yag po ma byung na khyi ma pa sun 'byin gyi bya ba yong rgyu thag gis cod/der brten tshang ma hur thag yag po gnang rogs/ tang gi srid byus 'gyur ba med pa red/ 'gyur na'ang yag tu yag tu 'phro ba'i 'gyur ba ma gtogs sdug pa'i 'gyur ba 'gro gi ma red/ 1982 lor nga rang 'di phyogs yong dus 'gyur gyi ma red ces zhus pa yin/ da cha yag tu phyin yod/ byas tsang tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i rgyas 'dzoms tshogs 'du thengs gsum pa nas bzung rang re'i sngon chad kyi g.yon thal nor 'khrul la yo bsrang byas nas gang ci'i thad yar rgyas gong 49

'phel phyin yod/ chos lugs kyi srid byus red/ mi rigs kyi srid byus red/'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus red/ shes yon can gyi srid byus red/ de dag tshang ma ha cang yag tu phyin nas don 'khyol byed kyi yod pa tshang mas mkhyen gsal red/ de 'dra song tsang tshang ma thugs ha cang bde pos phyogs gcig nas gung khran ta nga la dga' zhen dang / mes rgyal la dga' zhen/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la dga' zhen/ rang gi nus pa'i khyab khongs nang du bod ljongs gsar pa'i 'dzugs skrun dang / mes rgyal deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun gyi ched legs skyes 'bul thub pa dgos/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas rang gi khur du babs pa'i chos phyogs kyi bya ba'i thad/chos phyogs kyi bya ba zer ba 'di ni lung rtogs kyi bstan pa yin pas/ sngon la chos 'chad nyan byas te lung gi bstan pa rgyas pa dang / de dag tshang ma rang gis nyams len byas nas rtogs pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa/ rang cag rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gtso che ba ni lung rtogs kyi bstan pa yin pa red/ deng skabs mi 'gang zhig gi blta tshul la dgon pa de tsho yar bzos/ sku gsung thugs rten khra chem chem mang po zhig byas/ mchod pa rgyas po zhig byung na bstan pa rgyas song snyam gyi yod/ dngos 'brel byas na de 'dra min/ gtso che shos lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rgyas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis gsung ba'i chos de hrū shes mkhan mang po yod pa de dag rang rgyud la 'chad nyan rgyas po/ dge sdig spang blang de tsho tshul bzhin du nyams su len pa/ de dag gis rtogs pa rgyud la skyes nas sa lam thob pa 1 lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rgyas pa 'di gtso bo yin/ tshang mas nyams len yag po gnang tshe nga tsho la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos gting zab la rgya che ba rlabs chen gzhan la smon mi dgos pa zhig yod/ yin na'ang tshang mas slob sbyong yag po ma gnang na shes mi thub pas chos gang 'dra byas te byed dgos pa red dam/ de rtsis tshang mar yag po gnang rogs zhu yas yin/ de nas dge 'dun rnams thugs 50

mthun po gnang dgos pa red/ dgon pa so so'i nang yod pa'i dge 'dun sto dang /de yang gtso bo dgon pa'i nang gi thugs 'gan bzhes mkhan bla ma sprul sku dang /dge spyi chen mo ba sa tshang ma thugs mthun po gnang dgos/ yang mi zer mkhan 'di yon tan chen po byung na nga'i 'di yin/ kho'i de ma red zer mkhan 'grigs ma 'grigs de 'dra yong zhing / de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma gnang rogs gnang / dgon pa khag dang gdan sa kha ga tshang ma 'cham po yag po gnang dgos pa las/ nga yin khyod ma red/ nga drag khyod zhan zer ba 'di 'dra rtsa ba nas gnang rgyu med/dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun po gnang na ma gtogs/ yang mi kha shas kyis de'i bar la dkrug shing brgyab/ de 'dra byas na dge 'dun gyi dbyen zer ba ni las tshabs po che yin pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs yod/ nga tshos gang byas rung ma byas rung sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa la cha bzhag dgos/ chos lugs nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhig yin phyin 7rgyal ba shākya thub pas gsungs pa de khas ma len na kho mar phud bzhag na ma gtogs gzhan 'gro sa med/ ri bo da ge lugs pa yin na rje rin po ches ji ltar gsungs pa de rang la cha bzhag dgos pa red/ rje rin po che la yang ma red mdog mdog byas na ga re byed dgos red dam/ der brten tshang mar yag po gnang rogs zhes ngas re ba zhu yas 'di yin/ ngas zhus pa 'di dag thams cad thugs la 'jags pa gnang ste chos dang 'jig rten gang gi thad la yin na'ang rang re'i gangs ljongs 'di nyid kyi bstan pa slar yang yar rgyas kyis 'tsho grub pa dang / sems can la bde skyid yong ba/ char chu dus su 'bebs pa/rtsi shing lo tog rgyas pa/ bod mi rigs 'di nyid kyang phyogs gang ci'i thad yar rgyas gong 'phel gyis sngon thon gyi mi rigs kyi tshogs gral du 'dzul thub pa/ mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig bsgril gyi sgo nas mes rgyal deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun la nus pa 'don thub pa/ bod mi rigs nang khyal yin na'ang tshang ma ha cang 'grigs po dang mthun po yong ba/ dge 'dun 51

rnams kyang thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba/ dgon pa tsho yang yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba/ da lo las lo rjes ma'i lha sa'i smon lam de yag pa yong ba de las de'i rjes lo yag pa yong ba/ lo re nas lo re bzhin yar rgyas gong 'phel phyin nas chos dang 'jig rten gang thad bod ljongs 'di nyid yar ngo'i zla ba dang dbyar gyi mas ltar gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i ched du tshang mas bla ma dkon mchog la thugs smon skyabs 'jug zhu dgos la/ rang rang gis kyang bya ba de'i nang dngos su 'bad brtson byed dgos pa las/ kha rgyags pa bshad de don dngos la thug dus rang don gtso bor byas nas spyi don g.yugs pa dang / kha nas bshad dus spyi don mang po bshad khul byas/ don dngos la thug dus khyon nas sgrub yas med pa'i byed stangs ngan pa de 'dra rtsa ba nas ma gnang rogs/ tshang mas hur thag 'bad thag gnang rogs/ ngas gong du zhus pa bzhin bod du rgya rigs la sogs pa'i mi rigs gzhan dag kyang mang po yod pa de dag dang yang 'grigs po mthun po zhig dang / nga rang tsho nang khul yang 'grigs po dang mthun po gang ci'i thad lung pa'i nang bkra shis pa dang lugs legs pa yong ba gnang rogs/ de ring ni cho 'phrul zla ba sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pas dus 'di 'dra la tshang mas kha ton dge sbyor byed pa dang / phyag dang bawor ba byed pa de tsho 'bum 'gyur du 'gro ba 7rgyal ba rang gi byin gyis brlabs yod pa yin pas/ da res smon lam la phyag 'gyed 'bul mkhan dang / gtong sgo gtong mkhan/ mchod pa 'bul mkhan/phyag dang bawor ba la 'gro mkhan bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mang po 'dug pa de dag la ngas rjes su yi rang gi dga' ba bsgom rgyu dang / de dag gi dge ba tshang ma rdzogs byang du bsngo chog pa zhu rgyu dang / khyed rang tshos 'di 'dra gnang bas bsod nams kyi phogs shin tu chen po rdzogs pa ha cang gi skal pa bzang po yin pas legs so / dgyes so zhes bstod bsngags zhu rgyu yin pas de don thugs la 'jags pa ci nas kyang bka' drin skyong bar zhu/ zhes bka' stsal ba bcas so// // 52

rgyal yongs mi mang 'brus phogs skabs drug pa'i tshogs chen thengs lnga par zhugs mkhan bod kyi 'thus mi'i tshogs chung gros bsdur thog gnang ba'i gsung bshad/(phyi lo 1987 zla 3 tshes 28 nyin )dang po/ mi rigs kyi las don thog lhag pa'i gnad don rnams nges par sel dgos pa'i spor/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid slon kra'o tse dbyang gi srid gzhung las don snyan zhu dang / de min gyi 'brel yod snyan zhu nyan rjes mi rnams la dga' spro'i mor ba byung yod cing / ngos nas yongs su rgyab skyor zhu rgyu yin/rang rgyal gyi gnas bab khyon yongs nas bshad na yag po yod pa red/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs rjes yang dag pa'i srid byus dang / lam phyogs/ byed phyogs bcas gtan 'khel byas pa 'di ni rang rgyal gyi gnas stangs dang mthun pa zhig dang / des las don khug gong du spel thub rgyur ma zad/ grub 'bras kyang chen po thob nges yin pa las don snyan zhu'i nang 'khod 'dug rang rgyal 'di spyi tshos/sa ring lugs kyi deng rabs gsung bshad 'di ni sgra phab gzhir bzung rgya yig thog legs bsgrigs byas te rgya dpon tsho'i dpyad gzhir 'don spel byas pa dang / kun gzigs rin po ches bskyar gzigs gnang med pa red/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud gzhung las khang nas 1987 zla 4 tshes 39 nyin nang khul 'grems spel byas pa'i gsang ba'i yig cha zhig red/ (rgya yig nas bod bsgyur zhus pa yin/) 53

can la 'dzugs skrun byed ched dpal yon ha cang che ba dang / dmangs gtso tshad ldan gyi stobs chen rgyal khab cig la 'gyur rgyu yin par ngos nas yid ches brtan po bye da kyi yod/ phyogs mtshungs las don snyan zhu'i nang nang don mang po zhig yod pa dang / gnad don thag gcod bya rgyur dge mtshan ldan pa'i thabs shes dang bkod sgrig rab dang rim pa byas yod pa de tsho yang dag pa yin zhing / mi rigs kyi gnad don skor yang thung ngu zhig 'khod yod pa de dag yang dag pa red /rang rgyal ni mi rigs mang po yod pa'i rgyal khab cig yin zhing / rgya rigs phud pa'i da dung mi rigs lnga bcu nga lnga yod pa rnams grangs nyung mi rigs yin/sngon ma dang lhag par rig gnas gsar brje'i rjes g.yon gyi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen gyis mi rigs kyi las don thog gnad don mang po zhig lhags yod pa red/ dper na nye char mi mang rtsom rig dus deb thog ma rung khog bcug gis nga tso bod rigs mi mang kyi gzugs brnyan la dmang 'bebs byed pa'i rtsom yig cig bton yod pa red/dang thog nas yod pa'i pa sangs dang kho mo'i spun mched ces pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi rtsom yig der na ning nga tso 'thus mi phyogs pas bsam 'char mang po bton pa yin/ da dung u yon krang gzhon pa nga phod gdan zhu byas nas bsam 'char de dag 'brel yod sde khag so sor nges 'bul gnang dgos zhes zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang thag gcod yag po byas med pas ma tshad/ de las ldog te rgyal yongs kyi phul byung gzugs brnyan 'khrab gzhung khongs bya dga' ang dang po sprad yod pa dang /da dung snying rje med pa'i byams pa zhes pa'i slog brnyan sogs la yang bya dga' sprad yod pa red/ gzhan gyi mi rigs la'ang de lta bu'i gnad don mang po yod par ma zad/ rtsom yig khag kyang thon yod pa dang / tshags par dang dus deb sogs thog bkod yod pa red/ de min na ning phyi zla 11 nang 'brel yod bca' khrims bcu'i yig cha slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i gsal bsgrags byas pa de'i nang mi rigs rang skyong slong gyi khrims lugs tshud med pa red/ de lta bu'i gal 54

gnad che rtsa ba'i bca' khrims khongs su tshud med pa'i gnad don skor la gsal bshad bya rgyu gang 'dra yod dam zhes kha sngon thengs nyi shu pa'i rgyun las u yon gyi tshogs 'du 'i skabs nga zos khrims 'dzin las khungs la bsam 'char bton pa yin/mjug tu de ga 'dra byas yod dam zhe na/ mi rigs sa khul la mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims slob spyong byed dgos zhes par 'gyur ba btang yod/ de 'phral ngos nas de dag mi 'grigs pa'i slor bshad yod/ rang skyong gi bca' khrims slob sbyong dang lag len bstar rgyu ni nga cho grangs nyung mi rigs kho na'i gnas tshul zhig min par gtso bo rgya rigs dang / rgyal khab kyi las byed pas nges par slob spyong dang lag bstar byed dgos pa'i gnad don zhig red/ de ni mi zhig gi gyon chas mi gyon pa min yang sbyin bdag gis kho par gyon chas ma g.yogs pa dang gcig pa yin/ nga tshor dbang cha yod de bed spyod ma byas pa min par/ mi chos dbang cha sprod kyi med pa red/ de 'dra song tsang gzhi nas bsgyur bcos btang ste mi mang nyin re'i tshags par thog bkod yod pa red/ de dang de rigs mi rigs kyi gnad don slor la sems 'khur ma byas pa'i gnas tshul mang po yod/dir brten zengs nyi shu pa'i rgyun las u yon gyi tshogs 'du'i skabs sags chung gam du 'tshogs pa de'i thog ngos kyis bsam 'char bton pa yin/ de'i nang deng sang the bon dang hong kong gi gnad don sgor la sems khur chen po byed pa 'di ma 'grigs pa ma red/ yin na'ang nga sngo phar phud nas do 'khur ma byas pa 'dir nga tsho yang dga' gi mi 'dug dang thog bod bcings 'grol gtong skabs ma'o kru zhi dang / kre'u tsung li sogs 'go khrid slo mthun gyis rang mos thog skad cha dris nas / mi rigs kyi gnad don thag gcod byed kyi yod/ da cha mi rigs kyi gnad don skor 'di gang 'dra zhig gi thog gnas yod med gsal po shes kyi mi 'dugagand don 'di skor tshang mas gsal po shes pa byed dgos pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/nga tsho grangs nyung mi rigs mi 'bor gyi cha nas rgyal yongs kyi brgya cha 6 yas 55

mas las zin med kyang / nga hrū gnas sdod byed sa'i sa khyon gyis rgyal yongs kyi brgya cha 64 zin yod par brten sa khul de tshor brtan nying yag po zhig ma byung tshe / de ni rang re'i rgyal yongs kyi gnad don chags yod/ rgyal khab 'char gzhi u yon lhan khang gi snyan zhu'i nang mu mthud dbul zhing phongs pa'i sa khul khag la rogs skyor byas te dbul bcos phyug sgyur gyi lam la bskyod dgos pa'i las don sgor mang po zhig 'khod 'dug 'on kyang grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul la gang 'dra byed dgos min skor tha na tshig gcig kyang 'khod mi 'dug ngos nas rgyun las u yon gyi phyogs 'du'i thog gnas tshul de'i skor brjod myong / sngon la khyed tsho phyug po byas na ma 'grigs pa med/ nga chos gyon chas ral pa gyon nas gang sar slong mo byed par phyin chog 'di ni khyed rnams kyi gzi brjid red/ nga rang dpal 'byor gyi las don thad byang chub pa zhig min rung rtsa ba nas ma shes pa 'di 'dra min/ bod du 'grims 'grul khongs gtogs la phan pa'i thon khungs dang /nus pa'i 'byung khungs sngog 'don gyis bzo grwa 'ga' shas btsugs pa yin na lo gnyis gsum nang ma dngul tshur ltog thub rgyu red/ nga chos deng skabs rgyal khab la nor srid thad dka' ngal yod pa gsal po shes kyi yod/ gal che sa'i rigs la 'gan len byed pa sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og nus shugs la gzhigs nas grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul gong 'phel gtong thabs la 'os 'tshams kyi bsam shes byed dgos / ma rtsa gtong ba'i nus pa de tsam chen po med na/ srid byus dang de min gyi thabs lam lag len bstar na ma 'grigs pa gang yang med/ ngas gong du zhus pa ltar g.yon gyi srid byus de mi rigs sa khul du mi lo nyi shu lhag tsam ring lag bstar byas par brten bod du da dung yang shugs rkyen chen po yod pa red/ der brten mi mang gis da lta'i srid byus yag po 'dug da dung mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs yong ba'i re ba byed kyi yod ces brjod kyi yod pa red/na ning nga rang khams khul du lta zhib la bskyod skabs de khul du nags tshal gang 56

byung du gcod pa'i gnas tshul ha cang tshabs chen po yod pa mthong byung / nags ri nas shing gang byung du bcad stabs ri lug 'dug da dung mi rigs sa khul nang gi yong 'bab mtho ba'i dngos po'i rigs rnams yar bsdus yod pa dper na/ yun nan tag lo khron du tha ma kha'i bzo grwa zhig btsugs yod pa red/ der yong 'bab shog sgor stong phrag kha shas yod 'dug kyang / da cha mu mthud gnyer skyong byed chog gi mi 'dug rgyu mtshan ni lag rtsal mi ldang ba dang / spus ka yag po med pa / de bzhin rgyu cha legs gras bed spyod byas kyang tha ma kha legs gras thon skyed byed thub kyi med pa de red/ yin na'ang hrang had sogs su lag rtsal leg sa pa'i bzo grwar rgyu cha yag po med rung thon skyed gong 'phel byung ste rgyal khab la'ang 'bul gyi yod pa red/ mi rigs sa khul du de rigs la dmigs bsal gyi do snang byed dgos nges 'dug yong 'bab med par ma rtsa ha lam stongs nyer slebs skabs gzhi nas 'dri rtsad byed kyi yod pa de ni do 'khur byas pa zhig yin nam/ yang na mi rnams la khur po lci po mu mthud 'khur du 'jug pa'i che da du yin/ 1980 lor slo mthun hu'u ya'o pang sogs bod kyi las don la rtog zhib gnang bar phebs nas bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs te phan thogs med pa'i rgya rigs las bzo pa rnams bod nas phyir slog byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang yod/ gtan 'bebs de ni yang dag pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byas yod la/ bod du phan thogs yod pa'i mi btang na da lta dang / ma 'ongs pa tshang mar dgos pa yin/ phan thogs med pa'i mi bod du bzhag nas ga re byed dgos red dam/ der brten rgya rigs las byed pa tshang ma phan thogs yod pa'i mi kho na yin gyi ma red/ rgya rigs nang nus shugs dang shes yon yod pa'i mi yod la/ shes yon med pa'i mi yang yod/bod nang gi las byed pa gcig gi gron dngul rgyal nang gi rim pa gcig pa'i las byed pa mi bzhi'i gron dngul dang gcig mtshungs red/ bod nang don med kyi 'gro gron de 'dra btang ste gso skyong byed dgos don ga re yod dam/ nga chos nan 57

tan gyi sgo nas dbye zhib byas te dpal 'byor de tsam btang nas nus ga re thon 'dug dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ sngon ma bod la ba skyod rgyu rang mos kyi ming tho 'god kyi yod pas rgya rigs las byed tshang ma phan thogs yod pa kho na yin gyi ma red/ rgya rigs nang shes yon yod pa yod la/ shes yon med pa'i rigs kyang yod/ bod nang mi phan thogs yod pa gtong dgos/ phan thogs med pa'i rigs mang po bod du bzhag par brten bod kyi las don khag tshang mar shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod/de snga stong phrag re gnyis nas de rjes snga rjes rim par slebs te da cha bod nang rgya rigs de snga las ldab mang pos mang du phyin yod/ de snga dka' las brgyab ste bod bskyod byed mkhan rgan rabs tsho 'gro yul med pa'i gnad don phud da dung dka' ngal gyi gnad don sna tshogs shig lhags yod pa de dag kyang rim pas sel thabs mi byed ka che/da chags yod/ deng skabs bod nang gsar du 'gyor ba'i rigs kyi go gnas dang las don sogs la ma ltos par de dang mnyam du nang tshang bu phrug rgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa yong gi yod pa red/ de dag ni de snga a ris dmag bskul byed skabs kyi gnas tshul dang 'dra po 'dug dper na mi des phri ti nam nang lo kha shas ring dmag brgyab na kho la gla dngul ga tshad sprod rgyu yin dang / kho dmag sar shi na nga'i nang mir gun gsab ga tshad sprod rgyu yin zhes brjod kyi yod pa red/de dra'i rigs ga 'dra byas te yong gi red dam/ khungs lung med pa rang red/bod mi rigs ni bod kyi bdag po red/ bod mi mang gis yag po red bsams na de yag po yin dgos pa red/ de 'dra ma byas na ma 'grigs pa yos yin/ da lta mi mang pos yi ge btang ba'i nang go thos su wu cing twa 'phos len byed kyi yod tshod red/ de skor nga la krung dbyang thad gtogs las khungs khag la drang bden gyi zhu bskul byed dgos zhes gsal 'dug khong ni bod nang hru'u ci btang ba'i khongs nas legs shos shig red/ gnad don gzhan pa'i sgor zhu ma dgos par gtso bo mi rigs srid byus yo rol bya7 rgyu dang / chos lugs dang / 'thab

phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don bcas thad shugs gang yod bton te grub 'bras kyang chen po thob yod/ da cha las don gyi gtso bo'i kha phyogs dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu 'di yin stabs nga tshos mig rgyang ring tsam gyi bsam slo gtong dgos/mi rigs kyi las don la do snang rtsa ba nas ma byas na de ni yag po gtan nas ma red/mi rigs kyi las don dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi las don gnyis ni gal che chung gcig pa red/ slob grwa kha shas btsugs yod kyang slob gso'i las don gyi spus tshad shin tu zhan po red/ da dung rgya nag nang khul gyi zhing chen khag 1 6nang bod kyi slob sbyong 'dzin grwa btsugs yod/ krung dbyang nas dgongs bzhes de 'dra gnang ba ni bod mi mang la thugs 'khur gnang ba mtshon pa zhig yin rung /de'i nang da dung gnad don mang po zhig lhags yod/ gcig nas slob phrug de dag bod nas 'dems sgrug byas te btang ba zhig yin zhing / des mtho 'bring slob grwa khag gi slob phrug yong khungs thog dka' ngal 'phrad pa dang / bod nas de tsho'i ched du slob yon gron dngul gang tsam gtong dgos ba des bod nang gi slob gso'i ma dngul thog dka' ngal 'phrad yod/ gnyis nas slob phrug de dag mang che ba slob grwa chung ba'i slob phrug yin zhing / bsam blo'i nang bag chags yod med skor shod mi thub kyang lo na chung ngu'i dus nas pha ma gnyis dang kha bral ba dang /lung pa dang yang kha bral bar brten/ rim pas so so'i lung pa dang mi rigs pha ma bcas dang brtse ba rgyang du 'gro ba dang / khong tsho rang gi pha yul dang pha ma gnyis bcas dang sa thag ring por gnas stabs slob sbyong byed dgos pa de ma shes par slob sbyong byed mi dgos pa'i rigs mang po zhig shes kyi yod pa red/ nga rang yun nan sa khul du 'gro skabs gnas tshul de rigs kha shas mthong byung / der bod kyi skad yig slob tshan yod rung dngos 'bre la slob sbyong yag po shes rgyu ha cang khag po red 'dug khyim tshang gi mi mang po'i bsam par slob 'bring thon mtshams 3khyim du bslong nas las ka zhig btsal bsam pa de red/ bsam tshul de nas nang 59

mi tsho'i bsam slo phugs rgyang ring po med pa sogs shes nges yin /na ning ngas khams khul la yang bshad myong / rgya rigs kyi gsog pa mkhregs po yod la/ 'phur bskyod kyi nus rtsal yang chen po yod/ khong tshos rgyal nang gi sa gnas khag la 'phur thub pas ma tshad/ rgya gar rgya mtsho'i thog tu'ang 'phur thub kyi yod pa dang / de bzhin zhi bde rgya mas dang / rgyal khab gzhan la'ang slob sbyong byed par 'phur thub kyi yod pa red/ de tsho'i nang nas rgyal nang du log yong mkhan ni brgya cha 30 zin ma zin tsam las med/ nga tsho grangs nyung mi rigs rnams la 'phur rgyu'i go skabs shig byung na tshur rang 'jags 'phur rgyu'i nus rtsal ldan yod/ deng skabs bod dang rgyal khab nas khong tsho gso skyong byed pa'i ched du ma dngul mang po zhig btang / slob grwa thon rjes log ma yong na khong hrū gso skyong byas nas phan thogs ga re byung song ngam/ ngas rgyun las u yon gyi phyogs 'du'i thog zhu myong la/ ma 'ongs par mna' gan bzhag dgos pa 'dug/ mi rigs sa khongs kyi thob thang thog nas slob grwar bskyod mkhan tsho slob grwa thon rjes sa gnas su lo kha shas ring las ka byed par yong dgos/ gal srid ma yong na slob yon yongs rdzogs phyir slog byed dgos pa bzo dgos/ de bzhin ma 'ongs par bod ljongs kyi ming thog nas slob grwar bskyod mkhan tshor yang de ltar bye dgos/ slob grwa thon mtshams bar lo bcu grangs shig bod du slob sbyong byed dgos/ dper na yig tshad gtong rgyu'i slor la rgya nag nang khul gyi slob grwa'i yig tshad skar cha 480 yin zhing / rgya bod mi rigs gnyis bar skar grangs 250 yod pa red/ de yang bod rigs la skar cha 190 dang /rgya rigs la skar cha 250 red/ rgya rigs tshos de dag las sla po'i thog nas yon gyi yod pa dang / bod rigs slob phrug tshos nus shugs chen po bton na yang skar cha 190 yon ha cang khag po byed kyi yod/ de ni khong tshor skad yig thog nas dka' ngal 'phrad kyi yod pa red/ 'di skor nga rang sger la myong tshor 60

zab mo yod/ ngas rgya skad kyi thog nas skad cha bshad dgos na bshad thub kyi 'dug kyang ngas bshad pa'i skad cha'i nang mgo mjug log pa ma nga po zhig yong gi 'dug/'di ni nga'i skad kyi thog ma'i 'byung khungs rgya skad min pas byas pa red/ ga dus yin na'ang rgya rigs tso dang 'gran thub kyi mi 'dug/ da dung bod pa'i slob phrug tshor sa chu ma 'phrod pa dang / 'pho ba'i goms gshis mi mthun pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad pa da nga / slob phrug mang por bshal nad dang cham pa sogs kyi nad gzhi phog gi yod pa red/ gnas tshul de rigs nang mis shes ma thag gnam gyur bsdad nas dza drag ngang blta bar 'gro dgos kyi yod pa dang / slob phrug kha shas kyis da dung dgongs pa zhus nas nang mi thug 'phrad la 'gro gi yod/ de 'dra byas nas 'gro gron ha cang chen po 'gro gi yod pa red/ da dung na ning gnas tshul zhig byung yod pa ni hrang had dang sa gnas gzhan kha shas kyi slob gas bod kyi slob grwa'i ming 'khyer nas khang pa 'dzugs skrun ched rlangs 'khor gyi rigs nyos yod pa red / de skor rjes su shes rtogs byung ste brtag dpyad kyis thag gcod byas stabs da lta phran bu legs phyogs su 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin yod/ yin na'ang slob grwa de chos brtag dpyad byed mkhan 'byor nye'i mtshams tshogs 'du rim pa bslongs nas tshang ma skad cha bshad phyogs gcig mthun yong thabs dang gnas tshul phyir mi mngon pa'i thabs shes byas yod pa red/ byas tsang nga tshos nan tan gyi sgo nas bsam slo btang ste slad phyin de rigs dgos gal yod med dang / mu mthud don gnyer byed dgos min thad zhib bsdur nan po zhig byed dgos pa 'dug krung dbyang nas gang myur bod kyi dge rgan las don skor gyi tshogs 'du zhig bslong tshogs gnang 'char yod pa de'i thog bod kyi slob gso'i las don spor brtag dpyad zhib nan zhig gnang rtsis 'dug nga'i bsam par bod kyi slob gso 'di bod rang du 'dzugs gnyer byed dgos pa dang / nus shugs chen pos bod kyi slob grwa rim pa khag gi 'dzugs skrun thog shugs ston rgyag dgos/ mtho rim slob 'bring thon mtshams slob phrug 61

so so'i sbyangs 'bras dang / bod kyi dgos mkhor gzhigs nas slob grwa gang 'dra zhig la gtong dgos kyang de ltar bkod sgrig byed thub/ de dus bod kyi skad yig thog nas bshad kyang rmang gzhi zhig yod pa dang / bsam pa'i brtse dung gi gzhi rtsa yang tshugs yod stabs las don gyi nus shugs rang bzhin gong 'phel yong nges la brten de ltar byas na sngar las legs pa zhig mi yong ngam snyam gyi 'dugami rigs gcig gi ngos nas bshad na/ so so'i mi rigs kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang / bed spyod bya rgyu 'di ni shin tu gal gnad chen po chags yod/bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod bya rgyu'i thad krung dbyang nas sa gnas bar gyis bshad pa tsam las lag len bstar gyi yod pa ma red / krung dbyang nas deng rabs can bzhi'i byed phyogs lam ston gnang yod/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rang dbang can gyi byed phyogs la ngo rgol byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ nga rang sger gyi ngos la tshan rig gi shes bya gang yang med la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i slor da dung yang bcings 'grol yag po thob med/ nga'i bsam par nga tshos phyi rgyal la dpe bltas te slob sbyong byed dgos nges kyang / gtso bo khong tsho'i yar thon gyi lag rtsal dang / tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'dzin skyong byed stangs de tsho slob sbyong byed dgos/ 'tsho ba'i thad su yag pa yod kyang de yag pa rang red / de'i skor nga rang bsam klo btang ma myong / nyi hong gi mi'i 'tsho ba'i goms gshis rnyog dra tsha po yod kyang / khong tsho'i rig gnas slob gso'i bya gzhag dang / tshan rig dang lag rtsal gnyis shin tu yag po yod 'dug 'dzam gling thog dpe deb gsar pa zhig thon tshe myur shos la nyi ma bcu dang / 'gor shos la zla ba gcig nang bsgyur nas khong chos blta thub kyi yod pa red/ nga tsho'i bod nang yig sgyur las rig sa shin tu skyo po yod/ shing cang dang / nang sog gnyis dang yang bsdur thabs med pa'i skyo po yod pa red/ phyi gling pa'i skad sgyur rigs ni de bas kyang dkon po red/ na ning nga rang phyi rgyal la 'tshams 'drir 62

bskyod skabs bod skad nas phyi gling gi skad thog sgyur mkhan mi med stabs rgya skad nas phyi gling gi skad du bsgyur rgyu las mi 'dug de ni mis bltas kyang mdog nyes po'i gnas tshul zhig red/ de'i thog nas bod kyi slob gso'i las don mtha' skyo po ji tsam yod mtshon thub pa yin/ bod rang skyong ljongs zer ba'i snyan grags can 'di'i nang nas dngos khams rig pa sogs kyi slob tshan rnams bsgyur thub kyi med pa red/ rang skyong ljongs kyis da bar ga re byas nas bsdad pa red dam/ mtsho sngon gyi khong tshos legs nyes gang ltar yang tshang ma bsgyur thub 'dug da dung bod ljongs la rgyab skyor byed sems byed kyi 'dug yin na'ang bod kyi 'go khrid chos de ngos len med pa lta bus kha ya byas mi 'dug bod kyi 'go khrid mos bod kyi skad yig thog rtsa ba nas gal che don cher ma bltas par g.yug bzhag gi yod pa red / de ni shin tu nas thabs sdug red/ u yon krang gzhon pa nga phod 'di lo dbyar dus bod la phebs rtsis yod pa ltar/ khyed nas bod kyi skad yig slob spyong dang bed spyod byed phyogs kyi gnas tshul slor la thugs snang gnang ste khrims rdzog rang nas gtan 'bebs shig yong thabs gnang rgyu mi 'dug gam/ de ltar byung na bod du lo gcig gnyis nang da lta'i gnas stangs 'di la 'gyur ba gtong thub pa'i 'gan len yong nges yin/ bod kyi gnas tshul la bltas nas bshad na rgya che'i mi mang brgya cha 95 rgya yig dang rgya skad shes kyi med/ rgya yig dang rgya skad bed spyod byed pa ni las khungs nang yod pa'i rgya rigs las byed pa tsho stabs bde'i ched kho na red/ bod kyi skad yig bed spyod gtong rgyu 'di bod rgya che'i mi mang la phan thogs yod pa dngos yod gnas tshul nas gsal 11 chags kyi mi 'dug gam/ mi kha shas kyis nga kha mang po 'dug zer gyi 'dug nga skad cha mang po yod kyi red/ gong gi gnas tshul skor nga tsam min par mi mang por bsam tshul yod la/ na ning nga phod kyang sku rlung langs nas lcog rtse'i thog mur mdzog gzhu dgos thug yod/ nga rang ni de63

bas brjod ma dgos/ re bar tshang mas dgongs pa gzab nan bzhes rgyu'i re ba yod / bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod gtong rgyu'i gnad don 'di chung chung zhig gtan nas min/ de ni chab srid dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad donazhig yin / khyed hrū (rdo rje tshe brtan sogs la go ) bod rig par nyams zhib byed mkhan slo mthun tshos bod kyi skad yig dang / lhag par bod kyi chos lugs skor gyi lo rgyus ma shes na bod rig pa'i skor nyams zhib gang 'dra byas te byed thub kyi red dam / mang tshogs nas khyed rang tsho bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug las khungs la bsam 'char mang po yod mus red/ lhag par du mi sna bkod sgrig thad de bas kyang bsam 'char mang po 'dug/ mdor na bod kyi las don thad gnad don mang po zhig lhags mus red/ re bar ljongs tang u yon lhan khang dang / ljongs mi mang srid gzhung gnyis kyi nan tan gyis brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas nas nyams myong khag phyogs bsdoms byed dgos/ de bzhin krung dbyang nas kyang bod kyi chab srid thog thugs 'khur dang / dpal 'byor thog rgyab skyor sngar lhag pa gnang rgyu'i re ba yod/da lta'i bod kyi khur po 'di ha cang lci po red/ gnad don de rigs thag gcod 'byung thabs su nga tsho sku tshab tshogs pa nas kyang gros 'char kha shas 'bul lam zhus zin pa yin/ da res bod kyi gzhi rim las khungs khag nang bsgyur bcos btang ste lo na bgres pa dang / nad gzhi yod pa/ rgyun du las don nang phebs ma thub pa'i rnams bcos sgrig byas nas/ lo na chung ba dang / shes yon ldan pa/las ga'i 'jon thang yod pa'i gzhon skyes rnams gong 'then byas yod pa red/ yin na'ang de snga nas g.yon gyi bsam blo'i bag chags yod pa'i gras da dung nyung nyung ma red / mi de tsho'i nang de snga rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs gnad don yod pa de 'dra yod stabs mang tshogs nas bsam 'char shugs chen po 'dug/ nga tshos mi de rigs kha shas gong 'then byas yod pa red/ krung dbyang nas de snga bod du rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kyi gnad don rtsis rgyag bya rgyu min pa'i thag 64

gcod gnang yod la/ sger gyi ngos nas kyang rang skyon rang brjod byas te de snga'i nor 'khrul rnams yo bsrang byed dgos/ yang de snga'i bslab bya dang len byas te da lta mi byed pa gsum zer ba zhig khyab yong gi yod pa red/ krung dbyang gis rtsa ba nas ma gsungs pa zhig gang nas byung ma shes par khyab yod/ de lta'i gnas tshul rigs bod nang nyung nyung rtsa ba nas ma red/ der brten bod ljongs 'di zhing chen gzhan dag dang rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal can zhig chags yod / re bar krung dbyang nas mu mthud nas srid byus thad dang dngos po'i thad dmigs bsal gyi gzigs rtog gnang dgos/ bod mi mang rnams gang myu ra dbul po'i gnas las grol ba'i mdzad byus bzung ste rgya che'i mi mang 'dod blo lengs nges shig 'byung thabs su mu mthud srid byus de dag nges par du lag len bstar dgos pa yin/ mtha' mtshams kyi gdong thug gnad don sgor la nga rang sger gyi bsam tshul la/ gnas tshul chung rtsag rigs rgyun du yong rgyu yang red/ dmag 'khrug che ba 'phral du langs thub bzo mi 'dug de ni rgyun ring gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnas tshul zhig red/ phyi rgyal du bod mi mang po zhig da dung yang bsdad yod pa khong tsho ni nga tsho'i spun zla yin/ 'on kyang chab srid kyi langs phyogs dang lta ba mi 'dra bar brten/ bod kyi gnad don 'di yang rgyun ring gi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig red/ nga'i re bar bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas 'dzugs skrun bcas kyi thog shugs sdon rgyag dgos/ de ni bod kyi gnad don bo na tsam ma yin par rgyal yongs kyi ngos nas bshad na'ang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gyi don chen dang 'brel ba shin tu chen po yod pa'i gnad don zhig red/ gnyis pa/ zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong skabs dung rdeg gtong yul rgya che drags pa sogs kyi gnad don thag gcod yang dag pa byed dgos pa'i skor/ gong du khong nas (rig 'dzin dbang rgyal ) gtam bshad gnang ba'i nang bod du zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba'i gnad don skor brjod pa de tsho dngos yod red/ 1 95965

lor bod la ngo log zing 'khrug langs pa dang / zing 'khrug de zhod 'jags btang yod / de ni yang dag pa dang lab gleng gang yang med pa zhig red/ yin na'ang da lta brjod dgos pa'i gnad don ga re red dam zer na/ zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i bya rim nang rdung rdeg gtong mi dgos pa'i mi bzang rigs la rdung rdeg btang yod/ lhag par zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i las don nang gnad don mi nyung ba zhig bon yod pa ni de bas kyang tshabs che yod pa red/ zing 'khrug nang zhugs yod med kyi dbye ba gsal po phye med pa dang / skad cha 'dri rtsad tsam yang ma byas par mthong tshad bcug rkyang byas pa/ mi legs nyes tsam la'ang ma bltas par tshang ma sdeb bcug byas te rdung rdeg gtong yul gyi kha gtad la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i gnad don 'di rigs bod nang med pa min par dngos su lhags yod par ma zad/ de skor gnad don ha cang sdug po yod par bsam 'char mang po 'dug nga chos kyang gnad don 'di tshabs chen po yin pa ngos zin yod pa red/des na las don yag po gnyer te brtag dpyad zhib 'jug dang / yang dag pa'i sgo nas thag gcod byed dgos/ de ltar byed thub na mang tshogs rnams kyis khas len bya rgyu dang / 'dod pa mi khengs pa'i gnas tshul rigs rim pas nyung du 'gro nges yin/ nga tsho tshang mas bshad rgyu'i gnad don ni de rigs ma red dam zhes gsungs/ (mtshams 'dir nga phod nas de rang red ces zhus ) de snga nga la skyon brjod phog dgos pa'i gnad don yang yig 'byu khri bdun gyi gong snyan de yin/ de'i nang gnad don 'di'i gras ha cang gsal po zhus yod/ lhag par bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs tsho'i gnas tshul slor gong du nga phod nas gsungs pa dang gcig gyur yin/ sa gnas srid gzhung la khong rang tshor sgrig 'dzugs rim pa zhig yod pa dang / sgrig gzhi yang brtan po bzos yod pa red/ sku drag tshor yod pa'i go gnas dang las 'gan de bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs tshe gos dkar po g.yogs te/ glang dmar por bskyon nas rgyang 'bud gtong gi yod pas de ltar 66

btang na ga 'dra byed kyi yin/ mi su yin na'ang so so'i mdun lam la bsam slo gtong dgos pa ma red dam/ de'i thog skabs der da dung gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang gtan 'bebs byas don la/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur lag len ma bstar gong bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sngar yod dbang cha rang 'jags lag len bstar rgyu zhes gsal yod/ de bzhin bla brang khongs gtogs kyi 'dzin skyong dbang cha yang gong mtshungs byed rgyu'i skor gsal yod pa red/ yin na'ang gtam dper yod pa bzhin/ skad cha tshig gcig gis blta phyogs gsar pa 'dzin nas rnying pa'i lam srol la skyon brjod byed kyi yod pa red/ byed tshul de rigs ni dngos 'brel yag po ma red/dper na dngos gtso'i rtsod sgrub kyi lo rgyus smra ba po zhig yin na/ nges par du gnas tshul gang zhig lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen mi 'dra ba'i 'og thon pa de cha rkyen de rang zhwa gzhigs nas thag gcod byed thabs 'tshol dgos pa yin/ sku drag ni mi rabs nas mi rabs bar sa gnas srid gzhung gi zhabs phyi zhu mkhan zhig red/ de'i thog tā la'i bla ma mchog tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi skyabs yul du 'dzin nas gsol 'debs dang / dad gus shin tu chen po zhu gi yod/ de bzhin mi mang rnams kyi bsam blo'i nang nas dad bkur chen po zhu gi yod pa red/ de lta'i gnas tshul 'og mi rnams kyis khong tsho'i ched du las don byed 'dod byed pa dang / las ka byed pa ni brjod mi dgos pa zhig red/ mi de rnams zing 'khrug gi rkang 'dzin par ngos 'dzin byas te dung rdeg btang ba ni yongs su ma 'grigs pa red/ gnas tshul de tsho ngas gong 'bul zhu yig nang gsal por bris te bshad yod/ skabs der dgag pa dang skyon brjod phog byung / yin na'ang dgag pa ni dgag pa rang dang / dngos yod bden pa'i gnas tshul ni ga dus yin yang bden pa rang yin/ngas bshad pa'i nang skyon gyi cha yod na'ang / bshad yas 'grigs pa rnams ni de snga dang da lta gang du'ang 'grigs bsdad yod pa dang / bshad yas nor ba rnams 67

ni sngon ma dang da lta gang du'ang nor ba rang red/ de skor dbye ba gsal po phye dgos / dper na lto kha khul gyi gnas tshul nas bshad na/ thog mar dang blang dmag khams pa tsho yod pa red/ de'i rjes tā la'i bla ma lto kha khul du chibs bsgyur gnang skabs mi mang nas ma bskul dang blangs kyis thugs mkho mar dang rtsam pa sogs dga' bzhin sgro bzhin du 'bul lam zhus yod pa red/ rjes su mi de dag tshang ma ngo log zing 'khrug nang zhugs par brtsis par ma zad/ hur brtson can du yang brtsis yod pa red/ de 'dra byas nas 'grigs kyi red dam/ 'di ni mi rnams kyis shes dgos pa'i gnad don zhig yin/ yang dpe mtshon gcig zhus na/ nga rang yar mar 'gro dus bod rigs mang tshogs kyis ngos la gong bzhin dga' bsu dang dad gus byas pa de tsho mang tshogs la chab srid thog gnad don yod par brtsi dgos pa ma red dam/ de ltar brtsis na 'grig gi red dam/ bod rigs la dmigs bsal gyi goms gshis shig yod pa'i thog chos lugs kyi dad pa dag snang zhig kyang yod pa yin/ bod kyi dmigs bsal khyad chos de tsho'i thog do snang chen pos zhib 'jug byed dgos/ dmigs bsal khyad chos dang bstun nas gnas tshul thag gcod byed thub na 'grigs pa red/ bod du zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa de tso rtsa ba'i cha nas 'grigs pa yin kyang / lag len dngos kyi nang g.yon gyi shugs rkyen thebs pe5thod pa red/ skabs der g.yon gyi shugs rkyen thebs yod pa ma red ces brjod mi thub / de dag legs bcos byed dgos nges yin/ dper na/ rang re 'i tang gis rgyal khab btsugs nas lo ngo sum cu brgal ba de'i ring gi las don nang 'grigs pa byung yod la nor 'khrul yang byung yod pa red/ de slor tang gi tshogs chen bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs drug pa'i thog dngos su lo ngo sum cu'i nyams myong la phyogs bsdoms byas te 'dzam gling yongs la khyab bsgrags byas yod pa red/ 'grigs pa dang ma 'grigs pa gnyis ka bshad thub pa 'dis 68

tang gi mtshan mthong chag rgyu las ldog ste mtshan snyan gong mthor song yod pa ma red dam / nga tsho'i slo mthun kha shas te bod dmag khul khang dang / khren tu dmag gul khang gi 'go khrid rgan gras kha shas la ngas bshad myong / nga mos de 'dra ma byas na yag po yong ba yod zer ba lta bu ni lab gleng gang yang med pa zhig red/nga tshos yang nas yang du bshad pa ni khyed tshos bod kyi gsar brje dang bcings 'grol gtong ba'i las don nang rngul khrag mang po bton myong yod pa red/ de dag ni byas rjes shin tu chen 11 bzhag pa zhig yin pas/ bod mi mang gis dus nam yang phyed rnams brjed srid kyi ma red/ 'di ni snying gtam rang yin/ yang khyed rang mmu las don nang 'dra mi 'dra'i skyon dang nor 'khrul yang byung yod pa de tsho bod du bzhag yod pa red/ de yang nga mos brjed thabs med pa yin/ de dag ni skyon sel bya rgyu kho na'i ched dang / nga tsho tshang ma sngar las yag pa yong ba'i ched du yin pa 'di nga'i sems dkar gyi gtam yin/'dir ngas rgod bro'i gnas tshul zhig zhu rgyur/ bka' shag srid gzhung gis ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs yod pa las/ nga tsho bla brang khyab khongs nang nas zing 'khrug bslangs med/ thog mar nga tshor gsung don zhi ba'i bcos bsgyur byed rgyu dang / blu nyo'i srid byus lag bstar sogs mang dag cig bshad yod/ de rjes dngos su bcos bsgyur byed skabs nga tsho'i khongs gtogs rnams la'ang ha cang sdug po btang yod pa 'di ni mi rnams ha las dgos pa zhig red/ sa gnas srid gzhung gi khongs gtogs nas gros phyin pa ni bros pa rang red/ bros ma phyin pa'i rigs nyung shas shig yod pa de dag rgyal gces yar thon gyi dpe mtshon ston ched du bkod sgrig byas yod/ nga tsho'i khongs gtogs kyi nang du bsdad nas klo gcig sem/sa gcig byed mkhan gyi mi tshor sdug po bsam yul las 'das pa zhig phog yod pa red/ skabs der nga rang lha sar yod stabs 'grigs tsam byung / nga'i nang gi skyed byed kyis gtsos pa'i mi re re byas nas 'thab 'dzings btang yod pa red/69

skabs der bla brang gi las byed zhig gi bza' zla 'dzin bzung do dam byas yod pa red/ nyi ma gcig mo la 'dri zhib bya rgyu'i grwa sgrig byas te mo skad btang nas gnas tshul ngos len zhu dgos pa'i brda btang yod pa red/ mos bshad don/ paṇa chen zer mkhan des yin na nga rlung gis bsad song zhes/ mo'i kha nas skad cha 'di 'dra zhig thon 'dug de 'phral 'dri zhib byed mkhan tsho'i bsam par 'dis paṇa chen gyi nag nyes chen po zhig ther 'don byed pa 'dug bsam nas skad cha nyan rgyu'i thog do snang shugs che ru btang ba dang / tshig tho 'god mkhan sogs tshang mas do snang chen pos lcog tse'i g.yas g.yon nas bsnor te tshig tho bkod chog byas te sdod skabs mos bshad don/ nga chos paṇa chen zer mkhan gyi mi ngan de'i rjes su 'brangs te ngo log zing 'khrug nang ma zhugs pa 'di nor 'phrul chen po shor 'dus khong gis sne khrid nas ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs yod na ha cang yag po byung yod/ thog mar rgya mi gsod dgos pa rnams bsad/ de nas bros phyin pa yin na nga tsho ni rgya gar dang thag nye po yod pas las sla po red/ 'on kyang khos nga tshor yar thon byed dgos pa dang / rgyal gces byed dgos zer bshad par brten da lta gnas stangs 'di red/ rgya gar la bros ni mi thar/ skyes pho mo med par 'thab 'dzings btang ste dmyal pa gson por myong dgos thug song zhes bshad 'dusamatshams 'dir khos (rgya mi'i las byed pa ) mi ngan dang mi ngan zhes skad cor brgyab 'dug de ni dngos yod gnas tshul byung ba zhig yin pa las ngas rdzun bzo byas pa rtsa ba nas min/ gong du khyed rang (rig 'dzin dbang rgyal ) gis bshad pa'i phyi rgyal la bros 'gro mkhan las sdod mkhan tsho legs pa byung ba'i dngos don 'di red/yang nga sger la myong tshor zhig yod pa ni 1979 lor tā la'i bla ma'i dku tshab mi lnga bod nang phebs pa'i dus su nga'i skyed byed kyang nang gi sger dngos gnad don snyor la bod nang phebs yod/ mi sus kyang kha ya byed mkhan byung mi 'dug sku tshab mi lnga po mi rer snum 'khor re dang / da dung gsung bsgyur dang srung 70

skyob mi snas phebs rogs zhus yod pa red/ nga'i skyed byed ni rang skyong ljongs kyi rgyal sgor 'dzul rgyu la'ang dka' ngal byung ste/ sgo srung bas 'gro mi chog pa'i bkag 'gog byas nas char pa'i dkyil du sgug dgos byung yod pa red/ go gnas thog nas bshad na bod la de snga gung gnyis yod pa nas gcig ni 7rgyal ba rin po che'i yab dang / gcig ni nga'i skyed byed red/ spyi mogs snying pa'i go gnas nas bshad na nga'i skyed byed kyi go gnas khong tsho las zhe drag mtho ba yod pa red/ yin na'ang yar thon byas pa'i mi sna zhig yin stabs de ltar byung ba red/ 'di 'dra 'i ya mtshan che ba'i gnas tshul bod nang med pa min par dngos 'brel yod pa red/nga chos bod nang g.yon gyi shugs rkyen 'dug ces bshad pa ni don dngos yin pa las/khungs med kyis bshad pa zhig min la/ yang ngas 'dir rtsis rnying pa brgyab pa'ang min / bod kyi spyi tshogs nang dngos 'brel gyi brtag dpyad cig gnang / de nas don dngos gnas tshul tshang ma dang bstun te srid byus don 'khyol legs po zhig gnang thub na nga tsho'i las don la phan thogs chen po yong rgyu red/dper na zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i las don nang mcho sngon sogs sa gnas gang sar byas pa'i gnas tshul de rigs slog brnyan zhig bzos te bltas pa yin na tshang ma ha las dgos pa yong rgyu red/ mgo log khul du mi mang po dmar gsod btang ba dang / bsad pa'i ro rnams ri'i steng nas rbab ril btang ste 'og tu sa gong chen po zhig brus yod pa de'i nang sbas yod pa red/ da dung 'das po tsho'i nye 'brel rnams bslongs te khong tshor nga tshos ngo log zing 'khrug pa rtsa med btang ba yin pas/ de ring nga tsho dga' spro'i dus chen gtong dgos zhes bshad de 'das po tsho'i ro'i steng la zhabs bro rgyag tu bcug pa dang / de rjes me mda' sbag sbag kha bsgrigs nas de gar 'dzoms pa'i mi mang rnams sdeb gsod btang yod pa red/ dngos 'brel bshad pa yin na sa khul nyung shas nang ngo lo zing 'khrug byung yod/ khams khul la ngo log byed mkhan mang tsam byung yod na'ang sa gnas 71

mang che bar ngo log zing 'khrug langs me da/ da dung dpe zhig zhus na a mdo'i bya rung dkar po khul dang / de bzhin ma li sa khul du gnas pa'i 'brog pa tsho la deng snga go lag me mda' stong khrag kha shas yod pa rnams bsdus te srid gzhung la gong 'bul zhus yod/ skabs der khong tshor dga' bsku'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas tshogs chen 'tshogs nas khong tshor bstod bsngags btang ba dang / da dung brang khog la me tog dmar po btags yod pa red/ yin na'ang khong pho sdod gnas su 'byor te snum 'khor nas babs ma thag tshang ma 'dzin bzung byas te dus yun ring por btson du bcug yod/ de'i nang lo na rgan pa kha shas yod pa de tsho'ang bcug 'dug khams khul dang / a mdo'i khul so sor de lta'i sdug sbyong tshad med btang ste skabs re mi grangs bcu tsam dang / yang skabs re mi grangs nyi shu tsam re mnyam du dmar gsod btang yod pa red/ thog mar byas na de tsho'i rigs bshad na yag po yod pa ma red snyam yang / bya ba de 'dra byas pa'i ngan 'bras la mi mang rnams blo pham byung yod par brten/ nga mos nan tan dang zhib tshalas chen po'i sgo nas las don dang brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byed thub na/ srid byus don 'khyol sogs kyi sgor la mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i nang bsam tshul gang 'dra yod shes rgyu red/ nga'i bsam par de dag ni mi rigs sa khul zhig la mtshon na don gnad chung chung zhig rtsa ba nas ma red snyam/ des na drangs bden dang /zhib tshags chen pos srid byus don 'khyol dngos 'brel yong thabs byed ngagos pa dang /mi mang dang mi su dang su la'ang ga dus yin rung mjug ma zhig 'jog gi 'dug pa de 'dra bya rgyu med/ de ma bzhag na gzhi nas sems nang gi nad gzhi drag skyed yong ba dang las don khag kyang yag po bsgrub thub/ srid byus don 'khyol byed skabs nga tsho'i mi kha shas la ga dus yin na'ang mjug ma bzhag rgyu'i goms gshis shig 'dug de 'dra byas na phan thogs ga re yod dam/ gnad don bshad rgyu yod na bshad dgos pa dang / 'dzin bzung byed dgos pa'i nag nyes yod na 'dzin 72

bzung byas na 'grigs kyi red/ ha go 'di go med pa'i ngang ma jug ma zhig bzhag na cho ga re yod dam/ ngas mi de tsho'i rigs la don dam pa'i shes bya mi 'dug ces brjod kyi yod/ yang mi khag gcig gis de tsho'i rig sa la do snang dang sems 'khur chen po zhig byed kyi yod pa ni/ slog brnyan shang yu'i nang gi le 'o cin 'dra po byed kyi yod pa red/ zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong skabs gyi gnad don skor la slo mthun wu cing twa nas brtag dpyad byas te thag gcod bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod pa red/ yin na'ang nus shugs chen po zhig bton dgos nges red 'dug (mtshams 'dir rdo rje tshe brtan nas ngas bltas na de'i nang gnad don gsum yod pa ni/ dang po dmag dpung gis zing 'khrug nod 'jags gtong ba'i las 'gul nang zhugs skabs zing 'khrug nang zhugs yod med kyi dbye ba med par yongs rdzogs la gcig gyur gyi dgra 'dzin byas yod pa dang / gnyis pa sa gnas kyi thog nas bshad na chab mdo dang / nag chu/ lto rdzong sa khul bcas par tshabs che'i drag gnon byas yod pa dang rdung rdeg gtong yul rgya che ba bcas kyi dngos 'bre la gnad don tshabs chen po lhag yod/ ga sum pa gan sa srid gzhung gi dpon rigs khongs nas tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan yin phyin zing 'khrug nang zhugs par brtsi rkyang byas yod pa red ces zhus/) bsam pho'i mgo la rdo phog pa red ma gtogs tshogs 'dur 'gro mkhan red/ chogs 'dur yong dgos pa'i bka' btang yo da stabs skabs der ma phyin thabs med chags yod/ de 'dra'i rigs zing 'khrug nang zhugs par brtsis na ga la 'grigs/ rgyu mtshan med pa rang red/ (yang rdo rje tshe brtan nas gong gsal gnad don gsum gyi thad tshabs chen po chags yod 'dug skabs der gong rim nas da dung b.la' btang gsal/ cang ce hri che ba the ldan la bros pa dang / cang ce hri chung ba rnams gtsang dag bzo dgos/ zhes bka' phab gnas zhus/) de ni ma'o kru'u zhi'i gsung bshad nang gsal po yod 'i sne cang ce hri che ba gsod rgyur ma zad/ da dung cang ce hri chung ba yod tshad gsod 73

rgyu yin zhes bshad yod/ der rdzun tshig sne gcig med/ pa ṇa chen che ba nga ma shi ba da dung yag po red bsam/ paṇa chen chung ba mang por tshabs che'i rdung rdeg phog yod/ de'i thog da dung mi shi ba nyung nyung rtsa ba nas ma red/(mtshams 'dir rdo rje tshe brtan nas/ de sngon bshad srol zhig byung yod pa ni gzhi rim gyi 'go dpon hrū gtsang ma ma bzos tshe/ mi mang mang mogs rnams mgo bo bkyag mi thub pa sogs bshad pa 'di zing 'khrug nang zhugs yod med kyi rnam dbye med par gtor rkyang byed pa'i thog 'brel ba chen po yod ces zhus/) byas tsang g.yon gyi shugs rkyen de snga sa nas yod pa zhig red/ lhag par du 1959lor slo mthun pheng ta'i ho'i la dgag pa skyon brjod byas pa dang 'brel rgyal yongs su g.yas phyogs par ngo rgol byed pa'i las 'gul spel ba dang / de rjes g.yon gyi shugs rkyen rtsa ba tshugs nas lo ma rgyas 'go tshugs pa red/ nga rang tsho sger gyi ngos nas bshad na nor 'khrul med pa min/ nor 'khrul yod thag chod yin/yin na'ang 1959 lor las byed pa 'bor chen bod du btang ba dang / g.yon gyi bsam khro'i shugs rkyen yang de bzhin du rtsa ba brtan po tshugs pa/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi las mjug ma bsgril gong khong phos de 'phral mi mang spyi khang 'dzugs dgos pa'i blang bya bton pa de dag ni snga sa nas grwa sgrig byas zin pa'i gnad don zhig chags yod/ byas tsang gnas tshul de rigs la dbye zhib nan po byas te nor ba'i rigs nges par yo bsrang byed dgos/ de 'dra byas na yag po red/dmag dpung gi ngos nas ha lam go nor thebs srid/(mtshams 'dir nga phod nas/ de snga dmag dpung la go nor byung yod pa shes rtogs ma byung / na ning skabs drug pa'i phyogs 'du thengs bzhi pa tshogs skabs drin ming g.yid nga'i nang la phebs nas skad cha 'dri gi 'dug 'thus mi mmu nang bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i gnad don skor bsam tshul ga re 'dug gam gsung gi 'dug ngas zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong skabs 74

rgya che drags pa las gzhan gyi bsam 'char gang yang mi 'dug zhus pa yin/ dren nas u yon krang gzhon pa paṇa chen gyis zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba de yang dag pa red ces gsung yod pa ma red pas/ de bsdus gsal gsar 'gyur nang du'ang thon yod ces gsung gi 'dug de'i dus ngas gzhi nas dmag dpung la go nor byung ba shes rtogs byung / don dngos zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i las don gyi ngo bo la nor 'khrul byung med/ zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i brgyud rim nang rdung rdeg gtong yul rgya che drags yod ces gsungs/ (mtshams 'dir rdo rje tshe brtan nas/ nga chos da bar zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba de nor ba red ces brjod myong gtan nas med/ nga tshos bshad yas ni zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i brgyud rim nang byung ba'i skyon gnas skor yin zhes bshad/)paṇa chen mchog nas mu mthud gsungs don/ dper na mas sngon khul la yul tsho chig stong nas sum stong bzhi stong bar yod pa de tshor dud tshang yang sum stong nas bzhi stong bar yod/ mi 'bor ha lam bzhi ltong lnga stong yod kyi red/grong tsho re nas 'dzin bzung byas pa'i mi 'bor brgyad brgya nas chig stong brgal ba zhig 'dzin bzung btson bcug byas yod/ btson khang nang shi ba kho nar mi grangs sum brgya bzhi brgya brgal bas ha lam phyed ka tsam zin 'dug na ning brtag dpyad byed skabs grong tsho re gnyis tsam zing 'khrug nang zhugs yod pa las/ grong tsho mang che ba ngo rgol nang zhugs med thag chod red/ de snga ngas gong 'bul yig 'byu khri bdun gyi snyan zhu'i nang 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas pa'i grangs 'bor de spyi yongs kyi mi 'bor nas brgya cha lnga bkod yod/ skabs der ngas shes par gzhigs na 'dzin bzung byas pa'i mi 'bor spyi'i brgya cha 10 nas 15 bar yin rung / de dus nga la grangs 'bor dngos yod 'god rgyu'i snying stobs med stabs brgya cha lnga bkod pa yin/ de dus nga la 'thab 'dzings btang nas tog tsam min na shi tshar song / brtag dpyad byed skabs 'dzin bzung byas pa'i grangs 'bor 75

brgya cha 10 nas 15 bar zin gyi 'dug byas tsang bod rigs sa khul gyi gnad don ha cang tshabs chen po red/ gnad don tshabs chen po de tsho'i rigs la kha nas skad cha mkhas po kho na bshad de bsdad pa las/ rtsa ba'i cha nas legs bcos byed rgyu'i thabs shes ma byas na de'i mjug 'bras tshabs chen po zhig yong nges red / nga'i skad cha 'di rigs mi gzhan gyi go na rna bar mi 'gro ba yong rgyu yin rung / nga rang ni tang dang mes rgyal la dga' zhen gyi kun slong thog nas bshad kyi yod/ de sngon nga shin cang la bskyod skabs khong tshor ngas bshad myong / khyed rang tsho'i mang tshogs kyi las don de legs nyes ci 'dra byung yod min ni phyi'i dgra bos btsan 'dzul byed dus gzhi nas shes thub/ rgyun du phyogs 'du sogs kyi thog bshad pa rnams ni rdzun ma yin pas/ yid ches ma byas na 'grigs kyi red /u ru su'i mis btsan 'dzul byas te u lu mu chir 'byor dus/ shin cang gi mi mang yar langs zu/sa rgya rigs bcings 'grol dmag dang mnyam du btsan 'dzul pa dang khyod shi nga ga ne gyi 'thab rtsod byas pa yin na/ de ni khyed rang tsho'i mi rigs kyi las don dang mang tshogs kyi las don rnams ha cang yag po byung yod pa'i mngon brtags yin/ ngas khyed tshor lo rgyus thog byung ba'i dpe gzhi gnyis zhus na / u ru su'i zla bcu pa'i gsar brjer rgyal kha thob rjes le nyin gyis mi rigs kyi las don legs tsam sgrub thub pa byung yod/ de nas si ta yin gyis 'go khri da byed skabs mi rigs gyi las don 'thus go tshang po zhig byed thub med/ der brten 'jar man btsan 'dzul dmag gis u ru sur btsan 'dzul byed skabs u ru su'i mi rma nga dang dmar dmag gnyis kyis 'jar man dmag la 'thab 'dzings drag po byas yod/ yin na'ang de gong mi rigs kyi las don yag po byung med stabs/grangs nyung mi rigs kha shas kyis 'jar man gyi dmag dpung la rogs ram byas te u ru su'i dmar dmag thog rgol 'dzings byas pa'i lo rgyus yod/ yang rang rgyal gyis wi ti nam la rang srung rgol lan slog pa'i dmag 'khrugs rgyag skabs kyi 76

gnas tshul nga zos slog brnyan nang nas gsal po mthong yod/ wi ti nam gyi mang tshogs kyis bcings 'grol dmag gi lam sne 'khrid pa dang / khong zos chu sogs sprad yod/ de pho tshang ma wi ti nam gyi grangs nyung mi rigs red/ de 'dra yong rkyen ni wi ti nam srid gzhung gis khong tsho'i gtso bo'i mi rigs cing phud pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan la sdang po byed kyi yod/ der brten bcings 'grol dmag 'byor ma thag dga' bsu zhus nas lam sne 'khrid pa dang / chu sprod pa sogs byas yod/ cing zer ba'i mi rigs 'di ni rtsa ba nas yag po yod pa ma red/ khong tshos mgo ma skur ba dang / lo na 50/60 brgal ba'i rgas 'khogs kyis kyang me mda' khyer nas mi gsod kyi yod/ da dung phrug gu lo 11byas pa zhig gis nga tsho'i dmag gi ying 8 gtor ba red/ lo rgyus kyi bslab bya de rigs nga tshos nges par dang du len thabs byed dgos/ de ni nga tshor phan thogs yod pa zhig yin/ 1964 lor nga rang pe cing du bka' 'gugs kyis skyon brjod gnang skabs 'go khrid kha shas kyis gsungs don/ khyod rang gis mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byas te zing 'khrung bslangs nas mes rgyal kha bral du gtong dgos bsam gyi yod pa red/ khyed rang tsho bod rigs yongs kyis drag chas spras na'ang mi grangs khri sum brgya lhag tsam las med pas ha las rgyu ga re yod pa red ces gsung byung / de 'dra'i skad cha thos dus nga ha las nas rang dbang med par sems skyo byung / nga rang la mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed pa'i bsam slo med/ gal srid mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i bya ba yod pa yin na'ang bod mi mang yongs rdzogs nga dang mnyam du gang 'dra byas te mnyam 'brel yong gi red dam/ nga'i bsam par gsung phyogs de rigs ni nor 'khrul rang red bsam gyi 'dug da lta lhing 'jags kyi gnas stangs 'di'i 'og mchongs phod mkhan su yang yong mi srid/ gal te mchongs yong mkhan zhig byung na'ang de 'phral rtsa med gtong thub/ bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug de ni dmag don dang / chab srid/ dus bab bcas kyi gnas 77

stangs ma shes pa'i mi kha shas kyis bslangs pa zhig red/ dmag dngos 'brel zhig rgyag dgos na nges par du dus bab kyi gnas stangs nges can zhig dang /phyogs tshang ma'i nus shugs dgos pa'i thog dgra phyogs dang rang phyogs gnyis lnga'i nus shugs la bsam slo gtong thub pa dgos pa yin/ de 'dra med par me mda' gog to kha shas shig 'khyer te gtor bcom byas nas dmag rgyag thub gyi red dam/ de dag ni dngos 'brel gang yang mi shes pas byas pa'i rgod bro ba'i bya ba zhig red/ phyi rol gyi dgra bos nang 'dzul byed skabs de lta'i gnas tshul byung na yag po med/ nga rang mos gnas tshul bzang po yod pa'i dus skabs su las don khag yag po gnyer dgos / de yang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mi mang rnams mes rgyal gyi nang du bde ba yod pa tshor thub zhig bzo dgos/ de ltar byed thub na rgya rigs tsho dang mnyam du rgyal khab 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu'i sems shugs 'phel nges dang / nga tsho'i bsam blo'i nang du yang bde ba tshor thub pa yong gi red/ de las ldog te rtag par gnon bsam pa kho na byas te bsdad na nyi ma gcig rnyog dra yong gi red/ sngon ma dmag don skor bshad pa de tsho la nges pa gang yang med/ da cha dmag don skor la do snang ma byas tshe dmag 'khrugs langs rgyu'i rgyu rkyen yod mus dang /dmag 'khrug 'gog pa'i nus stobs kyang sngar bas che ba zhig yod pa red/ 'on kyang gal srid nges med dmag 'khrug langs pa yin na gang 'dra byed dgos sam/1962 lor bcings 'grol dmag gis rgya gar dang sa mtshams su rgyal kha'i dmag 'thab byas yod pa red/ de skabs bod mi mang nas dmag gi dgos mkho khag mi'i skal pa dang / 'bri g.yag sogs kyis 'or 'dren byas te rgyab phyogs mkho sgru ba kyi las don yag po byas yod pa des dmag 'thab la rgyal kha thob pa red/ deng skabs mi 'ga' shas kyis rgya dkar nag bar slar yang dmag 'khrug langs grabs 'dug ces shod kyi yod kyang / dmag 'khrug langs mi srid snyam/ gal te dmag 'khrug langs pa yin na bod mi mang gi ngos nas 1962 lor byas pa ltar 78

dmag rogs byed kyi yod med 'di ni rang gis rang la dri ba 'don dgos pa'i gnad don chen po zhig yin/ nga tsho'i slo mthun 'ga' shas kyis srid byus don 'khyol bya rgyu'i thad the tshom tshom byed pa dang / de dag byed mi dgos pa'i thabs shes byed kyi yod pa red/ ngas bltas na mi de rigs la dmag 'thab kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la blta ba'i nus pa med pa dang / chab srid mkhas can gyi lta ba med pa bcas shig red ces brjod kyi yod/ yang gal srid bod nang rlung ldang rtswa 'gul gyi gnad don zhig lhags na krung dbyang nas dza drag gi phogs 'du zhig 'tshogs te don gnad khag gi skor gang zhig byed dgos pa dang / gang 'dra byed 'gab paṇa chen dang nga phod gnyis kyis byed dgos zhes gsungs te 'grigs thabs byed dgos kyi yod/ nga sar cha bzhag na de dag dga' bzhin spro bzhin du yos byed / yin na'ang rgyun gtan nas las don legs pa'i rigs ma spel bar brten rnyog dra byung dus nga hrū yang byed khag po yong gi 'dug nga ni dus rgyun nas skad cha rtsub po shod dgos mkhan zhi ga yin pa 'di yang rgyang ring gi khe phan kho na'i don du yin/ nga rang sger gyi don gnad cig yin na de ltar shod dgos don gtan nas med / nga rang sger ngos nas byas na ha cang skyid po 'dug nga'i bsam par nga ni krung go'i nang gi mi skyid shos shig yin snyam gyi yod/ don gnad khag gi skor la dgongs pa bzhes dus dgongs pa rgya che tsam bzhes dgos/ bod nang g.yon gyi shugs rkyen yod pa de dag phan thogs gang 'dug/ g.yon gyi bsam slo yod pa'i slo mthun tshos gnon gyi yod pa red/ nye dus slo mthun hu'u ya'o pang spyi khyab drung che'i go gnas nas phab pa'i skabs la mi kha shas de tshos dus chen ltar shog sbag spar ba dang / chang rag 'thung ste rgyas spros kyi thug sa spro btang nas bod rigs kyi rgyab rtsa pham nyes byung song zhes bshad yod pa dang / da dung da lta wu cing twa log mi thub pa dang / paṇa chen yang log thub kyi med lugs zer ba dang / nga phod gang 'dra yin min da lta ha go gi mi 'dug zer ba sogs 79

bshad yod pa red/ nga zo so so'i lung par log mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan ga re yod dam/ kho pa tsho dga' spro byed yas phran bu snga drags pa red/ mi de tshos nga hrū bod rigs dang rgya rigs bar kha bral gtong thabs byed kyi yod pa red/ nga tsho'i ngos nas rang tsho ni mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang gi khongs mi gcig yin zhing / gnad don tshang ma'i thad spun zla'i 'brel lam yong thabs byed dgos pa yin na/ bod rigs kyi rgyab rtsa pham nyes byung song zer ba ga 'dra byas na shod kyi yod pa red dam/ gnad don de rigs ni tshabs chen yin pas tshang mas dgongs pa yag po bzhes dgos/ bod kyi las don nang srid byus sngar bas lhag pa'i don 'khyol yong thabs dang / mi mang gi 'tsho ba gong 'phel yong ba bcas kyi las ka yag po byed dgos/ nga tsho bod la dgos dngul nyung skyon yod pa dang / gnam gyu sogs kyi thad do snang byed dgos/ da cha bod kyis dka' las khag po'i 'og nas gnam gru gnyis nyo thub yod rung / mtha' ma dka' gnad sna tshogs 'phrad nas khong chos 'phur bskyod byed kyi med pa dang / srid slon kre'u zhen le 'tsho bzhugs skabs dka' ngal sna tshogs sel te nga tshor snum 'dren lcags mdong btsugs yod rung / da cha slar yang khong tshos snum rin spar yod pa red/ de ltar byas na nga tsho'i 'khor lo'i rigs kyis skyel 'dren byed mi thub par rang sar lus rgyu red/ don gnad kha shas thog nga mor yang skyon cha yod/ krung dbyang nas dngul 'bor mang po 'di tsam gnang ba rnams gang du btang yod/ mang tshogs kyi ched du bya ba gang dang gang sgrub yod dam/ dngul de dag ni las byed pa dang las bzo tshos zas pa ma red pas/ de 'dra byas nas mang tshogs kyi ched du las don mang po byed thub med/ bod la rogs skyor phran bu ma byas na/ bod nang gtso bo lag pa gnyis la brten nas ngal rtsol byed dgos stabs skyo thag chod red ces gsungs / (mtshams 'dir nga phod nas bod la mthun rkyen gang yang med/ zhing 'brog gi thon skyed phran bu de rang las bzo las ni ha lam med/ da dung sang 80

las dar po med ces gsungs/)yang nga rang hrū rang ngos la byed pa'i nus pa yod kyang byed mi thub pa'i dka' gnad mang po yod/ bod kyi skad yig rlo ba spyong dang bed spyod byed rgyur do snang chen po byed kyi med pa red/ bod 'di mi rigs khag gi nang nas chos la dad pa byed mkhan gyi mi rigs sa khul zhig yin zhes bshad kyi yod pas/ bod yig bed spyod byed dgos pa 'di ni brjod mi dgos pa zhig yin/ yin na'ang gnad do na mang po yod pa red/ 1958 lor nga rang mtsho sngon la yod dus go thos byung ba zhig la/ skabs der tang nang khul gyi yig cha zhig gi nang zing 'khru ga langs pa dang de 'phral zing 'khrug la drag gnon bya rgyu dang / de rjes zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i las don spel skabs mi rigs dang chos lugs gyi gnad don de dag gtsang ma thag gcod byed dgos lugs bshad yod 'dug phyi mig cig bltas na/ phyogs yongs nas ma 'ongs par las don gang 'dra spel dgos kyi red dam/ deng skabs rgyal nang gi gnas bab zhi bde lhing 'jags yod rung /da dung yang gnad don chung rtsag rigs thon gyi yod/ spyi yongs nas bshad na zhi bde snying 'jags dang mthun sgril yag po yod pa red/ yin na'ang da lta'i gnas bab 'di la 'dod pa khengs mi nyan/ slad phyin rnyog zing che ba'i gnad don lhags na gang 'dra bya rgyu yin/ mi rigs kyi las don yag po gnyer ched dngul mang po bton thub kyi med na'ang / srid byus gtan 'bebs byed skabs de tsho'i nang grangs nyung mi rigs rnams la sems 'gul thebs pa'i blta skyong gi srid byus lag len bstar dgos pa yin/ zhes bka' stsal 'dug //81

bod kyi rig par zhib 'jug byed pa'i rmang gzhi ni bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gnyis yin/(phyi lo 1988 zla tshes nyin/)༄༅/ /de ring krung go'i bod kyi shes rig las 'dzin gyi tshogs 'du'i thog slo mthun nga phod dang / tha'an cin ran/ gzhan yang dbu khrid rnam pa tshang ma lhan du 'dzoms nas tshogs 'du rgyal kha'i ngang 'phogs pa red/ da lta slo mthun cang phing dang / rdo rje tshe brtan lags gnyis kyis bod kyi shes rig lte gnas kyi las don rim pa dang / phyin chad kyi las don byed sgo'i 'char gzhi rim pa tshang ma snyan sgron gnang song / da lta slo mthun nga phod kyis bka' slob ha cang yag po gnang song / ngas thog mar tshogs 'du 'di rgyal kha'i ngang nas 'phyogs par bkris bde legs zhu gi yin/ da lta 'dir ngas bsam 'char re 'bod tshig kha shas las mang po zhu yas med/ krung go'i bod kyi shes rig lte gnas thog mar tshugs pa'i skabs su ngas mi rigs pho brang nang bka' mol zhu rgyu byung /bod kyi rig pa zer ba 'di la rmang gzhi zhig dgos pa yin/ rmang gzhi de sang yin zhe na/ bod kyi chos lugs dang / bod kyi rig gnas zer ba 'di gnyis yin / de gnyis la da bar nga tshos mthong chung byas pa las/ mthong chen zhig gtan nas byas yod pa ma red/ de gnyis thad kyi bya ba yag po ma byung na bod kyi rig pa'i shes rig 'gan 'dzin gyi las ka 'di rtsa ba brtan po yong yas yod pa ma gsung bshad 'di ni 1988 lor pe cing du bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi las 'dzin phogs 'du thengs dang po'i thog stsal ba zhig red/ (gsung par nas yig thog phab 'bri zhus/)82

red / chu mgo med pa'i chu dang / rtsa ba med pa'i shing lta bu chags kyi red ces zhu rgyu byung / nga rang da lta yang lta ba de rang yin/ de yin zer dgos don ga re yin zer na/ da bar bod la bod yig byung nas lo 1300 lhag tsam phyin yod pa red/ da lta brjod tshul gcig la de'i gong nas yod pa red zer ba'i skad cha de tsho phar bzhag mngon sum du nga tsho'i bod yig 'di byung nas lo 1300lhag tsam phyin yod pa red/ de nas phyi lo 1959 lo bar nga tshor nor 'khrul byung yod na'ang 'dra/ rjes lus thebs yod na'ang 'dra/ gnas tshul sang 'dra zhig gi 'og tu yang nga tshos bod yig 'di rang bed spyod btang ste 'dzam gling gi sa mtho'i thog mi tshe bskyal nas bsdad pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ nga tsho'i bod yig 'di cha tshang po yod na'ang 'dra/ cha tshang po med na'ang 'dra/ cos kyi rig pa yin na'ang 'dra/ de min tshan rig yin na'ang 'dra/ bzo las yin na'ang 'dra/ sman gyi rig pa yin na'ang 'dra/ skar rtsis rig pa yin na'ang 'dra / snyan ngag rig pa yin na'ang 'dra/ gtan tshigs rig pa la sogs pa tshang ma bod yig thog tu bris pa ma gtogs de min gzhan zhig thog bris pa gtan nas yod pa ma red/ de dang chabs cig bod la sa khul khag gnyis yod/ da lta bod rang skyong ljongs zhes pa'i bod kyi sa gnas srid gzhung dang / yang de bzhin zhing chen khag la yod pa'i bod mi spun zla tshos bod rang gi srid 'dzin gyi las ka tshang ma bod yig thog nas cha tshang byas pa red ma gtogs/ de'i tshab tu yi ge gzhan dag cig bed spyod btang ba gtan nas yod pa ma red/ sa gnas khag la dpe bzhag na / da lta khams dang / a mdo khul gyi dgon pa de tsho'i nang bod yig rang bed spyod byed kyi yod pa red/ lung pa de tsho'i sde shog gi lam lugs srung 'dzin yang bod yig rang gi thog nas byed kyi yod pa red/ de min rdzong dang zhing chen sogs la yar mar 'gro dgos byung na rgya mi sku zhabs de 'dra gdan 'dren zhus nas yi ge bris pa ma gtogs/ nga rang tsho'i lung pa'i nang bod yig rang bed spyod byas 83

na khungs 'khyol gyi yod/ song tsang / nga hrū lo ngo 1300 lhag tsam ring bod yig bed spyod btang nas bsdad pa'i mi rigs shig yin ma gtogs/ skad yig gzhan dag bed spyod btang nas bsdad pa zhig gtan nas min/ yin na'ang 1959 lo nas bzung bar lam nga tsho'i bod yig 'di da lta slo mthun nga phod kyis gsung song / g.yon gyi shugs rkyen 'og tu da cha bod yig bed spyod gtong dgos byung na ha cang dka' las khag po chags yod/ bod yig shes mkhan nyung nyung zhig las med pa 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul thabs skyo po zhig chags yod pa red/ na ning 1987 lor slo mthun nga phod dang / nga tsho gnyis kyis sems thag bcad de bod la bskyod nas nga phod bod rang skyong ljongs mi mang 'thus mi'i tshogs chen gyi rgyun las kru'u rin song tsang phyag las gnang ste bzhugs/ ngas khong la rgyab skyor zhus byas nga tsho gnyis kyis g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs kyi sgo nas u tshugs nan po brgyab ste da phyin bod du bod yig slob sbyong dang / bed spyod byas nas yar rgyas gtong dgos zhes bshad pa yin/ bod la bod yig bed spyod gtong dgos pa dang / slob spyong byed dgos pa/ yar rgyas gtong dgos pa bshad de gros chod bzhag dgos pa 'di ni ngo tsha dgos pa'i gnas yin kyang / bya ba dngos kyi thog de ni dngos yod gnas tshul yin pa dang / kha tsha dgos gtugs yin pa/de ltar ma byas na ma 'grigs pa zhig yin pa bcas chags yod pa red/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thad nas bshad na rjes lus red la/ rgyu mtshan gyi thog nas bshad kyang skad cha de tsho ni ngo tsha dgos pa'i gnas shig red/ bod la lo 1300 lhag ring bod yig bed spyod btang ste khungs 'khyol ba'i sa khul zhig la bcings 'grol byung nas gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og lo ngo nyi shu'i nang bod yig rbad de brlag pa red/ da cha u tshugs brgyab ste bod yig bed spyod gtong dgos pa'i gros chod cig bzhag dgos byung ba 'di 'dzam gling thog zhabs 'dren gyi las ka red/84
