yin na'ang nga hrū gnyis nas las ka 'dir u tshugs brgyab ste mtshams re rgya 'dre brgyab/ nga mi 'di rlung langs po song tsang / lcog tse'i sgang du mdzog mgo yang brdabs nas mi 'ga' re rlung langs dgos pa bzos pa dang / de bzhin dro mthun nga phod nas kyang gsungs/ phun dbang lags dang / phun bkras lasas bcas tshang mas ha rub ba rub gnang / de'i thog la slo mthun wu cing twa khong tsho'i gras kyis kyang rgyab skyor shugs chen po gnang byas thebs chag 'grig tsam byed thub pa byung ba dang / de'i mjug tsam du da lo nas bzung bod la lag len bstar yas kyi khyab bsgrags shig byas yod pa red/ lag len bstar nas gang 'dra yong gi yod med blta rgyu red/ yin na'ang tshags par 'god mkhan zhig bis nga tsho bod mi mang la gnad don dri ba bton pa zhig la/ bod nang btsan dbang gi thog nas bod yig lag len bstar rgyu 'di 'grig gam zhes bton yod/ de ni bod du bod yig bed spyod gtong rgyur ngo rgol byed mkhan nang rgya rigs yod par rma zad/ bod rigs kyang mi nyung ba zhig yod pa'i rtags red/ de'i nang mi snaga' zhig gi ming bris yod pa tshang ma bod rigs kyi ming red/ ngo rgol byed mkhan rme nga che ba bod rigs de tshos mdun du thon nas bod la bod yig bed spyod gtong rgyur ngo rgol byed kyi yod pa red/ song tsang / ngas khong tsho la lan rgyag yas ga re rgyag gi yin zer na/ khyod rang tsho ni khrims kyi she sa bya dang / mi rigs kyi tshes bya/ lo rgyus kyi shes bya bcas ha cang dman pa red/ snying rje zhes lan bya ga gi yod/ khrims kyi shes bya gang 'dra red dam zer na/ rtsa khrims kyi nang du mi rigs kyi sa khul la mi rigs kyi 'dod slo bed spyod dang / skad bed sbyo da gtong yas thad rgya khyab che shos kyi yi ge de bed spyod gtong dgos zhes gsal bye du da pa red/ bod la da lta rgya yig shes mkhan sngon ma dang bsdur na mang du phyin yod/ yin na'ang brgya cha 90 yan gyi mis rgya yig shes kyi med pa red/so nga tsang / bod la bod yig khyab che ba yin par bsnyon du med/ gong du 85

skad cha bshad mkhan de tsho ni rtsa khrims dang 'gal ba dang / mi rigs kyi bca' khrims dang 'gal ba/ rang skyong gi bca' khrims dang 'gal yod pa red/ der brten khong tshor khrims kyi shes bya med pa red/ mi rigs shig la mtshon na/ si ta yin sogs kyis mi rigs su dang su zhig yin na'ang rang gi skad dang / yi ge zer ba 'di gtso bo yin gsung yod pa red/ skad dang yi ge zer mkhan 'di gtso bo yin pa ni mi rigs kyi shes bya yod mkhan zhig yin na tshang ma'i sems kyi nang gsal po shes kyi red/ song tsang / lo rgyus kyi shes bya med pa red zer ba 'di ni nga tsho bod la lo 1300 lhag ring bod yig bed spyod btang ste khungs 'khyol yod pa red/ de dag 1959 lo nas bzung med par phyin pa red/ de ni lo rgyus kyi shes bya red/ song tsang / ya nga snying rje/ a mdo'i skad brgyab na snying ma rje zer ba ltar red/ (mtshams 'dir tshang ma bzhad gad shor/) de 'dra song tsang / da lta 'dir bod kyi rig pa la zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i sgor gsung gi yod pa red/ khyed rang mos brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas nas yar rgyas gtong yas la ngas sems 'khur dang rgyab skyor zhu dang zhu/ yin na yang nga ni da lta mu mthud nas rmang gzhi de rang la sems 'khur byed kyi yod/ bod yig 'di bod dang bod mi'i sa khul gzhan dag la shi gi yod dang gson gyi yod mi shes/khyed rang sas 'dir dpyad gzhi mtho po bzung nas bod yig gi deb chen po 'don pa gnang yas 'di bka' drin chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa red kyang / nga ni bod rigs kyi bod yig 'di khungs 'khyol ba zhig yong yas yin nam/ de med par bzo yas shig yin/ 'di'i jog bsam tshul yod/ song tsang ngas na ning skad cha 'di bshad pa yin la da lta'ang yang bskyar skad cha 'di rang bshad kyi yod / bod kyi rig pa ni chos dang 'brel ba zhig yin/ bod 'di thog ma nas da lta nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di nyid rig 'brel gyi mi rigs shig tu grub pa dang / chos dang zung du 'brel yod/ song tsang mi rigs kho rang gi bsam slo gtong stangs 86

dang / mi rigs kho rang gi legs nyes bden rdzun dbye ba 'byed pa'i lta ba de tsho tshang ma'i yong sa nang pa'i chos red/ dper na/ rgya rigs kyi de tsho tshang ma mang che ba khung rtse dang / mong rtse brgyud nas byung ba nang bzhin/nga tsho'i 'di dag yongs su rdzogs pa ston pa shākya thub pa nas byung ba red/ song tsang / nga tsho bod rigs kyi de dag tshang ma chos dang rbad de khag kha ga byas te le'u cha tshang zhig bshad kyi yin zer na shod thub thabs gtan nas yod pa ma red/nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'di chos lugs stabs bde zhig min par ha cang gi gting zab po dang / gzhung rgya chen po yod pa zhig red/ de'i nang chos kyi shes bya tsam du ma zad/ rig pa'i gnas yongs su rdzogs pa yod/ song tsang / bod kyi rig pa'i gnas cha yongs su tshang ba yong yas la des shugs rkyen dang nus pa chen po bton yod pa red/ chos ma shes pa la bod kyi rig pa la brtag dpyad byed yas zer ba 'di rtsa ba nas yong thabs med pa zhig red/ dper na/ mar le'i ring lugs ma shes par spyi tshogs ring lugs la zhib 'jug byed kyi yin zer na yong gi red dam/ mar le ring lugs mi dgos zhes g.yugs bzhag nas nga spyi tshogs ring lugs la brtag dpyad byed kyi yin zer bshad na yong gi red dam/dpe de bzhin du bod kyi rig par zhib 'jug byed pa la chos kyi gnas tshul shes dgos/ yin na'ang da lta mi mi nyung ba zhig gis bod kyi chos de rgya skad nang da'o yan zhes rnyog dra tsha po red brjod kyi yod pa red/ phyi lo 1959 lo nas bzung nga hrū bod rigs sa khul gyi dgon pa khag 5000 lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nas yongs rdzogs sam/ mang che ba rtsa gtor btang ba red/ rtsa ba'i cha nas brgya cha brgya tham par gtor skyon byung yod pa dang / gtor skyon btang ba brgya cha 97 98 bar zin yod/ 'phros lhag bdun brgyad cig yod pa'i nang nyams chag khyon nas ma byung ba'i dgon pa rdog po gcig yod pa ma red/ lhag pa'i nang nas yag shos de po ta la yin yang de'i nang nyams 87

chag phyin yod pa red/ der brten ngas brgya cha 100 tham par gtor skyon byung yod pa red ces zer dgos don 'di yin/ de lta bu'i gtor skyon chen po byung ba'i nang bod kyi lo rgyus dang / bod kyi rig gnas/ bod kyi ngal rtsol mi mang gi lo ngo stong phrag ring dka' las brgyab pa'i 'bras bu tshang ma med pa bzos pa red / song tsang / da lta lhag pa ni chag ro dang yig ro tog tsam lhag yod pa de rnams rtsa cher 'dzin gyi yod pa red/ bod kyi rig pa nas byas na chos la nges par du gces spras byed dgos pa dang / chos kyi rig pa rgyun 'dzin byed dgos pa 1 bod du chos lugs kyi srid byus de hrū tshang ma don 'khyol yag po zhig byed dgos pa red/ ngas rnam pa mor dpe zhig zhus na/ da res nga tsho 'dzam gling o lim mig gi lus rtsal 'gran tshogs la phyin pa der grub 'bras yag po byung med/grub 'bras yag po ma byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug pa red dam zer na/ de ni nga tsho'i lus rtsal gyi rtsa ba'i yongs khyab rang bzhin ldan pa'i chu tshad de dma' ru phyin pa dang / lus rtsal rtsed mkhan tshos dka' las brgyab nas sbyangs yas sdug tu phyin yod pa de red/ ngas 'di brjod dgos don ni yongs khyab kyi sgo nas dgon pa tsho'i nang chos brtag dpyad byed yas dang / chos slob sbyong byed yas kyi rmang gzhi yag po zhig ma byung na/ mi rgan pa kha shas shig gis zhib 'jug byed kyi yin zer na'ang tshad mtho po zhig yong rgyu khag po yin/ de la spyi tshogs kyi rmang gzhi dang / mang phyogs kyi rmang gzhi med pa red/ bod yig kyang dpe de bzhin yin / bod la masan na'ang 'dra/ bod kyi shes rig la mtshon na'ang 'dra/bod yig yongs khyab bed spyod gtong rgyu dang / chos lugs kyi srid byus lag len yag po bstar rgyu/ dgon pa tsho'i chos 'chad nyan gong 'phel gtong rgyu bcas ni ha cang gal chen po red/ 'on kyang da lta mi khag gcig gi klad pa'i nang rtsa ba nas thag zod med cing / bod la da lo dbyar kha nas bzung mi khag gcig gi klad pa'i nang gi g.yon gyi na tsha de yang bskyar 'phar nas chos dang / mi rigs 88

kyi skad yig la srid byus don 'khyol byed yas mang drags 'dug ces shod kyi yod pa red/ de tsho ni tsi ci'i mig rgyang las thung ba zhig red ces brjod rgyu bcas nga'i zhu don gnyis pa 'di yin/zhu don gsum pa ga re yin zer na/ da lta bod kyi shes rig lte gnas kyi phyag las skor khye da rang tshos phyag las gnang nas dmigs yul ga re 'grub dgos pa yin zer na/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa de yin/ de la nga rang bsam 'char gang yang med/yin na yang de 'grub par byed pa la khyed rang tsho'i rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi bya ba dang / tshan rig brtag dpyad kyi bya ba'i rmang gzhi yag po zhig ma tshugs pa dang /tshan rig zhib 'jug yag po ma byas par khungs med rdzun bzo dang / khral mngon sla bcos byas na/ da gin nga phod nas kyang gsungs song / khyed rang tsho yar bon song tsang / rang la mkho yas de tsho mang po bris nas ring du btang /rang la mi dgos pa de tsho thung du btang ba'am/ yang na rtsa ba nas med pa bzos pa de 'dra byas na/ mi lkugs pa zhig yin na'ang rna cog gis thos kyi red la/ mi yon tan can dang / lo rgyus la brtag dpyad byed mkhan phos bltas na khong tsho gad mo shor gyi red/ song tsang / khyed rang tshos rmang gzhi yag po zhig 'dzugs dgos pa las/ dmigs yul de 'grub pa'i ched du rgyu cha mang po zhig bsngogs te gcig bzos pa yin na/ de ni bye ma'i 'og la brgyab pa'i khang pa lta bu zhig yong gi red/ khang pa ni rmang gzhi brtan po zhig thog rgyag dgos shing / bye ma'i thog la khang pa brgyab na sa yom phran bu brgyab pa dang khang pa lug 'gro ba dang /sa yom ma brgyab kyang ljid ma theg par khang pa yo 'gro gi red/ de 'dra song tsang /bod yig thog le tshang mas thugs gzab gnang rogs gnang zhes zhu rgyu yin/zhu don bzhi pa ni/ khyed rang tsho'i da lta'i 'char gzhi'i nang shi'i dzang shing dzang (stod ljongs ) (stod ljongs ) zhes mang po bris 'dug ngas 89

bltas na de 'os po rang mi 'dug khyed rang tsho'i las don ni bod kyi rig pa la zhib 'jug bya rgyu 'di red ma gtogs/ shi'i dzang zer ba'i bod ljongs la zhib 'jug byed pa'i lte gnas shig ma red/ bod rig pa zer ba 'di'i nang bod rigs yongs rdzogs tshud yod/ da lta krung go'i nang phal cher nga hrū bod rigs khri cho bzhi brgya tsam yod cing / de'i nang nas khri nyis brgya tsam bod rang skyong ljongs kyi khongs su 'pho ba skyel kyi yod pa dang / khri nyis brgya zhing chen gzhan bzhi'i nang 'pho ba skyel gyi yod pa red/ song tsang / khyed rang tsho'i de la ngas bltas na shi'i dzang ci'u yan ci'u krung shin zhes bod ljongs zhib 'jug lte gnas min nam snyam/ shi'i dzang zhes bod ljongs rkyang rkyang byas na sa khul gzhan dag tshos bsam 'char 'don gyi red/ khyed rang tshos sa khul lnga po de kun la cha snyoms yag po byed dgos/ yin na'ang bod rigs kyi sa khul lnga'i nang nas bod ljongs gtso bo yin ge ni brjod med red/ bod kyi rig pa zhes pa 'di rang byas tshe dpe bzhag na/ nabrug pa dang / 'bras ljongs/ la dwags de tsho mi rigs kyi thog nas bshad na 'byung khungs bod rigs red/ song tsang / bod rig pa'i nang khong tsho la'ang brtse ba yod pa red/ de dag ngas de ring khyed rang tshor dran gso btang ba yin/ don tshan bzhi pa zhu rgyu de ltar yin// //90

ma 'ongs par kha phyogs skabs lo rgyus kyi nyams myong gtan nas brjed mi rung /(phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 23 nyin/)༄༅༅/ /slo mthun rnam pa dang / grogs po rnam pa/ de ring nga chos 'dir don snying gting zab ldan pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs bzhin yod pa 'di'i thog bzhugs pa'i da res paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa bar gyi sku gdung lhan bzhugs kyi gdung rten bskyar bzhengs zhus pa'i mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal legs grub kyi mdzad sgor rlabs chen gyi rgyal sa pe cing nas phebs mkhan rnam pa dang / krung dbyang gi 'brel yod las khungs khag nas phebs pa'i dbu khrid rnam pa/ bod ljongs kyi rang skyong sa khul gang sa nas phebs pa'i rim pa khag gi tang srid dmag gi 'go khrid blo mthun/ zi khron dang / mcho sngon/ kun su'u/yun nan sogs spun zla'i zhing chen khag nas phebs pa'i zhing chen rim pa'i blo mthun rnam pa dang / zhing chen de dag khongs kyi bod rigs rang skyong khul so so'i 'go khrid slo mthun dang 'brel yod rang skyong rdzong so so'i 'go khrid slo mthun/ de bzhin phyogs gang sa'i 'gan 'khur slo mthun rnam pa bcas/ ngas drang po drang bzhag dang bsam pa rnam dag gi gdan zhu phul don ltar/ chang mas spro sems rab tu chab srid sgor gyi gsung bshad 'di ni/ paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa bar gyi sku gdung mnyam du bzhugs pa'i mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal chen mo gsar bzhengs legs par grub pa'i mdzad sgor bcar mkhan rgya na ga ci/ dpon rigs sogs mtho 'bring mi sna zhugs pa'i bzhugs mol chogs 'du'i 'og rgya skad thog gnang ba zhig red/ (bod sgyur zhus pa yin/)91

'khol ba'i ngang nas lam thag ring ba dang / gnam gshis mi 'phrod pa sogs kyi dka' ngal mtha' dag la gdong len gnang ste/ bod kyi gzhis ka rtse sa khul la phebs nas kha sang dbu 'byed mdzad sgo chen mor dgyes zhugs gnang ba dang /de ring yang bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'di'i thog tshogs zhugs gnang yod pa red/kha sang rnam pa tsho tshang mas dga' spro rab tu brtas pa'i ngang nas gsung ba shad gnang ba dang / yang dran rten gyi don snying ldan pa'i legs mtshan 'bul rten btegs nas gdung rten bskyar bzhengs kyi mdzad sgor rten 'brel gnang bas ma tshad/ de ring yang 'dir tshang mas gsung bshad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnang bar brten/ thog mar nga'i bsam par dus tshod ha cang thung drags 'dug pas cung zad ri nga du gtong dgos min nam snyam pa'i tshor ba shugs drag po zhig byung / gang lags she na/gsung bshad gnang mkhan ha cang mang po yod pa tshang mas brjid bag che zhing don snying ldan pa'i gsung bshad gnang bas yin/ nga la slo mthun rnam pas gsung bshad ha cang legs po dang drang po drang bzhag gnang ba'i zor snang byung / kha sang dang de ring gnyis la/ slo mthun hu'u cin tha'o dang krang hri tso'i rnam pa gnyis kyis tshogs 'du'i thog tu ha cang gal gnad che zhing ya rabs kyi kun spyod dang mthun pa'i gsung bshad gnang ba dang / de bzhin krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u dang ljongs tang ud kyis kyang rnam 'gyur gsal ston dang / khong tshos rnam 'gyur ha cang yang dag pa'i sgo nas lo rgyus kyi kyag kyog mang po zhig gsal bshad gnang ba dang / de dang chabs cig da lta lag len bstar bzhin pa'i lam ston srid byus thad kyang 'grel bshad gnang song / der brten nga rang ni bod ljongs la gtogs pa tsam du ma zad/ bod sa yongs rdzogs la dbang ba'i mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas ha cang sems 'gul thebs pa dang dga' spro chen po byung / ngas gung khran tang gi rjes su 'brangs nas da bar lo 39 song zhing / da lo gung khran tang gi srid dbang bzung nas lo 41 'khor ba'i dus dran la dga' gyon 92

rten 'brel zhu rgyu yin/ (bzhad mo bzhad ) nga 'di 'dra'i mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas ngas gung khran tang la yid ches dang dga' po byed kyi yod/ der brten ngas thog mar nga tsho'i tang krung dbyang la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin rgyal srid spyi khyab khang dang 'go khrid blo mthun rnam pa bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ bod ljongs kyi dbu khrid slo mthun dang / krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi dbu khrid slo mthun bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyur ma zad/ da dung 'brel yod bod ljongs mi mang gi 'thus mi sogs phyogs gang thad kyi 'go khrid blo mthun dang /de dang chabs cig spun zla'i zhing chen khag gi 'go khrid sde khag dang 'go khrid blo mthun bcas la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/de ring 'dir dus tshod ha cang thung thung las med pa 'di'i nang ngas 'go khrid rnam pa tsho la deng phyin gyi las ma'i khrod du thugs phan sos pa'am/ yang na zur lta'i dpyad gzhi gnang chog pa dang / dza drag kyang yin pa bcas kyi gnad don kha shas zhu rgyu yin/ yin na yang nga la 'das pa'i dus skabs nang byung ba'i yid du mi 'ong ba'i gnad don bgrang rgyu dang / yang na 'das pa'i dus tshod nang don gnad kha shas thog grub 'bras chen po thon song zhes bstod bsngags gtong ba'i skad cha bcas de gnyis ka bshad 'dod med/ yid du mi 'ong ba'i skad cha bshad 'dod mi 'dug la/ ha cang yid du 'ong ba'i skad cha'ang bshad 'dod mi 'dug gang lags she na/ de dag tshang ma 'das zin pa'i don dag yin pas red/ 'das pa'i don dag legs po yod na'ang 'das tshar ba red/ legs po med na'ang 'das tshar ba red/ da lta nga tsho'i bshad bya ni ma 'ongs par kha phyogs stangs dang deng phyin gyi las don thog la kha phyogs stangs de yin/ 'di ni dngos yod ring lugs pa dang dngos gtso ring lugs pas gal cher brtsi gi yod/ der brten deng phyin gyi las ga'i khrod du lo rgyus kyi nyams myong bslab bya brjed mi rung / nga tshor dga' 'os pa'i rgyal kha'i nyams myong yod la/ sems pham yid chad skye ba'i pham 93

nyes kyi nyams myong bslab bya yang yod/ nga tsho'i krung dbyang nas sa gnas bar gyi slo mthun mang che bas lo rgyu sa kyi bslab bya dang len byas te cung zad spyang du dang go rtogs mtho ru song yod/ 'on kyang skabs re mi kha shas kyis lo rgyus kyi dngos byung de dag rmi lam thengs gcig rmis pa ltar gting brjed 'gro gi yod par ma zad/skabs rer nad rnying bskyar log kyang rgyag gi yod pa dang / nad rnying bskyar slog brgyab rjes de dang 'dra ba'i bskyar zlos kyi nor 'khrul yong gi yod pa red/ mi zhig la mtshan na nor 'khrul med pa'i mi ni mi srid pa lta bu yin/ nor 'khrul med pa'i mi ni 'das pa'i dus nas da bar byung med la/ phyin chad kyang 'byung mi srid/ nga rang gi ngos nas bshad kyang de sngon nor 'khrul mang po shor myong la / phyin chad kyang nor 'khrul mi yong ba'i khas len ngas zhu mi thub/ 'on kyang bskyar zlos rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul mi 'byung ba'i ched du 'bad brtson byed dgos pa ste/ 'das pa'i dus su nor 'khrul shor myong ba de slar yang bskyar zlos kyi nor 'khrul shor na de ni chab srid pa zhig gi ngos nas bshad na ha cang mi 'os pa'i gnas tshul yin/ der brten slo mthun rnam pa tshos nga'i lta stangs 'di 'grig gi 'dug dang mi 'dug dgongs pa'i dpyad gzhi gnang rogs zhes zhu rgyu gcig 'di yin/gnyis pa/ nga tsho bod ljongs kyi bod mi gnas yu/la so sor 'phrad pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig tu gyur yod ce na/ dngos yod gnas tshul dang po ni bcis 'grol btang ba nas dus da lta bar du nga tsho yar rgyas phyin yod dam zhe na yar rgyas phyin yod pa red/ yar rgyas ji tsam phyin yod pa red dam zhe na ha cang legs po phyin yod pa red zer dgos pa zhig byung yod/ 'di ni dngos yod gnas tshul red/ yin na yang nga chos rlos btang ba'i gyong gun gyi rin thang dang / grub 'bras gnyis bsdur nas bshad tshe nga'i bsam tshod byas na blos btang ba'i gyong kun gyi rin thang che ba yod pa red/ nga zor thob pa'i grub 'bras kyi rin thang de gyong gun gyi rin thang las che ba byung yod pa ma red/ 'dis ga re 94

brjod kyi yod pa red dam zhe na/ deng phyin chad nga phos rtsa ba nyid nas de lta bu'i bskyar zlos kyi nor 'khrul yang bskyar brtsam mi rung zhes brjod kyi yod pa yin/der brten nyin ma de ring nas bzung nga zos g.yon thal che ba'i nor 'khrul gyi las tshog rtsa ba nas brtsam rgyu med la/ phyogs mtshungs nga phros g.yas thal che ba'i stor 'khrul gyi las ka yang brtsam rgyu med/ 'on kyang bod ljongs kyi bod rigs sa khul la mtshon na g.yon gyi nor 'khrul gyi gtor skyon nyen tshabs de g.yas kyi nor 'khrul gyi gtor bcom nyen tshabs las che ba byung yod pa red/ gang lags she na / rang re'i rgyal khab ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi thog ma'i dus skabs su gnas yod pa dang / bod rigs sa khul ni thog ma'i yang thog ma'i du sdo skabs su gnas yod pa red/ nga tsho ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs nas der slebs pa zhig red/ krung go'i bod sa khul thog ma'i dus skabs su gnas yod zer dgos don ni/ khong hrū bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin phyed tsam dang mi ser spel yul phyed tsam gyi spyi tshogs nas der slebs par brten tshad mtho ba yod pas zhig ma'i gnas skabs zhes brjod chog pa red/ kho tsho dang bsdur na nga tsho cung zad rjes su lus te thog ma'i yang thog ma'i dus rim dus gnas yod/ 'di 'dra'i dus skabs su nga tshos sgrub thub thabs med pa'i g.yon thal che ba'i las don bsgrubs pa yin na gnod skyon 'byung rgyu nges can yin/ mi mang gi bsam slo ngos 'dzin gyi nus pa 'i thog nas bshad na g.yon lhung gi bya bas bslangs pa'i zug gzer de g.yas lhung gi bya bas bslangs pa las kyang che ba byung yod pa red/ der brten sngon chad nga tshos g.yon gyi nor 'khrul yo bsrang byed myong yod mod/ da dung nga'i bsam chod byas na g.yon gyi gnod skyon 'gog rgyu gtso bzung byas thog g.yas kyi gnod skyon yang 'gog dgos pa 'dug yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ g.yas kyi nor 'khrul gyi ngo bo de log spyod yin pa'i kha bral gyi bya gzhag la 'gyur ba byung ba yin na nga tsho sa nges par 95

du slo rtsa brtan po'i sgo nas ngo rgol dang 'gog gnon byed dgos pa yin/ deng phyin gyi bya ba'i nang nga tshos rgyal gces ring lugs kyi dar cha ma/thon por bsgrengs te so so'i gces pa'i mig nang bzhin mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur dang mi rigs kyi mthun sgril srung skyob byed dgos pa yin/ de yang thog mar rgya mi rigs dang bod mi rigs kyi bar mthun sgril byed dgos/ de bzhin mi rigs gzhan dag bar mthun sgril byed stangs dang / bod rigs nang khul bar mthu na sgril byed stangs ba cas rnam dbye gsal por 'byed dgos/ de ring nga la ha cang dga' spro'i sar snang zhig yong gi 'dug gang lags she na 'di ni mthun sgril gyi rgyas 'dzoms tshogs 'a du zhig yin pas red/ sngon chad nga tso bod pa na nga khul yang 'di 'dra 'i mthun po zhig min/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig la brtsi mthong mi byed par bod pa (dbus gtsang pa ) tsho'i snang bar khams pa dang a mdo 'gro gi med la/ yang khams pa dang a mdo ba'i snang bar bod pa hrū 'gro gi med/ de bzhin bod pa'i nang du yang dbus pas gtsang pa snang bar 'gro gi med la/ gtsang pas dbus pa snang bar 'gro gi med/ de dag ni glang dar ma'i rjes su bod khams sil bur sgo ra nas lo 311 lhag tsam song ring lung tshan khag so sor gyes nas bsdad pa'i lo rgyus las byung ba zhig yin zhing / nga tsho'i mi rigs 'dir sa phyogs rang bzhin dang / kher sdod rang bzhin gyi bsam bro'i shugs rkyen chen po yod/ de lta bu'i bsam slo gtong stangs 'dis nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi yar rgyas dang / nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi gong 'phel/ nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi mdun lam bcas la 'gog rkyen bzo gi yod pas nga'i ngos nas bsam slo gtong stangs de la mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byed bzhin yod/ nga tsho'i mi rigs nang khul tshang ma mthun po med pas/ mi rigs nang khul tshang ma mthun sgril yong ched 'bad brtson byed dgos yin/ de dang chabs cig nga tsho ni kru twa mi rigs kyi cha shas shig yin pas spun zla'i mi rigs gzhan bar gyi mthun sgril srung skyob dgos pa dang / lhag par rgya mi rigs bar 96

gyi mthun sgril srung skyob byed dgos/ der brten mi rigs mthun sgril 'di khag gsum du dbye chog pa ste/ bsam slo gcig gyur rgyun 'khyongs yong bar byed ched ang dang po bod rgya mi rigs kyi mthun sgril dang / ang gnyis pa nga mo bod rigs dang grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan bar gyi mthun sgril/ ang gsum pa nga cho bod rigs nang khul gyi mthun sgril bcas yin/de ring nga tsho bod rigs kyi sa khul khag tshang ma'i 'go khrid slo mthun rnam pa mnyam du 'dzoms na sa chos lugs dang / mi rigs/ lhag par dngos yod chab srid kyi don snying ldan pa'i 'di lta bu'i brjid chags kyi gdung rten gsar bzhengs la thun mong gi thog nas rten 'brel zhu bar phebs mkhan tshang ma mnyam du 'dzoms pa 'di ha cang legs po byung / nyin ma de dag gi ring dmigs bsal gyi spro snang chen po yong gi 'dug nga tsho bod rigs ni da lta'i mtshams 'dir sa khul lnga yod / bod ljongs ni che shos red/ mi 'bor 'phel rgyas ha lam sa ya gnyis zin grabs yod/ sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma khri hrū brgya dang nyi shu yod/ bod rigs kyi sa khul gzhan rnams la khyon mi 'bor khri nyis brgya zin grabs yod cing /nye lam lo shas ring mi 'bor 'phel rgyas che tsam byung yod/ sa cha'i thad phal cher spyi le gru bzhi ma khri brgya yas mas shig zin gyi yod/ bod rigs khyon yongs bsdoms pa'i mi 'bor ni ha lam khri bzhi brgya tsam dang / sa khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma khri tsho nyi brgya yas mas shig red/ mes rgyal thog nas bshad na shin tu gal chen po zhig red/ mi 'bor nyung la sa rgya chen po yod par ma zad/ mes rgyal gyi lto nub nas byang bar 'dzam gling gi mas bod sa mtho'i thog gnas yod par brten sa rgyud dang mes rgyal gyi ngos nas bshad na'ang ha cang gal chen po zhig red/sa cha de 'dra zhig gi da lta'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs dang / rig gnas kyi khyab khongs khag gi thad la ha cang rjes lus thebs yod cing / krung dbyang gis dus mtshams de'i nang nga tshor thugs 'khur bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gnang nas/97

phyogs gang ci'i thad nga tshor rogs ram dang / nga tshor rgyab skyor/ 'phel rgyas bcas btang gnang yod/ yin na'ang rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis skabs 'gar nu pa de tsam thon mi thub pa'i gnad don 'ag ra zhig yod/ da lta sa khul khag lnga lu dbye nas btsugs pa de ni ha cang yag po 'dug sa khul khag lnga po phyogs gcis tu zla bsgril gtong dgos don med/ de'i thad ri phar phyogs (phal cher rgya gar phyogs la go dgos sgyur mkhan gyis ) nas bshad par/ khag lnga po zla bsgril btang nas bod rang skyong sa khul chen po zhig 'dzugs dgos zer/ nga'i bsam slor de 'dra byas na phal cher rgya 'ub bsdus e yong / da khul lnga po 'di srid 'dzin thad khag lnga yin pa'i da lta'i gnas stangs nang bzhin mu mthud bzhag na dga'/des nga tsho'i rgyal khab dang / nga tsho'i mi rigs la phan thogs yod/ phyogs mtshungs ngas brjod dgos pa zhig la sa khul khag lnga po zla bsgril gtong dgos zhes pa'i skad cha de log spyod dang / gsar brjer ngo rgol ba/ ngo log ji red ces zer ba'i shod tshul la nga mos mthun med/ kha gyes nas bsgril/ bsgril nas gyes pa ni lo rgyus thog yod pa zhig red/ 'on kyang da lta'i dus mtshams la bsgril dang ma sgril 'byung 'gyur la blta rgyu red/ da lta bltas na khag lnga ngo de khag so so de rang byed dgos/ yin na'ang sa khul lnga po de mi rigs gcig rang yin pa las mi rigs mi 'dra ba khag lnga ma yin zhing / nga tsho ni mi rigs gcig dang / rigs gcig skad yig gcig chos lugs gcig yin/ goms gshis thog la'ang rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig gyur yin/ 'on kyang 'ga' zhig thad he bag che tsam yod na'ang mang che ba gcig pa yin/ skad lugs de rbad de gcis gyur min pa ni yul skad mi 'dra ba de red/ de'ang kong tung dang pe cing gi yul skad lta bu red/ yul skad de tsho'i thog ya mtshan byed dgos don med/ nge cing gi skad cha shod stangs de kong tung nang rtsa ba nas go mi thub/ phu'u can la de bas rnyog dra chen po red/ der brten nga tshos dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas 98

slob gso'i 'og nges par du phan tshun rogs ram dang / phan tshun skul 'ded gtong dgos/ da lta nga mas phan tshun la lta ska bas tshang mas mor ba ha cang rno po byed kyi 'dug ngas slo mthun de hrū la bslab bya rgyag rgyur/ gnas tshul gyi rbog tu tshor ba rno drags kyi 'dug tshor ba rno drags na yag po yod pa ma red ces pa 'di yin/ dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas/ shes rig slob gso bcas kyi thog nga tsho phan tshun rogs ram bye da dgos/ shes yon slob gso'i thog phan tshun la rogs res byas te lo bcu nyi shu song mtshams nga'i bsam tshod ltar byas tshe nga tshos bod skad brgyab pa 'di bod mi tshang mas gcig gyur go thub pa zhig yong gi red snyam/ da lta nga mos skad cha bshad pa go brda mi 'phrod pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni/ slob gso'i thog tu rang rang so so byas nas phan tshun gcig gyur zhig ma byung ba de red/ nga phos brjod dgos pa zhig la 'das pa'i dus su bod yig gcig gyur du bed spyod byed kyi yod pa red/ dgon pa'i nang chos 'chad nyan byed skabs tshang ma go brda 'phrod nas shes par ma zad/ tha na sogs po tshor yang go brda 'phrod kyi yod/ da lta'i dus su go brda 'phrod kyi yod pa ma red/ sa khul lnga pos bod yig 'bri stangs mi 'dra lnga spyod kyi yod pa dang / pe cing gcig pu la'ang rlung 'phrin las khungs dang / dpe skrun khang / mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/yig sgyur sde tshan bcas khag bzhi lnga zhig yod/ de dag tshang ma bod rigs yin pa gcig gyur yin na'ang rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i bod yig 'bri stangs bzhi lnga zhig spyod bzhin pa red/ de ltar mu mthud nas phyin pa yin na nga tsho'i bod yig 'di ci gang min pa zhig tu 'gyur nyen che bas/ rim pas 'di dag gcig gyur yong thabs su khrims thog gtan 'bebs kyis phan tshun go brda 'phrod pa zhig bzo dgos rgyu bcas shes rig slob gso'i skor la zhu rgyu 'di tsam yin/rig gzhung thog phan tshun brje res byed dgos par ma zad/ dpal 'byor sgog kyang phan tshun skul 'ded dang / phan tshun rogs ram byed dgos/ da lta 99

nga tsho phyi phyogs la sgo mo 'byed pa dang / nang khul dpal 'byor 'khrug tu gtong ba'i tang gi spyi'i lam phyogs 'og skyod bzhin yod/ lam phyogs 'di legs po 'dug gam mi 'dug ce na/ ngas byas na ha cang legs po 'dug nga tsho'i mes rgyal phyi phyogs su sgo mo ma phye na re ba med pas sgo mo nges par du 'byed dgos pa yin 1 da lta mig sngar phyi phyogs su sgo mo 'byed pa'i srid byus lag bstar byed pa'i bya rim nang 'di 'dra dang de 'dra'i gnas tshul lhags pa'i wor brjod na/ de ni rtsa ba'i cha nas khag gnyis su dbye chog pa ste / dang po/ de ni ha cang gal chen zhig yin la g.yol thabs med pa zhig kyang yin/ dpe zhig brjod na/ gal srid khang pa zhig bzo bcos rgyag skabs de'i steng gi dngos po rnams gcig kyang chag skyon med par len dgos brjod na de ni sus kyang byed mi thub pa zhig red/ dngos po de dag las 'di phyogs kyi dngos po kha shas pha gi'i phyogs la spo dgos pa dang /pha gi'i phyogs kyi dngos po kha shas 'di phyogs la lpo dgos pa de 'dra'i brgyud rim nang dngos po kha shas la tan tan chag skyon yong gi red/ dpe de dang 'dra bar de snga dar ma myong ba'i sgo 'byed kyi srid byus shig dngos su lag bstar byed skabs gzhung lugs kyi thog da dung cha tshang ba'i bsam blo'i bgrod rim zhig rnyed med pa red/'dis ga re brjod kyi yod ce na/ 'ol tshod kyis mdun skyod byed kyi yod pa de yin 1 dper na chu bo'i pha rol du 'gro skabasdo/ chu nang gi rdo ga cig gi sgang la rkang pa gcig bzhag rkang pa gcig shos spo sa gzhan zhig btsal nas der spos/ de nas rdo gzhan zhig sgang la rkang pa sgo tsam byas/ skabs re rkang pa sgos sa'i rdo rtsa ba nas ma rnyed pa'i skabs la 'u ting zhes chu'i nang lhung ba de nas yar thon thabs byed pa lta bu yin/ des ma tshad da dung bya ba sgrub rim nang nor 'khrul shor ba yang nyung shas yod/ de tsho kha shas ni bsam gzhigs bya rgyu ma ldang ba dang las ka zhib tshags ma byas pa las byu nga 'dug gang ltar mdor bsdus nas bshad na nga tsho'i grub 'bras ni ha cang chen po yin/ slo mthun rnam pa tsho sgo dbye bsgyur 100

bcos bya rgyur the sam dang g.yo 'gul byed mi rung ba dang / nga mos slo sems ci/na tu brtan po'i sgo nas nga tsho'i bsgyur bcos ni yang dag pa yin par yid ches byed dgos pas ma tshad/ bsgyur bcos kyi dmigs yul yang nges par mngon 'gyur byed thub rgyu yin par yid ches byed dgos pa yin/ tang krung dbyang gi dpa' rma dzangs gnyis ldan gyi dbu khrid 'og tu mu mthud bsgyur bcos kyi lam la zhugs dgos pa dang / nges par du phyi phyogs su sgo mo 'byed dgos pa yin/ 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal khab gang 'dra zhig yin rung phyi phyogs su sgo brgyab na 'dzugs skrun dang dpal 'byor gong 'phel yong thub thabs med/ dpal 'byor thad sgo mo phye rgyu ji tsam rgya che ba dang gting zab pa byung ba de tsam gyi yar rgyas 'gro mgyogs pa yod / der brten phyi phyogs su sgo brgyab nas kher sdod kher rkyang ngang ja 'thung nas sdod pa lta bu byas na mi 'grigs shing nges par phyi phyogs su sgo mo 'byed dgos/yin na'ang sgo mo 'byed pa'i skabs su gnas tshul mang po zhig lhags yod pa red/sanas tshul kha shas kyi thog nga tsho'i krung dbyang gi 'go khrid blo mthun tshos do snang byung yod / de'i thad bsam tshul shugs drag po shod mkhan yang yod pa red/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyis phyi phyogs su sgo mo phyes rjes/ nga sas legs pa'i phyogs mang po zhig la slob sbyong byas te yar rgyas dang sngon thon can gyi dngos po mang po zhig nang 'dren byed thub yod/ yang de dang chabs cig gang byung mang byung mang po zhig kyang slebs yod pa red/ nga tsho la mkho ba ni phyi rgyal gyi tshan rig dang /yar thon/ tshul ldan gyi spyod tshul/ las /ra brtson pa'i sgobs pa/ zhib tshags po'i byed stangs sogs yin pa las/ gang byung mang byung dang / bag med kyi 'tsho ba/ khungs lung med pa'i 'chal spyod sogs thos pa tsam gyis rna bar gzan pa'i ma rabs tha shal gyi bya ba de tsho nga tshor rtsa ba nas dgos mkho med/'on kyang phyogs kha shas thad dgos pa'i legs pa'i cha gang yang bslabs par/ mi dgos pa'i ngan pa'i cha bslab rgyur phyi rgyal gyi mi las 'jon thang che ba yod pa der 101

phyi rgyal gyi mi hrū yang har sangs dgos chags 'dug nga hrū bod pa deng phan ha cang legs po yod/ da lta'i byed stangs 'di mu mthud phyin pa yin na a tsi bod la'ang na tsha slebs srid snyam pa khyed tsho'i bsam blor 'khor dgos pa yin zhes ngas khyed tshor dran skul gtong gi yod/ lhag par du bde 'jags tshan pas 'di'i thog la do snang byed dgos/ rgyal 'dzugs rtsed mo dang / gzhang sang / btsan g.yem byed pa sogs gang byung gi spyod ngan tshang ma 'dzul yong ba 'di dag gis nga tsho'i bod yar rgyas gtong thub kyi red dam/ nan po byed dgos sar nan po nges par du byed dgos/ (phyag gi khu tshur gsol cog la rdeb pa gnang ) nan po byas nas dus tshod nges can song rjes spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags gnas stangs legs bcos yong ba byed dgos/mi nga ni cung zad nan po byed dgos mkhan zhig yin/ de ring slo mthun rnam pas nga sdod sa'i sa khul 'dir mdzad sgo 'tshogs skabs sgrig 'dzugs dang sne len zhu stangs sogs gang 'dra yod med gzigs zhib gnang rogs gnang / nga la mi mang po med kyang tshang mas nga'i kha la nyan te gang byung bye da mkhan med par brten phyogs 'du tshogs rgyur nus pa mi dman pa zhig thon yod/ gal te de 'dra min par sne len pa zhig gis sku mgron la kha rtsod byas pa'i gnas tshul bstan rgyu yod na bstan rogs gnang / ngas lam seng tshogs 'du 'di rang thog gnas dbyung btang chog 'go khrid byed mkhan ltos skabs re nan po byed dgos sar nan po byed dgos/ 'on kyang / nan po byed pa 'di la bsdur tshad nges can zhig dgos pa yin/ nan po byed pa 'di bsdur grangs kyi brgya cha lnga las brgal mi rung ba dang / 'jam po byed pa sa brgya cha dgu bcu zin pa byed dgos/ 'di lta bu'i bsdur tshad 'jog pa ni khyon yongs kyi 'go khrid byed stangs shig yin/ gal srid nan po byed rgyu ha cang mang drags na tshang ma zhed nas bros te so so gcig pu dze kher rkyang dpon po chags rgyu yin pas de 'dra byed mi rung / gal che shos 102

brgya cha dgu bcu nas go lnga bar gyi dus skabs nang mi la gdung sems mnyam bskyed dang rogs ram 'go 'don bcas byas na legs po yong nges yin/ yang ma rabs 'phag 'tshag rgyag mkhan mang sar nan po brgya cha bcu byed dgos kyang byas te ma rabs byed phod pa'i slo khog ji tsam yod med bltas na/ spyi tshogs dang sde khag gcig gi nang nas de'i nus pa mgyogs myur mngon thub rgyu red/da lta'i gnas skabs la nga tsho cung zad rjes lus yin/ der brten deng phyin nga tsho krung dbyang gi bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i lam gyi thog tu shar skyod byed dgos zhes zhu rgyu gcig 'di yin/ 'on kyang shar skyod byed pa'i skabs su nga mor dka' ngal mang po zhig 'phrad kyi yod/ mtsho 'gram sa khul gyi yar rgyas ha cang mgyogs po yin pas nga tsho rgyug nas phyin na'ang kho mos zhon pa'i phyi rgyal gyi rta chen rkang pa ring po de tsho'i rjes nga tsho'i rtas ga la zin khong tsho thag thag thag thag thag ces spo na la shor 'gro gi red/ nga chos zhon pa ni rta thebs chag gam yang na bong bu na/na pas ji tsam rgyug kyang kho tsho'i rjes zi na mi thub/ lo de dag ring nga tsho dang 'o tsho'i bar gyi he bag ni chen po yin pa las chung chu nga zhig min/ ngas bltas na hai bag 'di 'dra yong ba ni rgyun ldan gyi gnas tshul yin/ nga tshos gzhan tsho yar rgyas 'gro ba'i dngos yod gnas stangs la gnon shugs sprad nas bkag 'gog byed mi thub/ yin na yang nga tshos gsal po shes dgos pa ni/ so so rang nyid kyi skang par sbyong brdar sprad nas cung gom pa che tsam dang mgyogs tsam slo thub pa byas de khong tsho'i rjes zin thub pa byed dgos/ de min nga tshos khor mor khyed chos nga cho cung zad sgug rogs/ kong tung sogs mtsho 'gram gyi sa khul tshor nga tsho cung zad sgug rogs/ nga tshos lo shas ring hur brtson byas te nga tsho'i bar gyi he bag chung du gtong rgyu yin/ zhes bshad nas yong thabs yod pa ma red/ nga mos ga re bshad rung khong tsho nga tsho las yar rgyas 'gro snga ba yin/ da lta nga tshos u tshugs brgyab ste khong tsho'i rjes zin pa'i yar rgyas yong ba'i 'bad brtson byed dgos pa yin/103

gal de yar rgyas yong ba'i 'bad brtson ma byas na/ lo shas kyi rjes su nga tsho'i bar he bag dngos gnas bsam yul las 'das pa zhig yong nges yin/dpal 'byor dang rig gzhung gi he bag chen po 'di chab srid 'gan len gyi gnad don dang 'brel ba yod/ nga tsho dang mthun sgril yag po med pa dang nga tsho dgra bor ngos 'dzin byed mkhan gyi mi mang po zhig gis he bag 'di bzung nas sngon thon gyi sa khul dang de'i nye 'gram gyi sa khul bar la dkrug shig rgyag gi yod/ sngo na thon mi rigs dang rjes lus mi rigs kyi bar dang / de yang gsal po bshad na rgya mi rigs dang nga mo grangs nyung mi rigs bar dkrug shing rgyag gi yod pa red/phyogs de dag gi thad krung dbyang gi ngos nas dmigs bsal gyi thabs lam 'os 'tshams la brten nas 'dzin skyong byed dgos pa las/ tshang ma gris btub pa ltar gyi srid byus 'dzin mi rung / gris gtub pa ltar byas pa'i rjes su gzhan gyi thabs shes gang yang bya rgyu bsdad med/ 'di'i nang lcags phor nang gi kha lag skor yang tshud yod/ dpe mtshon zhig brjod na/ nga tsho'i 'dir shes yon ldan pa'i ched las pa krang ga ge mo zhu ba zhig yod/ khong gis gsungs don/ ba smro zhig la skyes pa'i be'u yang gzugs stobs bzang zhan gcig mtshungs shig min pas/gzugs stobs zhan pa'i be'u la gzan chas mang tsam ster nas ma gsos tshe 'tsho bcud ma ldang pa'i rkyen gyis be'u shi 'gro ba dang / de bzhin drel phrug yin na yang skyo ba de shi 'gro gi yod/ gzugs stobs legs pa de hrū sha zhed rgyas sla po yong zhes gsungs myong / dpe de dang gnas lugs gcig mtshung ltar nga tso rjes lus yin pa phor lcags kyi phor pa'i nang gi kha lag tog tsam dgos/ de yang gsal po bshad na nga mor chab srid thog dmigs bsal lta skyong dang / dpal 'byo ra thog rgyab skyor/ phyogs gang thad kyi rogs ram gnang rgyu bcas ni ngas bltasan ha cang tshul dang mthun pa zhig red snyam gyi yod/'on kyang 'das pa'i lo bcu phrag kha shas ring nga chos las ka ma byas par 'cho 104

ba gzhan la brten pa'i rkyen gyis bsam blor goms gshis ngan pa zhig 'jags yod cing / dngul rdzogs skabs krung dbyang la slong mo rgyag par 'gro gi yod/ slong mo rgyag skabs mi rigs kyi dar cha mthon po bsgrengs nas nga tsho bod ljongs zer ba'am/yang na bod rigs sa khul gyi ming khyer te de ga'i mi ser rnams ji ltar dbul phongs yin pa dang / khong phos rnyog dra 'di 'dra da nga de 'dra bshad kyi 'dug zer ba sogs rgyu mtshan mang po bgrangs nas dngul len gyi yod/ phyir log rjes dngul de dag mi ser tshor mi spyod par rang nyid kyi khang pa rgyag gi yod pa red/ da lta 'di 'dra byed mkhan dpon po'i rigs la ming ngan zhig btags 'dug pa ni/ bong bus dpon po byas pa zer ba'am ming zhig 'dug pa ngas gsal po dran ma song / gang ltar 'di ni ha cang gnad 'gag chags yod/nga rang sdod sa'i khang pa 'di ha cang legs po yod kyang / 'di la shod rgyu gang yang med/ 'di ni rig gnas gsang brje chen po'i gong du brgyab pa yin/rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i rjes su ngas nyams gso phran bu byas pa las khang pa gsar pa brgyab med/ nga'i khang pa'i nang gi me thab de'i tshab tsha slog gi sgrig chas btsugs na yag po yod pa red gsung mkhan 'dug yin na'ang ngas da bar sdod shag nang tsha slog gi sgrig chas btsugs med/ 'khyags dus sa snum blugs snod chen po zhig la i khung phug nas me bsro gi yod/ nga lkugs drags nas tsha slog sgrig chas me thab las legs pa yod pa ma shes pa min/ de gnyis kyi khyad par nga'i klad pa'i nang gsal zhing gsal ba yod/ 'on kyang ngas bod gang sa can ljongs kyi yul 'di la bsam klo gtong dgos pa las/ thog mar rang nyid kyi don dag bsgrub mi rung bsam gyi yod/ 'dis gang zhig brjod kyi yod ce na/ rang nyid kyi don dag bsgrub rgyu ang dang por 'jog mi rung ba dang / thog mar gzhan gyi don dag kha shas bsgrub dgos pa de yin/ de ltar bsgrubs pa la brten nas tshang ma'i gnas stangs cung zad legs su song mtshams gzhi nas rang nyid kyi khyim 105

la sgrig chas sgrig gi yin na/ de ni zla ba kha shas nang las sla por 'grub thub pa yin / nga lkugs drags nas tsha slog gi sgrig chas kyis me thab la 'gran mi thub bsam gyi med/ tsha slog gi sgrig chas ni dngos ga nas me thab las legs pa yod pa red/ 'on kyang de'i thad 'gro gron nyung tsam dang las ka bya rgyu mang tsam byas na bsam pa byung / nga ni rang re'i mi rigs 'di las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa zhig yin par yid ches yod/ 'on kyang las brtson dpa' ngar 'di la skyon zhig yod pa mthong gi 'dug nga tsho bod mi rigs kyis skabs re gang 'dra byed kyi 'dug ce na/ rang nyid lto chas grod pa 'grangs pa zhig dang lus po ma 'khyags tsam byung na des 'dod pa khengs sla ba'i skyon ha cang shugs chen po 'dug da lta'i spyi phyogs 'di'i nang 'gran rtsod byed dgos pa dang / mdun masangs byed dgos/ pa yin/ de ltar byas nas mtho tshad nges can zhig la slebs rjes da dung mu mthud mdun mchongs byed dgos/ de ltar byas pa yin na sngon thon mi rigs kyi gral la slebs thub/ mdor bsdus nas bshad na nga tsho ni las la brtson zhing snying rus che ba dang / rnam dpyod ldan pa/ mgo ha cang grung po yod pa bcas shig yin dku las/ nga tsho lkugs pa min/ yin na yang shes rig slob gso dang dpal 'byor de 'dra'i thog nga tsho phan tshun rogs ram byed dgos zhes zhu gi yod /phyogs gzhan nas 'dir krung dbyang gi 'go khrid blo mthun dang / mi rigs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don thog rkang 'gan bzhes mkhan blo mthun rnam pa hrū bcas phebs yod pa red/ ngas 'dir tshig kha shas zhus na/ bod ljongs la krung dbyang nas rogs ram dang dmigs bsal lta skyong gi srid byus mang po zhig lag len gnang bzhin yod kyang / de lta bu'i thob thang bod rigs kyi sa khul gzhan rnams la 'thob kyi med pa red/ tshang ma gcig mtshungs gnang ma thub kyang slo mthun rnam pa tsho'i thugs la nges par 'jags pa gnang rogs/ bod ljongs gcig pu la thugs 'khur gnang ste bod rigs kyi sa khul gzhan rnams la thugs 106

'khur cung zad ma gnang na de ni ha cang drang bden dang spyi snyoms shig ma red/'on kyang bod ljongs kyi thog gnas tshul kha shas bshad rgyu yod pa red/ gang lags she na/ da lta nga tshos bod ljongs dbul phongs red ces brjod kyi yod pa red/ bod ljongs kyi 'di lo'i spyi'i yongs 'bab de zi khron (zhing chen ) gyi rang skyong khul gnyis kyi yong 'bab dang ha lam gcig mtshungs chags yod/ thon 'bab 'byu rigs yin na'ang 'dra tshang ma ha lam 'dra mnyam chags yod/ khong tsho (zi khron )nyung ba yin na'ang khong tsho'i sa khul la lhags pa'i gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i tshabs chen po min/ rjes su bod ljongs yar rgyas phyin mtshams kyang dung nga tshor gzhan gyi rogs ram dang / dmigs bsal lta skyong gi srid byus dgos pa yin/ ngas gong du da lta nga tsho'i 'das pa'i dus kyi sgyid lug gi skor bshad yod/ phyin chad nga tshos sgyid lug bya rgyu med/ nga mos 'das pa'i dus tshad nang gzhan gyi rngul khrab/ kho nar brten te krung dbyang nas dngul bslangs yod / phyin chad nga tsho rang nyid kyi rngul khrag 'don dgos shing / rngul khrag ma bton na 'grig gi ma red/ nga chos rang nyid kyi rngul khrag bton nas 'bad brtson chen po byas te spyi phyogs kyi rgyu nor gsar gtod byed dgos pa dang / so so rang nyid yar rgyas gong 'phel yong ba byed dgos pa las/ gong rim gyi dngul kho nar cha tshang snyes nas sdod rgyu med/ rgyal khab ni mi mang du phyur bcu la kha gtad gcog dgos kyi yod/ der brten tshang mas rang mi rigs kyi gdeng slobs dang / yid ches/ yar thon/rang srung bcas kyi bsam blo gtong rgyu ha cang gal chen po yin/ nga tshos nges par du rang gis rang la yid ches byed dgos pa dang / mi rigs gzhan gyis bsgrub mi thub pa'i las ka nga mos sgrub thub pa byed dgos pa las a nga mos yong gi ma red nga tshos yong gi ma red ces brjod rgyu med/ nga tshos mi yong ba ga re red dam/ nga mo la mig gnyis dang / rna ba gnyis/ lag pa gnyis/ rkang pa gnyis bcas gzhan dang gcig pa yod pa red/ der brten nga mos rang nyid 107

la yid ches dang / nges par du yar bon yong ba byed dgos/ deng sang slo mthun kha shas kyis de tsam yar thon yong thabs mi byed par/ zhogs pa langs pa nas bzung dgong mo ma nyal bar chang 'thung ste sdod kyi yod/ las khungs tshugs dus dang grol dus gnyis la tho bkod par skyod tsam byas/ de rjes ma chang gi rtse mo rtsed du 'gro ba'am/ yang na ja mngar mo'i nang 'dzul nas ja 'thung ste sdod kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra byas na 'grig gi red dam ma red/ nga tsho'i zla re'i phogs dngul ni mi mang gi rngul khrag yin pas/ dka' las ma ba rgyab ne ga la 'grigs/'di 'dra sems kyi bzod kyi 'dug gam/ spyir btang nga'i zla phogs cung zad mtho po yod rung de mtshungs kyi las ka yang gla phogs las mi nyung ba zhig byed dgos kyi yod / slo mthun kha shas ni 'di dang 'dra gi med/ tshang mas nges par 'bad brtson byed dgos/ de bzhin tshang mas srog dang bsdos nas 'bad 'bungs byas pa yin na/ lo gsum nas lnga'am bcu'i nang nga tsho'i dbul phongs rjes lus kyi rnam pa rtsa ba nas 'gyur mi thub kyang gang 'tshams kyi blta bzo yod pa zhig yong nges yin / da dung lo bcu phrag kha shas dang / tha na brgya phrag kha shas 'bad brtson byed dgos pa yin/ gal te de ltar ma byas na/ da lta'i bod ljongs kyi gnas tshul gang 'dra yod ce na/ nga rang na ning zla ba dang po dang da lo'i zla ba dang por 'dir slebs pa'i mthong tshul gnyis bsdur nas bltas na/ mi'i sems khams bde thang gi dpal yon rnam pa na ning las zhan du song yod pa'i sar snang byung /'di ltar lo re nas lo re zhan du zhan du phyin pa yin na/ nga tsho lhung sa gang 'dra zhig la lhung nas zags sa gang 'dra zhig la zags rgyu red dam/ ngas hru'u ci gsar pa'i 'go khrid 'og tu nga rang thengs rjes ma yong skabs mi mang gi sems khams bde thang gi dpal yon rnam par 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung ba mthong thub pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/ dngos po'i dpal yon gyi rnam pa bsgyur bcos gtong rgyur dus tshod dgos shing / nga tshos de sngon lo gnyis nang thog ma'i kya ra rgyas kyi rnam pa mthong thub 108

pa dang / lo lnga par gang dang gang bya rgyu sogs dmigs tshad mang po zhig bton yod pa ma red dam/ (zhes sku gam gyi mi la bka' 'dri gnang /) dngos po'i dpal yon yar rgyas gtong rgyu de 'dra'i las sla bo zhig min/ nga'i bsam par thog mar sems khams bde thang gi rnam par yin gcig min gcig legs bcos yong ba zhig byed dgos snyam gyi 'dugade ring ngas bshad rgyu'i skad cha ha cang mang drags song / mjug tu ngas mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gyi skor la tshig 'ga' shas zhu rgyu yin/ bod kyi sa khul 'dir kha sang mdzad sgo 'tshogs skabs sgro sems 'khol ba'i rnam pa yag po zhig mthong rgyu yod kyang / mi kha shas kyis dkrog gtam bshad nas kha sang gi rnam pa de lta bur yang gtor bshig gtong gi yod pa red/spyir btang byas na gtor bshig gtong thub thabs med la/ gang yang byed thub med / chos kho na byas nas sdod pa'i mi rigs shig 'di 'dra'i yag po yod pa'i skabs su/ khong tshos nga tsho'i thog dkrog gtam bshad nas gtor bshig gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang red dam/ lha sar zing cha langs yod pa ma red la/rgyal rtse ra yang langs yod pa ma red/ gzhis ka rtse la zing cha slong mkhan de bas byung med/ 'on kyang sa khul de dag la zing cha langs rgyu red ces de 'dra'i dkrog gtam shod mkhan gyi mi zhig dngos gnas byung yod pa red/ da dung des ma tshad dkrog gtam ga re khyab kyi yod ce na/ chos lugs kyi dus chen dang mi rigs kyi dus chen nam yin la zing cha thengs re dang / lo re'i zla 3 tshes 10 nyin gzhi rgya che ba'i zing cha thengs gcig de nas dus tshod 'tsha mas shos kyi go skabs dang bstun nas me ma/das drag chas spras pa'i mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi zing cha thengs gcig slong gi red zer ba sogs kyi skad cha ha cang mang po zhig shod kyi yod pa red/der brten nga tshos nges par du mthun sgril byed dgos pa dang / nges par du nga 'i mes rgyal gyi mtha' nas bskor te mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur srung skyob byed dgos/109

nga hrū bod ljongs dang bod rigs sa khul gzhan dag bcas tshang ma mes rgyal dang rgyab 'gal du phyin na nga sar mdun lam med la/ nga tsho'i mi rigs la'ang mdun lam med/ der brten nga phos mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur la srung skyob byed dgos pa dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs sdon rgyag dgos/ de'i thad nges par nga tsho'i dar cha gsal po dgos pa yin/ ngas tshogs 'du 'di'i thog dang de min gyi phogs 'du khag gi thog dar cha gsal ston gyis kha bral la ngo rgol dang mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur la srung skyob byed kyi yod/ der brten mi zhig gis nga la thugs gzab cung zad gnang dang / khyed kyi bka' mol nang ha cang dmar rjen gsung rgyu mang drags kyi 'dug cung zad 'jam po dang go rgyu yod pa zhig gsung na ma 'grigs pa ci yod/ nyung tsam gsung na'ang ma 'grigs pa ci yod ces brjod byung / ngas rtsa don rang bzhin gyi gnad don shod skabs 'di ltar drang po drang bzhag 'od dgos pa las chal le chol le bshad pas 'grigs thabs med/ ngas nges par du dar cha gsal ston byed kyi yod/ der brten slo mthun rnam pa'i yul phyogs so so nas mes rgyal gcig gyur srung skyob dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon / rang re'i rgyal khab kyi mtha' nas skyor rgyu/ rang re'i rgyal khab 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu sogs kyi thad nges par du tang krung dbyang dang gcig gyur rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa dang / rgyal yongs mi rigs khag gi mi mang gi phyogs su langs dgos zhes ngas re ba zhu rgyu'i phyogs gcig 'di yin/phyogs gnyis nas zhu rgyu ni/ nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi rang skyong skor yin/'di'i thad klo mthun kha shas kyis gsung bshad gnang song / de dag ni dngos dngos rjen rjen du gnas pa'i gnad don zhig red/ da lta'i gnas skabs kyi nga tsho'i mi rigs rang skyong ni de tsam cha tshang ba zhi ga ma red/ gnad don mang po zhig gi thog rang skyong gi ming tsam las don dngos thog med pa red/ gnas stangs 'di la nges par du 'gyur ba gtong dgos pa yin/ gnad don 'di'i thad 110

slo mthun kha shas bsam tshul mthun po yong gi med/ goms srol du chags pa'i 'das pa'i dus kyi srid byus tshang ma'i nang 'dra mnyam gcig gyur zhes bshad nas gcig gyur la phab pa'i gong rim gyi bka' dang / gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid/ gcig gyur gyi bkod sgrig gcig gyur gcig gyur gcig gyur gcig gyur gcig gyur zhes de ltar gcig gyur rkyang rkyang bshad nas nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi rang skyong 'di gcig gyur gyi 'og med pa bzos na 'grig gi ma red/ nga mos bod rang btsan la ngo rgol dang kha bral la ngo rgol byed par nga mor bca' khrims kyis sprad pa'i rang skyong gi thob thang de dag nges par du lag bstar don 'khyol bye da da gos pa yin/ de 'dra ma byas na ga nas 'grig gi red dam/ mi rigs shig la so so'i skad dang yi ge rtsa ba brtan po yod pa 'di tsam bed spyod gtong rgyu'i dbang cha med pa gang yin nam/ dus tshod gang 'tsham song ba'i sngon du lha sar bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i slob phrug tshos bod yig bed spyod byed pa'i rang dbang dgos zhes skad brgyab yod pa red/ kho tshos re ba zhu ba'i thabs lam gyi byed stangs de la nga tshos bstod bsngags byed thub kyang / kho zos bton pa'i re ba ni tshul dang mthun pa zhig red/ 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i gnas tshul sa khul gzhan la'ang byung mi 'dug gam / mtsho sngon la byung mi 'dug gam/ yig cha bkram pa sogs de 'dra'i gnas tshul yin su'u dang / zi khron la'ang byung mi 'dug gam/ bod rigs sa khul khag tu bod yig bed spyod bya rgyu'i thad kyi gnas tshul 'di yag po mi 'dug la / sa cha kha shas la de bas kyang yag po byung mi 'dugabod kyi gnad don mang po'inang nas mi rigs kyi las byed pa nges par ha cang yag po dgos pa'i slor de sngon 1987 lo'i zla 10 par lha sar zing cha thengs dang po langs skabs nga rang mtsho sngon la yod/ mtsho sngon nas thon khar ngas zhing chen rim pa'i 'go khrid blo mthun dang zhing chen srid gzhung gi 'go khrid blo mthun slo dang mnyam du tshogs 'du chung chung zhig tshogs pa de'i thog 'di ltar bshad yod/111

mi rigs kyi las byed par nges par phyogs gnyis kyi cha rkyen tshang dgos/ dang po / chab srid thog nas yid rton 'pher ba dang / tang gi kha la nyan pa/ tang gi 'go khrid srung skyong / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam la bskyod rgyur dga' ba la sogs dang / gnyis pa/ rang gi mi rigs la brtse dung yod pa dang / rang mi rigs kyi las ka yag po bsgrub thub pa/ rang mi rigs kyi tshab mtshon pa dang mgrin tshab pa byed thub pa/ rang mi rigs kyi snying stobs mtshon thub pa bcas dgos pa yin/ de 'dra'i cha rkyen tshang ba'i las byed yin na gzhi nas tang gi mi rigs kyi las byed pa yag po zhig la brtsi chog gal te de 'dra'i cha rkyen tshang med na mi rigs kyi las byed de ni rigs rgyud ring lugs la 'gyur 'gro bas de ltar byas na mi 'grigs/ kho'i pa pha bod pa red/ kho'i pa pha kha che red/ kho'i pa pha sog po red zer ba'am/ yang na kho'i a ma 'di dang de red zer ba sogs la brten nas mi rigs kyi dbye ba 'byed pa ni gal chen po ma red la/ rigs rgyud gang yin min yang gnad 'gag ma red/ gtso che shos mi des rang mi rigs kyi tshab byed thub kyi yod med dang / rang mi rigs kyi la las ka yag po bsgrub thub kyi yod med kyi thog nas gdeng 'jog byed dgos pa yin/ gal de ltar byed kyi yod pa yin na/ las byed de'i go gnas spar tshe las byed des gzhi nas tang dang mang tshogs bar dang / srid gzhung dang mang tshogs bar bcas kyi 'brel ba'i thad zam pa lta bu'i nus pa 'don thub nges yin/ gal te de ltar ma byas na/ gnas tshul byung skabs su mi rigs kyi las byed pa phyi la thon nus kyi ma red/ phyi la thon nas rang mi rigs dang mang tshogs kyi gnad don thag gcod mi thub mkhan gyi las byed pa gso skyong byas te gang yong zhes bshad pa yin/ mtsho sngon zhing chen u yon lhan khang gis zin bris bkod te rjes su nang khul dpyad gzhir bkrams par ma zad/ krung dbyang la'ang snyan seng zhus yod pa slo mthun kra'o tse dbyang gis gzigs rjes nga pe cing du 'byor skabs khong gis nga gzigs ma thag 'di ni ha 112

cang yag po 'dug ngas khyed la rgyab skyor yod/ ces gsungs byung / ngas kyang khong la thugs rje che zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang de nas da bar snyan zhu 'di zhal bzhes yod bzhin du rtsa 'dzugs pu'u yis cha tshang ba zhig lag len dngos kyi nang don 'khyol da dung yang ma byas pa'i khar/ mi rigs kyi las byed pa'i tshad gzhi'i skor gyi bsam 'char 'di gang du zhu ru bskyod kyang lan rnying pa bskyar zlos byed pa tsam las gang yang yong rgyu mi 'dug bran g.yog gi gshis spyod ldan pa'i mi dgos mkho yod pa las/ 'jon thang can gyi mi dgos mkho med pa lta bu byas na 'grig gi red dam/ nga tshor mkho ba ni 'jon thang can gyi mi yin pa las bran g.yog gi gshis spyod ldan pa'i mi min/ kha nas lags so lags so dang / thugs rje che zhes brjod rgyur goms pa'i las byed pa de tsho las byed yag pa'i gras yin dang /yang na mkhas mdzangs ldan zhing skad cha thad /ra drang po shod mkhan gyi las byed de tsho las byed yag pa'i gras yin dbye ba ma phye na yong gi ma red/ da lta'i skabs su mi rigs rang skyong zhes pa 'di ming don mtshungs pa zhig dgos pas/ mi rigs kyi las byed pa'i thad kyang rtsa ba'i cha nas 'gyur ba gtong dgos/ yang bsam slo yag po med pa gung khran tang gi dngul blangs te las ka ri phar phyogs kyi las ka byed mkhan dang / kha bral gyi las ka byed mkhan sogs byung na gu yangs gtong rgyu min/ de 'dra'i mi dngos gnas byas na yong srid kyi ma red/ gal te gung khran tang gi dngul blangs nas gzhan gyi las ka byed mkhan dngos 'brel yod pa yin na de la gu yangs gtong thub kyi ma red la/ de 'dra'i mi rigs kyi las byed pa nga tshor dgos mkho med/rnam pa lhan rgyas la ngas gong du zhus pa ni mi rigs mthun sgril gyi skor yin/chogs 'du 'dir zhugs mkhan mang che bar ngas zhus pa'i skad chas spro snang gi tshor ba zhig yong rgyu yin pa nga la yid ches yod/ yin na'ang slo mthun re zung re zung la khas len gnang 'dod yod kyi ma red/ de dag la rim pas dus sad 113

kyi bden dpang byed nges yin/ mi ngas bshad pa'i skad cha yang dag pa yin min dus tshod thung thung nang dpyad bsdur byed dgos don med/ de ring dus tshod dbang gi ngas skad cha mang po zhu thub ma song / mi rigs sa khul rang skyong zhes pa 'di bod rang skyong ljongs la bshad na'ang 'dra/ bod rigs rang skyong khul khag dang rdzong la bshad na'ang 'dra/ nges par du ming don mtshungs pa zhig dgos/ 'di shod dgos don gang yin zhe na/ nga phos bod rang btsan la ngo gol byed kyi yod/khong mos shod bzhin pa'i bod rang btsan ni nga tshos shod bzhin pa'i bod 'di ma yin zhing 1 khong mos bshad pa'i bod rang btsan ni bod mi gnas yul gyi sa khul yongs rdzogs la go gi yod pa red/ 'di klo mthun rnam pa tsho'i thugs la nges pa gnang dgos / khong chos bshad pa'i khyab khongs ngos 'dzin byed yul ni chen po zhig red / nga tsho'i bod yig nang 'khod pa'i bod dang bod chen po zhes pa'i bod chen po de la brjod kyi yod pa red/ der brten nga tshos khong tsho la ngo rgol byed dgos na / nges par du mi rigs kyi sa gnas la rang skyong ming don mtshungs pa shig lag len bstar dgos pa yin/ de dang chabs cig ngas zhu dgos pa zhig la de ring 'dir gtso bo bod rigs kyi sgor zhu gi yod kyang / mi rigs gzhan la'ang gcig mtshungs rang skyong dgos pa red ces brjod rgyu yin/ de ltar byas tshe ga'i nas nga ṣṭharware rgyal khab nang mi rigs tshang ma mthun sgril dang / 'dra mnyam/ phan tshun rogs res bcas yong thub pa dang / nye char u ru su'i nang mi rigs kyi rnyog zing byung ba de 'dra mi yong ba'i sngon 'gog byed thub rgyu yin/ de ltar ma byas na u ru su'i rtog zing de 'dra rgya khyab tu yong nges yin pa 'di ni nga'i bsam tshul yin / don tshan gnyis pa 'dis ga re brjod kyi yod ce na/ lo rgyus kyi 'gul skyod khrod du nor 'khrul gyi bzos pa'i rma kha ni bsam blo'i khyab khongs nas phyi dngos po'i khyab khongs bar gyi phyogs gang sar cung mang po yod pa de yin/mjug tu zhu rgyur/ da res gdung rten bskyar bzhengs kyi las gzhi 'di'i 114

thog nas tang gi srid byus dngos 'brel lag bstar byas pa mtshan pa dang / 'di dang de lta bu'i gnang don mang po zhig gi thog krung u tshang 'dzoms gros phyogs thengs rgasum pa tshogs tshun nas las ka mang po zhig byas yod pa dang / rgyal khab nas 3gro song ha cang chen po btang ste gnad don mang po zhig thag gcod byas yod/ da dung thag gcod bya rgyur lus pa rnams nges par du thag gcod byed dgos/ nga'i re bar chab srid thog gtan 'khel ba'i srid byus lag bstar byed dgos rigs 'phral thag chod po dang mthar phyin pa zhig nges par lag len bstar dgos pa dang / rgyal bab la dka' ngal yod rung gun gsab dngul slog dgos rigs ma sprad na mi 'grigs/ mang cha tshang slog dgos brjod na de ltar yong rgyu khag po yin/ da lta nga tsho'i rgyal spub kyi gnas stangs la yang dka' ngal yod pa red/ der brten nga'i bsam tshul lu rgyal khab nas kyang cung zad sprad/ mi mang nas kyang bsam shes cung zad byas/de ltar phan tshun phyogs gnyis gas bsam she sa gu bshangs byas na yag po yong nges red snyam/ gal te de ltar byas pa yin na gsar du bzos pa'i rma kha drag bskyed byung nas gnad don thag gcod byed thub pa dang / nga tsho'i mi rigs khag tshang rma mthun sgril yag po yong ba/ mi rigs bar gyi 'brel bar rtsa ba'i 'gyur ba yong thub / nga chos tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs tshang mas skad chen po brgyab nas mthun sgril byed dgos pa sogs bshad kyi yod pa red/ ngas krung dbyang gi mi sna tshor nyu rgyu byung / nga tsho bod par skad cha rim pa gsum bshad rgyu'i srol zhig yod/ de 5 nga cha tshang khog pa'i nang nyar te tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs bshad rgyu'i skad cha gcig dang / spyir btang gi mi'i mdun du bshad rgyu'i skad cha gcig grogs bshes blo thub tshor bshad rgyu'i skad cha gcig bcas yod/ der brten tshogs 'du 'phogs ska bas mkhas mdzangs ldan pa dang yang dag pa yin rabs mang po zhig bshad/chogs 'du grol rjes rgyab la 'khang ra'i skad cha mang po zhig shod pa dang / mtha' rma rang nyid dang grogs bshes blo thub tsho mnyam du 'dzoms skabs sdigs mo byed 'go 115

'dzugs par ma zad/ sdug sar log spyod kyi skad cha yang shod kyi yod/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs 'di 'dra'i 'og mi rigs mthun sgril gyi las don la legs phyogs kyi 'gyur ba yong rgyu dngos gnas bshad na khag po yin/ da lta mi kha shas la gnad don gang zhig byung ba de rang la dmigs nas thag gcod byed rgyu'i lta tshul yod kyang / nga ni der mos mthun med/ gnad don gyi 'byung rtsa gtso bo'am rtsa ba'i 'byung rkyen thag gcod ma byas par/ mgo na na mgo sman dang / rkang pa na na rkang pa'i sman btang ba lta bu byas na mi 'grigs/der brten rgyang ring la dmigs nas rtsa ba'i gnad don bcos thabs byed dgos pa yin/ bod sdod las byed klo mthun tshos nges par du sa gnas sa thog gi mi mang la re 'dod ga re yod dang / khong tsho'i sems khams kyi snying rtsa 'phar stangs gang 'dra yod sogs shes pa byed dgos/ phyi lo 1982 lor nga bod la thog mar slebs skabs kyi gnas tshul gang 'dra yin kha sang nga'i gtam bshad nang yod pa der khyed rang ོ do snang byung yod nges yin/ mi kha shas kyis nga bod la yong rgyur dga' bsu byed kyi med kyang bod rigs mi mang gis nga la dga' bsu zhus byung / de dus ngas bshad rgyu byung / bod kyi 'go khrid slo mthun kha shas bod du bsdad nas lo nyi shu sum cu song yod kyang / khong tshos bod pa'i sems khams kyi snying rtsa 'phar stangs gang 'dra yod dus da lta'ang shes kyi med/ skad cha 'di la go rgyu chen po yod pas bod pa'i sems khams kyi snying rtsa 'phar stangs rgyus lon thub pa byed dgos/ nga tshos kha gdangs tshad la mi mang la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu yin zhes brjod kyi yod pa red/ des na bod rigs mi mang ga re bsam gyi yod pa'i skor dpe mtshon chung chung zhig zhus na/ chos lugs ni bod rigs mi mang la mtshon na bla na med pa'i dad mos zhu yul dang / so so'i srog las kyang gces par 'dzin pa'i rtsa che zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang de dag yongs rdzogs rtsa gtor btang ba red/ bya spyod 'di bod rigs mi mang dga' po 116

bzos pa dang / bod rigs mi mang la zhabs 'degs zhus pa yin zhes ga 'dra byas nas shod 'os sam/ nga mos gzhung lugs thog gi gnad don kha shas bod kyi sa khul dang bod kyi mi mang thog u tshugs btsan sbyor byed pa dang / rang gi gnas stangs tshad gzhir bzung nas bod kyi spyi tshogs la tshad 'jal ba bcas byas na 'grig gi ma red/da res rnam pa tsho tshang ma phebs yod pa ltar bod kyi gnas tshul tshang mas gzigs yod pa red/ mi rigs kyi sa khul khag nas phebs mkhan khongasdo/ kyi mang che ba ni bod rigs sa khul khag nas phebs mkhan yin stabs bod mi tshos gang bsam gyi yod mkhyen gyi red/ rgya rigs blo mthun chos 'di skor nges par mkhyen pa gnang dgos / rlo mthun kha shas kyi gsal po mkhyen gyi med na bod kyi khyad cho sa yang snying gang yin gsal po gzigs rogs gnang / bod kyi khyad chos sa bab mtho la gso rlung nyung ba zer ba'i 'di 'dra'i stabs bde po zhig la ngos 'dzin na mi 'grigs/bod kyi khyad chos gtso bo bod mi rigs kyi bsam slo dang / 'du shes 'dzin stangs/spyod lam sogs ngos 'dzin pa dgos/ mi rigs kyi goms gshis dang / chos lugs kyi gnad don dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi gnad don/ zhing 'brog mi mang gi gnad don sogs gang ci'i gnad don dang / de bzhin lu gu rgyud du spel ba'i tang gi srid byus ji bzhin lag len don 'khel byung min dang / thag gcod byung min gyi gnad don bcas kyi thog do snang byas pa yin na/ bod mi mang gi snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gung khran tang la bka' drin che zhu nges yin pa dang /de bzhin rgya mi rigs dang grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan gyi rogs ram gnang bar yang bka' drin che zhu nges yin par ma zad/ de ltar gnang tshe khong tsho'i bar gyi bsam blo'i brtse dung nye ru song nas/ phyin chad mi rigs mthun sgril sra brtan du gnas min gyi nyen kha'i gnas stangs 'dir yar rgyas yong srid pa yin/de ring ngas skad cha bshad rgyu mang drags song / skad cha shod mtshams 'ga' 117

shas la sems tshor shugs che slebs pa'i rkyen gyis skad cha kha shas la tshig skyon byung yod tshe blo mthun rnam pas skyon brjod dang yo bsrang gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin/ ngas bshad pa'i skad cha'i snying don mdor bsdus na/ dang po/ slo brtan 'gyur med kyi ngang gung khran tang gi rjes su 'brangs dgos pa dang / gung khran tang la yid ches slo 'gel byed pa/ gung khran tang gi mtha' skor du ngar lcags las grub pa lta bu'i mthun sgril sra brtan byed dgos pa dang / gnyis pa/ nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi khe phan dang gnad don kha shas snor la rtsod pa rgyag dgos sar rtsod pa rgyag dgos pa dang / skad rgyag dgos sar skad brgyab nas thag gcod yong ba byed dgos pa las 'a ri 'u re'i ngang phyin na mi 'grigs/ nga tsho'i mi rigs la da lta thag gcod byed dgos pa'i gnad don mang po zhig yod pa ste/ chos lugs dang / mi rigs tsho mi mang gi 'tsho ba sogs kyi gnad don rnams tang gi 'go khrid 'og tshang ma mthun sgril rdog rtsa chig sgril ngang rim pas thag gcod byas te/ mtsho bod mtho sgang du gnas/ pa'i bod ljongs dang bod rigs sa khul gzhan dag bcas tshang ma spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon dang dngos po'i dpal yon gnyis ldan gyi phyug 'gyur dang yar rgyas ldan pa'i sngon thon gyi lung pa zhig tu 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/ gsum pa / de ltar 'dzugs skrun byas pa brgyud bod pa rang ngos nas kyang mes rgyal gyi spyi'i 'phel rgyas thad byas rjes 'jog thub pa byed dgos pa bcas yin/de ring bod ljongs gtso bor gyur pa'i bod rigs sa khul gzhan dag bcas kyi 'thus mi lhan 'dzoms gnang ba 'di'i thog ngas skad cha tshig kha shas zhus pa 'di das nor 'khrul red bsam na slo mthun rnam pas skyon brjod gnang rogs/ yang nor 'khrul ma red bsam na so so'i deng phyin gyi lag len khrod du zur blta'i dpyad gzhi gnang rogs/ mtha' don ngas lhag bsam zol med dang spro sems 'khol ba / sems 'gul ches cher thebs pa bcas kyi bsam blo'i thog nas khyed rnam par bla na med pa'i gus 'dud dang kha zhe gnyis med kyi thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin// / /118

chos lugs dang / mi rigs kyi las don thad kyi g.yon thal lam phyogs gtsang sel byed dgos pa dang /sprul sku'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byed phyogs/(phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 24 nyin/)ra༅༅/ paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa bar gyi sku gdung mnyam du bzhugs pa'i mchod khang shar bkris rnam rgyal chos phyogs rab gnas kyi mdzad sgo tshugs pa'i dga' ston 'di'i thog rnam pa lhan rgyas bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ zhan su'u/ yun nan bcas kyi sa khul nas phebs pa'i dgon sde khag gi las sne dang / snyan grags ldan pa'i bla sprul rnam pa bcas la/ ngas thog mar rnam pa tsho sa thag ring po nas 'dir sku gdung gi rten 'brel la phebs par thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / rnam pa tshos sku gdung gsar bzhengs kyi rten 'brel ched du rten 'bul yang gya nom pa bsnams phebs par thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu yin/de ring chos lugs thad tang gi srid byus rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnad don kha shas kyi thog bka' mol zhu rgyu yod/ ngas zhus pa'i rjes la 'thus mi rnam pa hrū rang rang gi dgongs tshul lhag po gsung rgyu yong gi red/ don tshan dang po gang yin zhe na/ sprul sku ngos 'dzin bya rgyu'i skor la rnam pa tshos ha cang thugs 'khur chen chos phyogs skor gyi gsung bshad 'di ni/ paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa bar gyi sku gdung mnyam du bzhugs pa'i mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal chen mo gsar gzhengs legs par grub pa'i mdzad sgor bcar mkhan bod kyi sa khul khag lnga'i chos phyogs kyi mi sna dang / dpon rigs bcas zhugs pa'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog bka' gnang ba zhig red/ (gsung par nas yig thog phab pa yin/)119

po gnang gi yod pa dang / rgya che'i mang tshogs tshos kyang kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi re 'bod gnang gi yod pa red/ rang re'i bod sog gi sa khul la sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed pa'i lam lugs byung nas lo bdun brgya lhag tsam phyin yod/ thog mar sprul sku mang po byung yod pa ma red/ ha cang nyung nyung yin/ sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed pa'i lam lugs thog mar bka' brgyud pa nas byung yod pa dang /rjes su chos lugs kyi grub mtha' gzhan dag la'ang byung yod/ lo rgyus kyi brgyud rim nang sprul sku ngos 'dzin byas nas dgon pa so sos bdag sgrod byed pa la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu dang / dgon sde khag bdag skyong byed rgyu/ sa khul khag gcig gi chos dad mkhan gyi mi mang tsho'i re ba'i 'dod pa bskang rgyu/ mi rigs kyi rig gnas gang ci'i thad yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong rgyu bcas la nus pa chen po thon yod/ nus pa bzang po zhig thon pa'i nyer len la brten nas chos byed mi sna tsho yin na'ang 'dra/ rgya che'i chos dad can gyi mang tshogs bcas tshang mas bla ma sprul sku zhes pa 'di gong du bkur nas cha 'jog byed pa dang / de la re ba chen po bcol ba'i goms gshis sam lam srol 'di 'dra zhig rang shugs kyis chags yod/ sngon chad kyi lo rgyus la phyi mig bltas na bla ma sprul sku mang che ba yag po yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed thub mkhan dang / mkhas pa la la ni grub pa yang yin pas rang rang sa khul gyi chos phyogs dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba'i thad nus pa bzang po zhig 'don thub yod/ nyung shas ni de las ldog ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren du gyur pa de 'dra yang byung yod/ yin na'ang legs pa'i phyogs ha cang gis mang ba yin/ lo bzhi bcu lnga bcu'i gong ste bcings 'grol ma btang tsam nas bod rigs dang / sog po'i sa khul du snga mo'i chos dad kyi rnam pa sdug tu song yod / lhag par phyi lo lnga bcu nga bdun nga brgyad dang / bod rang skyong ljongs khul la lnga bcu nga dgu lo'i dmangs ga'i bcos bsgyur nas bzung ste de'i 120

thog la rtsa med gtong 'go tshugs yod/ da lta ngas 'di zhu dgos don ni bla ma'i sprus tshad 'di bcings 'grol ma btang gong gi lo bco lnga nyi shu tsam nas rim pas sdug tu phyin pa zhig las/ bcings 'grol btang rjes lam sang sdug tu phyin pa zhig ma red/ 'on kyang lnga bcu nga bdun nga brgyad lo nas bzung gnam sa mgo rting slog pa lta bu'i 'gyur ldog byung yod/ gnam sa mgo rting slog pa lta bu'i 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba de'i skabs tang gi chos lugs kyi srid byus de g.yon phyogs su thal nas srid byus drang po zhig lag len bstar med/ dngos gnas byas na rang rgyal gyi rtsa khrims nang du chos dad rang mos kyi srid byus lag len bstar dgos zhes dang / chos la dad pa byas na'ang rang dbang yin la/ chos la dad pa ma byas na'ang rang dbang yin zhes drang po zhig yod/ 'on kyang bya ba dngos kyi nang du de ltar byung yod pa ma red/sngon chad nga tsho bod rigs sa khul gyi dgon pa mang che bar dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha yod/ lhag par du bod kyi dgon sde tsho bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi nang don du gyur pa zhig red/ dgon pa'i nang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi dmigs bsal dbang cha dang bshu gzhog gi lam lugs yod cing / rgya che'i zhing bran dang bran g.yog la gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog btang yod/ 'di dag ni chos kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa yin la/ rgya che'i zhing bran dang bran g.yog tshos kyang lam lugs de med pa bzo dgos don yang dngos yod gnas tshul 'di red/ 1959 lor bod la ngo log zing 'khrug byung ba zhi 'jags btang ba'i skabs su ngas krung dbyang la snyan seng zhus yod/ rang rgyal gyi rtsa khrims bdun pa'i nang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi bslad skyon shor ba'i dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha dang / bshu gzhog gnya' gnon gyi lam lugs 'di med pa bzos te dgon pa gtsang ma yag po zhig bzo dgos kyi 'dug ces ngas 'di bshad pa yin/ rtsa 'dzin 'di nyid rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi 121

khe phan dang mthun zhing / rgya che'i chos byed mi snas kyang dang du len thub pa'i gnas tshul zhig red bsam gyi yod/ nga chos skabs der zhus pa de ltar lag len bstar ba yin na gang 'dra zhig yong gi yod ce na/ dgon pa'i nang gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bslad skyon de dag med par dgon pa chos kyi dgongs don dang mthun pa zhig dang / chos nyams len byed mkhan dang chos byed kyi mi sna yod pa sogs dgon pa khag yag po zhig yong ba yod/ dper na/ de ni spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dag ther byas pa lta bu yong mi srid pa min/ bkra mi shis pa dang slo pham pa zhig la bya ba dngos kyi nang de las yongs su ldog pa zhig byas yod/nya dang nyung ma mnyam bsres kyi thog nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs dang / chos dngos gnyis mnyam du rgyug pa leb brdung byas nas tshang ma gtor ba red/ nga hrū chos la dad pa yod mkhan tsho'i ngos nas bshad na sku gsung thugs rten zhes khri / 'di yi shes pa 'gugs pa'i gzhi rtsa zhig yin/ chos la dgab med mkhan gyis de la 'dam bag gi sku zhes brjod nas de'i byin rlabs sogs rtsa ba nas khas len gyi med/ yin na yang de la rig rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan yod/ nga tsho'i dpe cha'i nang du chos bshad pa tsam du ma zad/ lo rgyus dang / rig gnas / brtsam sgrung / skar rtsis/ gnam gshis/ rang 'byung khams la sogs pa'i rig pa'i gnas rgya chen po zhig bshad yod pa las chos rkyang pa sha stag min / de tsho tshang ma med pa bzos pa dang / tha na dgon pa'i khang pa tshang ma yang med pa bzos pa red/ khang pa ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs rtsa ba nas yin mi srid/ dpe cha sgrig bzhag pa de tsho yang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs yin shes stangs med/ der brten bod rigs sa khul gyi dgon pa mang che ba zhig dmangs gtso'i bco bsgyur gyi skabs su rtsa med bzos zin pa red/ de'i skabs srung skyob kyi dgon pa zhes dgon pa cung grags che ba khag gcig sung skyob byas yod/ dgon pa de tsho'i nang du'ang grwa pa ha cang nyung du phyin yod/122

grwa pa lhag yod kyang gnas tshul de 'dra chags yod/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og 1959 lo'i dgun thog nga rang pe cing la 'gro skabs krung dbyang la snyan seng zhus yod / de dus dgon pa khag la grwa pa yod kyang chos 'chad nyan de tsam byed kyi med la/ tshogs kyang mang po tshogs thub kyi med/ der brten ngas krung dbyang la 'di 'dra byas na rtsa ba nas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug chos kyi las ka byed mkhan khag gcig la rgyal khab nas 'gro gron gnang dgos pa dang / gso skyong byed dgos kyi 'dug de byings kyi grwa pa mang che ba ngal rtsol byas te rang kha rang gso byas na 'grigs kyi red/ grwa pa yongs rdzogs ngal rtsol la brten nas rang kha rang gso byed dgos byung tshe chos kyi slob sbyong rtsa ba nas yong thabs yod pa ma red zhus pa yin/ma'o kru'u zhis bsam 'char 'di gsan nas yag po 'dug gsung yod/ de gong bod la grwa pa mi nyung ba zhig yod/ bod ljongs rang la brtsis na dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas gong grwa pa khri bcu grangs yod cing / 'ga' res khri bco lnga dang / 'ga' res khri bcu gnyis yod brjod kyi yod/ gang ltar dmangs ga'i bcos bsgyur tshar ba'i rjes su grwa pa lhag pa khyo bsdoms khri gnyis tsam yod/krung dbyang nas cog mchan gnang ste grwa pa stong phrag lnga la rgyal khab nas phogs sprad de chos kyi slob sbyong byed rgyu dang / grwa pa chig khri lnga stong thon skyed nang zhugs nas rang kha rang gso byed rgyu byas pa yin/ yar yong nas de'i thad rigs gcig rkang 'dzin 'dzugs rgyu dang grub mtha' ris med la bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i las ka byas pa red/ de ni 1960 lo'i nang yin/1962 lor nga rang mar phyin pa'i rjes su bod kyi gnas tshul dang / yang sgos mtsho sngon khul du bskyod pa'i gnas tshul mthong ba rnam krung dbyang la snyan seng ring po yig 'byu khri bdun yod pa zhig phul yod/ rjes su paṇa chen gyi log spyod yi ge khri bdun zhes pa 'di'i nang chos lugs kyi skor don tshan ha cang ring po zhig yod cing / bod ljongs kyi cos lugs slor bshad yod par ma zad/ khams 123

dang / a mdo bcas pa'i sa khul tshang ma'i chos lugs kyi skor bkod yod/snyan zhu 'di thog mar yar phul ba ltar krung dbyang nas 'di'i skor tshogs 'du mang po phyogs te bod nang legs bcos gtong gi yin zhes gsungs pa red/ mjug tu 1962 lo'i zla 8 nang tang gi skabs brgyad pa'i tshogs 'du thengs lnga pa'i thog ma'o kru'u zhi'i rlabs chen gyi 'bod tshig cig ste gral rim 'thab rtsod nam yang brjed mi rung zhes pa 'di bton pa gnang nas nga'i thog la gral rim gyi ro langs rgyas mkhan red ces mgo la dog rgyag gcig gzhus nas 1962 lo'i lo mjug nas bzung nga la cham nad dang po phog yod kyang phyi nas ha go gi med/ nang du hab sbrid brgyab ste bsdad yod/ 1964 lor bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang gi rgya che'i tshogs 'du thengs bdun pa'i thog nga la dgag pa dang /'thab rtsod byas pa dang / bslab bya rim pa gnang ste nga nag khung nang sdod dgos byung zhing / nga rang gi gnas tshul 'di 'dra yin/ gnas tshul 'di 'og chos byed kyi mi sna gzhan tsho yang nga dang gnas stangs gcig pa lta bu'am/ yang na nga las kyang sdug pa byung yod/ nga'i ming 'di chen po zhig yin stabs/ phran bu drag pa byung yod/ dgon pa'i nang bzhugs pa'i chos yag po byed mkhan dang /chos la dad zhen dang dga' zhen yod mkhan mang che bar zhwa mo sna tshogs g.yogs te la la btson du bcug pa dang / la la ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod la btang ba/ chos byed kyi mi sna'i bsam slor bsgyur bkod gtong dgos zhes brjod kyi yod/ nga tsho'i bsam blo'i bsgyur bkod de sngon chad kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs dang / spyi phogs rnying pa'i lam lugs kyi bsam slo bsgyur bkod dang /gung khran tang gi 'go khrid la brtsi 'jog spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam la bskyod rgyu / rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi mang la gdung sems dang / mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur / mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs snon/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 7 bsam blo gtong dgos pa bcas bton na/ de ni 'don 'os nges dang 'don dgos

pa zhig red/ 'on kyang chos byed tshor de 'dra bton yod pa ma red/ ga re bton yod ce na cos la ngo rgol byed dgos zhes pa 'di dang / chos lugs so so'i shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan hrū la phyogs gtam gtong dgos pa dang / dpe cha me la bsreg dgos pa/ sku 'dra bcags pa bcas byed dgos/ de 'dra byas na dpa' bo red/ de 'dra'i chos pa gang 'dra byas na yong gi red dam/ nga chos ga re ba rjod kyi yod ce na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni so so'i srog las kyang gces par 'dzin gyi yin zhes brjod kyi yod/ 'di gtor dgos zer ba gang 'dra byas te dang len byed thub bam/ bsam slor bsgyur bkod gtong dgos pa yin kyang / de ni dbye ba 'byed dgos pa zhig yin par nga rang bsam gyi yod/ yin na yang stso du nga tshor re ba bawo pa ni ha cang khyad mtshar po dang / kyog kyog don du 'grub mi thub pa zhig bcas bton nas las ka byas pa'i nyer len gyis chos byed kyi mi sna chos kyi yon tan yod pa mang po zhig dang / bla ma sprul sku / dge bshes mang po zhig bcas btson khang nang lo mang po sdod dgos byung zhing / btson khang nang 'tsha ba dang mthun rkyen zhan po yin stabs mang po zhig btson khang nang dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / de 'phros rjes su btson khang nas slod pa de tsho yang klad pa rab tsam 'gyur zin pa de 'dra chags yod pa ngas mang po zhu mi dgos par rnam pa phos mkhyen gsal yin/ de'i skabs bla ma mang po zhig dgongs pa rdzogs yod/ de dag gi yang srid sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed dgos dus/da lta sprul sku mang po zhig dus gcig la ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'di byung ba red/don gnad gcig la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ni khams dang / a mdo khul la phyi lo 1957/58 dang / bod rang skyong ljongs la 1959 lor 'go tshugs pa red/ de'i skabs bla ma'i ngos 'dzin zin pa lo bcu nas nyi shu bar gyi bla ma de tsho ni yi ge ka kha dang 'don chos phran bu shes pa las/ rtsa ba'i chos kyi 125

yon tan slob sbyong byed ma thub pa khag gcig yod/ de tsho'i gras btson khang nang ma tshud par spyi phogs sgog gnas kyang spyi phogs thog zhing bdag dang / ma rtsa can mi ngan sogs rigs bzhi'i mi sna zer ba'i chab srid kyi rtsa tshig cig yod pa khong tsho mi de'i gras la brtsis nas spyi tshogs thog rdung rdeg dang dma' 'bebs byas yod / da lta gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig yod dam zhe na/ khong tsho ni lo bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu bar slebs pa'i bla ma yon tan med pa zhig chags yod/ de gong nas yon tan yod pa'i bla ma tsho ni dgung lo ha cang bgres po chags yod pa red/de rjes tang gis mi bzhi shog kha hril po gtor ba dang / lhag par tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs pa red / de'i sngon gyi lo ngo sum cu'i ring tang 'di khrims med kyi lam la bskyod yod pa ni ma 'grigs pa red/ de'i nang yang dag pa'i bya ba byung yod la/ nor 'khrul yang tshabs che byung yod/ de dag la phyi mig bltas nas nor 'khrul yo bsrang dang / yang dag pa'i rigs mu mthud gong 'phel gtong dgos/ mu mthud gong 'phel gtong dgos don gang yin zhe na/ tang gis rtsa ba'i rtsa don bzhi rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos zhes gsung gi yod/ 'di ni sngon chad rgyun 'khyongs byas pa 'grigs yod la/ phyin chad kyang mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos/ ma 'grigs pa ni g.yon gyi nor 'khrul yin pas da lta bya spyod de rnams yo bsrang byed dgos / rig gnas gsar brje chen po khas mi len par ma zad/ der dgag pa rgyag dgos/ sngon chad kyi las 'gul gzhan dag hrū sngon chad yongs su yang dag pa yin na'ang de'i nang du'ang 'grigs pa dang / ma 'grigs pa'i cha gnyis ka yod/ dbye zhib 'di ni tang gi mdzad phyogs gsar pa tshangs thig lta bu zhig lag len bstar ba las byung ba red/ de'i nang tang gi chos lugs kyi srid byus dang / mi rigs kyi srid byus/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus bcas gsar pa zhig bskyar gso byas pa red/ ngas bskyar gso byas pa red ces brjod 126

don ni de gong chos dad rang mos med/ mi rigs srid byus med/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur med ces khyab bsgrags byas med kyang / don dngos thog rig gnas gsar brje lo bcu'i ring srid byus de dag tshang ma bzhag pa red/ bskyar gso byas pa red ces zhu dgos don 'di yin/ tha na rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs su 1974 lor mi mang 'thus tshogs thengs lnga pa phyogs pa red/ go'o ca ming ud (rgyal khab mi rigs u yon lhan khang ) yod brjod kyi med la med kyang brjod kyi med/ don du go rdo ud (rgyal srid spyi khyab khang ) kyi ming ma gtogs gozung ca ming ud yod pa ma red/ de med dus mi rigs kyi srid byus gang 'dra byas nas yong gi red/ krang zha'i (chab gros ) yang phyogs yod pa ma red/ chab srid spos phyogs zhes pa 'di ni tang gi phyi la yod pa'i dmang sa gtso'i tang shog dang / mi rigs/ chos lugs/ tang nang ma zhugs pa'i mi sna la sogs pa tshang ma 'thab phyogs gcig gyur byas nas tang la rogs ram byas te gros mol byed pa'i las khungs gal chen po zhig yin/ 1974 lor de yang med pa red/ de la brten nas 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus dang / chos lugs kyi srid byus bzhag nas med pa red/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs pa nas bzung tang gi mi rigs srid byus dang / chos lugs srid byus/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus bcas bskyar gso byas pa red ces ngas 'di brjod kyi yod/nga pho la mtshon na tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i gros phyogs thengs gsum pa nas bzung 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus brgyud rim ldan pa zhig lag len bstar ba de ni don dag ha cang gal chen po zhig red/ de nas bzung 'phel rgyas byung ste nga tshor de ring gos dmar po gyon rgyu yod pa dang / lhag par dpe cha 'ur 'don byas te skyor rgyu yod pa/ dgon pa tshor yang sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs rgyu yod pa/ tha na nga tsho'i sku gdung 'di gsar bzhengs byed rgyu byung ba/127
