dgon sde khag la yang mchod chas sngon ma nang bzhin med kyang rag gis bzos pa de 'dra yod pa red/ de tsho tshang ma tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa nas bzung tang gi rtsa ba'i srid byus la 'gyur ba btang ba las byung ba zhig red / da res rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i thog krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur bu'i bu'i krang gzhon pa slo mthun krang hri tso'i yis gsung bshad rgya skad thog gnang yod / mang che bas rgya skad mkhyen gyi yod pa red/ khong gi gsung bshad nang gung khran tang gis sngon chad rang la nor 'khrul byung bar bsgyur bkod btang nas sku gdung 'di ltar gsar bzhengs byas pa red/ tang gi yang dag pa dang rlabs chen gyi rang bzhin gang yin zhe na/ sngon chad nor 'khrul byung ba rang gis ngos 'dzin byas nas rang gis bsgyur bkod btang ba 'di red ces gsungs pa'i bka' mol 'di ha cang yag po 'dug de ni dngos gnas mi'i sems la bab pa dang / mi'i sems la skul ma thebs pa zhig red/ mi su dang su yin yang nor 'khrul med pa rtsa ba nas med/ nga tsho'i chos phyogs nas byas na skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun ldan ni sangs rgyas gcig pu yin/ yin na yang da lta sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa brjod pa'i yul ma red/ sangs rgyas 'dir bzhugs med kyang chos kyi ngos nas bshad na mi zhes pa 'dir nor 'khrul yong rgyu yin stabs nor 'khrul bshags sdom byed pa'i cho ga bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs yod/ gso spyong len dgos pa dang /bskang gso zhig btang na'ang sngon la bshags pa byed dgos pa 'di nor 'khrul byung ba bshags pa byas pa red/ nor 'khrul yong rgyu med pa zhig yin na bshags pa byed dgos don med/ rang la nor 'khrul byung ba bsgyur bkod ma btang na thabs sdug red/krung go gung khran tang gi bar lam gyi lo nyi shu'i gnas tshul nye char teng zha'o phing gis pe cing gi gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan rgya mi gcig la gsung yod/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab la mtshon na bcings 'grol byung nas 'go ltod kyi lo bdun yag po 128

byung yod/ de nas nga hrū lo nyi shu'i ring lam kyog la phyin pa red/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa nas da bar gyi lo bcu po 'di yag po byung yod ces pa 'di red/ der brten sngon chad lo nyi shu'i ring nor 'khrul byung ba de da lta lo bcu'i ring skyob thub pa byu nga yod/ bskyar bcos kyi las ka 'di mu mthud nas byas dang byed bzhin pa red/ ngas rnam pa zor zhu rgyur snga phyi tang gi gnas tshul thog rnyog dra mang po byung yod/ de dag la 'khrul nas tang la yid ches mi byed pa dang / tang la mi dga' ba'i bya ba byas na rtsa ba nas mi 'grigs/phyogs gnyis la blta dgos pa dang / sngon chad kyi las mjug rnyog dra 'di dag nga chos mu mthud sel dgos/ sprul sku'i grangs tshad ha cang mang po ma yin par sprus ka dag po yong ba byed dgos/ sngar gyi cos kyi goms gshis ltar sprul sku thag gcod kyi dbang cha 'di nga paṇa chen la sprad pa red/ ngas thag bcad pa yin na rim pa khag gi srid gzhung nas khas len bya rgyu red/ de min mi gzhan pa sus thag bcad kyang khas len gyi min zer ba 'di don tshan gsum pa red/don tshan bzhi pa sprul sku de dag rjes su rgyal gces chos gces can gyi mi zhig la gas skyong byed dgos pa'i las 'gan 'di yang nga la sprad pa red/ da lta yod pa'i bla ma tsho la chos kyi yon tan bslab rgyu dang / gsar pa yong mkhan tsho la'ang chos kyi slob sbyong dang yi ge/ gzhan yang chab srid kyi slob sbyong bcas sprad nas rjes su rgyal gces chos gces kyi bod brgyud nang bstan gyi rkang 'dzin pa zhig tu 'gyur ba byed dgos rgyu'i nga la las 'gan chen po zhig dang / nga'i mgo la zhwa smro rtsi thag chod cig slon yod/ da rnyog dra ga zod 'dug rnam pa hrū sprul sku byed rgyu byung ba yag po red kyang / nga rang ni las ka ha cang byed khag po 'dugader brten nga rang la 'di snor bsam 'char gcig yod/ rnyog dra 'di ni krung dbyang gis gtan 'khel byas pa red/ sprul sku ngos 'dzin bya rgyu 'di'i spor la rnyog dra mang po yod/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ sngar gyi lam srol ltar byas 129

na bla ma zhig dgongs pa rdzogs nas lo gcig gam gnyis kyi rjes su skyes pa'i phru gu zhig la ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa red/ de 'dra byed dus chig stongadagu brgya lnga bcu nga bdun nas drug cu re grang sa nang 'das grongs su gyur pa de cho/ de nas lo gcig gnyis phyin rjes skyes pa'i phru gu zhig la ngos 'dzin byas te chos kyi yon tan yod pa'i rgyal gces chos gces shig tu gso skyong thub kyi red dam/ rta rgan la 'gros bslab pa'i dpe ltar yong rgyu ma red dam / des na sngon chad kyi lo rgyus goms srol la 'gyur ba btang na ma gtogs mi 'grigs/ tshang mas gsung yas la sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa zhig dgos gsung gi yod/ sngon ma sprul sku ma nga po zhig 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis nas thag gcod gnang gi yod/ sprul twe ngos 'dzin zhu mkhan mang che bas sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa zhig yong ba zhes zhu bi yod / de ni sku thog gong ma'i rnam shes zhugs pa'i 'khrul pa med pa zhig zer ba 'di red/ sngon ma sku 'bum la spa khrug ('di gsung sgra gsal po mi 'dug ) ces pa zhig gis paṇa chen sku gong mar sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa zhig ngos 'dzin gnang rogs zhus par/ de'i lan du sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa las bstan pa dang dgon par phan thogs yod pa zhig byung na dga' ba med dam zhes bka' gnang yod pa red/mi des phan thogs rung ma thogs rung sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa gcig dgos zhes zhus nas 'khrul pa med pa 'di yin zhes phru gu zhig bstan pa de ni za ro zhig yod 'dugasku gong mas khyed rang tshor byung na bstan pa la phan thogs mkhan gyi mi yag po zhig byung na dga' ba med dam zhes gsung yod kyang / kho pas ni sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa zhig dgos zhus pa red/ rgyu mtshan 'di 'dra la brten nas da dung gsal bshad cig byas na/ 7rgyal ba sku phreng drug pa dgongs pa ma rdzogs gong la 7rgyal ba bdun pa byung yod/ nga tsho'i chos rang gi thog nas bshad na yin gcig min gcig dgongs pa rdzogs nas lo dus thim mi dgos/ chos kyi rtogs pa yod pa zhig yin na dus gcig tu sprul sku mang por sprul thub kyi yod/ rang gi rnam shes 130

gcig pu kho rang ma gtogs yong mi thub pa ma red/ snga tsam dang phyi tsam chos kyi thog nas 'grigs pa zhig red ma gtogs ma 'grigs pa ma red/ bla ma de dgongs pa rdzogs na zla dgu zhag nyi shu rtsa grangs song ba zhig dgos kyi 'dug kyang /de ni ngas bltas na dgos kyi ma red dran gyi 'dug de ltar ma byas tshe las ka 'di ha cang byed khag po chags kyi 'dug yo bzhi bcu nas nyi shu rtsa grangs bar gyi grong gseb kyi 'brog phrug sha stag cig gang 'dra byas te sprul sku bzo dgos sam/'di nga'i bsam tshul dang po yin/gnyis pa ngos 'dzin bya rgyu 'di mang che ba lo bcu grangs kyi phru gu byung na 'tshams po yod/ bar lam dgongs pa rdzogs pa zhig yin na de las chung ba yin na yang 'grigs/ sngon ma dgongs pa rdzogs pa zhig yin na lo bcu grangs de 'dra la ngos 'dzin byas na phru gu de'i spyod pa dang / rig pa/ chos la 'dun pa'i bsam blo ji ltar yod pa sogs bzang ngam phal cher shes thub/ nga mos sprul sku ngos 'dzin bya rgyu 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum dang /dgon sde de dag bdag 'dzin yag po bya rgyu dmigs yul gtso bor 'dzin gyi yin na/ 'khrul med yin zhes se rdog rdog cig yar 'jog rgyu ma yin pa 'dir tshang mas dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ nga tshos sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed pa 'di bstan par phan thogs pa zhig dang / chos kyi yon tan yod pa/ spyod pa yang bzang po yod pa zhig gtso bor 'dzin gyi yod na 'khrul med yin zhes se rdog dog cig bzhugs khrir bzhag na gang 'dra yong nga ma/ nga ni de 'dra ma byas na snyam pa dran gyi 'dug yo dus gang 'dra yin dang / phyogs kyi dbye ba gang 'dra yin ngas brtag pa byas na 'grigs / 'on kyang mtha' ma brtag pa byas te sprul sku'i 'os sprul gsum re bton nas mi de tsho gsum la nga tshos zhib 'jug dang / gnas tshul tshang mar brtag dpyad khu /ga po byed dgos/ brtag dpyad yag po byas pa'i rjes su yang nga gcig pus thag bcad na 'dra chag po mi 'dug sngon ma dge lugs pa rnams 7rgyal 131

ba yab sras rnam gnyis kyis gtso bo gnang gi yod pas 'di skor skyon gang yang mi 'dug 'on kyang chos lugs grub mtha' gzhan dag la gzhan gyi gnad don yod pa dang / krung dbyang nas ngas gtan 'bebs byed dgos gsung gi yod/ da cha jo bo rin po che rang gad na 'dren zhus te nga la rogs pa gnang rogs zhu gi yin/ jo bo rin po che ni grub mtha' tshang mas khas len zhu gi yod/ 'os sprul ming hpho gsum re yod pa 'di rnams nyi ma gcig 'gor gyi yod kyang jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du brtag ril phul nas thag gcod bya rgyu yin/ de nas nor ba yin na yang 7rgyal ba shākya thub pa rang gdan 'dren zhus bzhag na bsam pa 'di nga'i bsam tshul yin / nga zo mnyam sbrel gyi thog nas thag bcad/ yang bar lam khag gcig thag bcad pa de tsho'i gras kyang gtan 'bebs ltar byas na brtag dpyad byas nas yang bskyar thag gcod byas na ma gtogs rgyal khab nas khas len bya rgyu ma red/ de dag ni mi so so'i dngos yod gnas tshul la bltas nas dbye zhib byed dgos/ de ltar thag bcad na rim pa khag gi srid gzhung gis khas len bya rgyu dang / ngas khas ma blangs na rim pa khag gi srid gzhung gis khas len bya rgyu ma red/ krung dbyang gis gtan 'bebs 'di 'dra zhig gnang yod/ sprul sku'i skor gyi gnas tshul 'di'i thad dgongs 'char ga re yod/ de ring zhu rgyu'i gnas tshul gcig 'diyin/don tshan gsum pa bod sog sa khul gyi dgon pa de dag phyin chad yag po rdo snang ba zhig dang / chos kyi thog nas dgon pa de dgon pa 'dra po dang / bla ma de bla ma dang 'dra po/ grwa pa de grwa pa 'dra po zhig dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snyigs lnga'i dus 'dir nyams pa sor chud pa dang / gong 'phel du gtong thub pa zhig sangs rgyas kyi lung rtogs mdo sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum rgud stso pu 'ig yong ba grang snangagos/ srid phyogs mas bshad rim ringes par 4la gces khrims sung yong ba dang / gung khran tang la dga' zhen dang / mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la srung skyob/ mi rigs kyi mthun sgril la shugs ston/132

spyi tshogs kyi dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsamapa'i dpalayon nang rang rang gi nus pa 'don pa/ spyi phogs 'phel rgyas dang / lhag par rig gnas slob gso'i nang nus pa 'don dgos/ dpal 'gyor gyi thog kyang da lta'i 'di 'dra min par 'gan srung yod pa zhig dgos/ yang krung dbyang nas gtan 'bebs gnang ste bod kyi nang bstan mdzub khrid u yon lhan khang zhig dgos kyi yod pa des dgon pa de dag tshang ma yag po yong ba byed dgos pa de'i 'gan yang nga la gnang yod/dgon pa 'ga' re ha cang chen po yod pas/ nga rnyog dra tsha po dang mgo na po 'dug yin na yang las ka 'di byed dgos kyi yod pa red/ des na nga mos sngon la chod blta zhig byas pa yin/ de yang rang gi dgon pa bkra shis lhun por byas pa yin/bkra shis lhun por byed dgos don ni/ bkra shis lhun por mthun rkyen phran bu yod / mthun rkyen ji ltar byas te bzang ba yod ce na/ sngon chad kyi grwa pa rnying pa phran bu mang ba yod pa'i bzo 'dug lhag par du yang chos phyogs kyi byed sgo de dag bskyar gso byed dgos na byed bde po yod pa dang / de'i thog dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs kyang phran bu yag pa yod/ gtso che shos nga rang gi dgon pa yin dus tshod blta byas nas yag po byung na legs shos dang / gal te yag po ma byung ba yin na'ang nga la bsam 'char gtong mkhan mang po yong gi ma red /dgon pa gzhan dag cig la tshod blta byas tshe yag po byung na 'grigs kyang / gal te yag po ma byung na tshang mas nga la kha gtong gi red/bkra shis lhun por tshod blta byas te lo gnyis tsam song ba de'i ring grub 'bras ha cang yang po byung yod/ da lta bkra shis lhan por mtshan na chos phyogs thad sngon chad yod pa brgya cha brgya bskyar gso zin cing / 'on kyang gzhi rgya che chung sngon ma nang bzhin yong thabs med/ sngon ma grwa grangs bzhi ltong lhag tsam yod kyang da lta drug brgya bdun brgya tsam las med/ gzhi rgya sngon ma ltar yong thabs med / yin na yang gzhi rtsa'i thog yongs rdzogs bskyar gso byas pa yin/ grwa 133

pa'i sgrig khrims dang 'dul khrims thog kyang cung zad nan tsam lag len bstar ba la brten nas mi tsho'i lta snang la yag po yod/ bkra shis lhun por grwa pa 'jug skabs kyi khrims ni sngon ma nas dam po yod/ nga tshos de bas dam du btang nas grwa pa'i spus tshad mtho po yod/ sngon ma bkra shis lhan por dpe cha ngag rgyugs shog bu brgya lhag tsam sprod dgos shing / phru gu tshos thog mar de dag blo la gzung ste rgyugs ma 'phrod na tshud kyi med/ da lta ngag thog gi rgyugs sprod thub pa dgos par ma zad/dpe cha klog thub pa dgos/ sngon chad dpe cha klog ma thub kyang ngag skyor thub na 'grigs 1 dpe cha ngag thog nas slob kyi yod/ da cha de'i thog yi ge 'bri thub pa dgos/ sngon ma slob phrug ces phyu pa dkar po zhig gyon nas dgon pa'i slob grwa lta bu byas te lo gsum sdod dgos pa de'i ring phru gu de gang 'dra yod pa phal cher rtsa ba'i cha nas shes thub/ da cha rgyugs sprod skabs dpe cha ngag rgyugs tsam ma du ma zad/ klog rgyugs dang 'bri rgyugs bcas sprod dgos pas 'jug skabs phran bu de snga las tshad mtho ba yod/ spyir btang byas na slob grwa chung ba rim pa'i gnas tshad dang mthun pa yod/ dgon par bcug tshar ba'i rjes su sngon chad yin na las ka mang po yod pas yi ge 'bri rgyu tsam slob cing / da lta yi ge 'bri rgyu tsam ma yin par sum rtags sogs dang / de bzhin grwa pa byas rjes gang zhig srung dgos pa dang / gang zhig byas na 'grigs min sogs gsal po shes ched blangs 'das so drug dang / lam rim de rigs lo gnyis nas gsum par slob sbyong sprad de rgyugs blangs nas ang ki yon pa legs pa de dag mtshan nyid 'dzin grwar 'jug rgyu dang /yang re ba de tsam med mkhan de dag las ga'i rnam grangs mang po yod pa de tsho'i nang btang 1 dpe cha yag pa dang rig pa yag pa de dag dpe cha slob mkhan khongs su 'jug rgyu/ gzhan dag kho rang tsho'i ngos nas tshad ma yongs pa yin dus phran bu lab gleng yong min la ma ltos par gang 'tshams gyi yag po byung yod/ de ltar byas nas nga tshos dgon pa'i nang stangs 'dzin shugs che tsam byed thubarngo kyi 'dug134

srid kyi thog nas stangs 'dzin thub pa'i nyer len la brten nas sngon chad yin na 'ang bkra shis lhun po rgyal gces kyi dgon pa yi na pa dang / lhag par ngas kyang bslab bya 'dra brgyab/ de bzhin 'brel yod chos kyang slob gso 'dra btang ste rgyal gces khrims srung gi bsam blo'i chu tshad mtho ba byung yod/ bod nang yang bskyar dgon pa tsho nas rnyog dra yong dus nga tsho nas rnyog dra gang yang yong gi med/ dpal 'gyor gyi thog nas bshad na/ dgon pa rang gis kyang rtsag rtsig gi las ka dang /thang ga 'bri ba/ par brko ba/ spa se 'tshong ba/ dgon par phyin rgyal gyi mis da par rgyag skabs dngul bsdu ba bcas dang / gtso che ba dgon pas ma rtsa btang nas nga tshos bod gangs rgyan dar rgyas sne len khang zhig btsugs te tshong las byas pa'i nyer len la brten nas da lta dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun thad rgyal khab nas nga tshor gang yang ma gnang na yang dgon pa lha khang bzhengs rgyu dang / grwa pa'i 'tsho ba legs bcos gtong rgyu sogs yongs rdzogs rang mgo rang thon thub kyi yod/ rgyal khab nas nga tshor sngon ma rogs dngul gnang yod/ de ni shin tu bka' drin chen po red / da res kyi sku gdung 'di'i dngul tshang ma nga tsho rang nas thag gcod thub pa byed kyi yod la/ sku mgron rgya chen po 'di 'dra gdan 'dren zhus pa yang nga rang slo rang gis dngul btang ba ma gtogs rgyal khab nas gang yang zhus med/ de nas da lo mchod khang 'di tsho brgyab par sgor khri brgyad cu tsam phyin yod/ de dag tshang ma nga rang tsho rang gis btang ba yin/ lo rjes ma nas bzung nga mos sngags khang la sogs pa rgyag rgyu'i 'char gzhi yod pa de dag gi dngul yang tshang ma nga pho rang nas thag gcod byed bzhin pa las/ rgyal khab la dngul gnang rogs zhes zhu dgos pa gang yang med/ nga tsho'i nyams myong bzang po 'di dag dgon sde gzhan dag tso la'ang rim bzhin spel thub pa zhig byung na/ dgon sde gzhan dag tsho'i chos kyi byed sgo yang zab tu 'gro rgyu yin/ 'di dag rnam pa tshos sngon la mkhyen pa gnang rogs / rim pas chos phyogs kyi slor khag gsum gyi thog nas kha sang ngas gtam 135

bshad zhus pa yin/ dgon pa zhes pa 'di dgon pa mang nyung ma red/ dgon ji 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed thub pa'i gzhir gyur min la rag lus yod/ grwa pa mang nyung ma red/ tshang ma 'dul khrims gtsang rme dang / chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin byed pa/ de'i thog mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum bcas dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa gang mang yong thub pa bya rgyu 'di gtso bo yin/chab srid kyi thog nas nga tsho tshang ma krung twa mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi spyi dmangs shig yin pa dang / bod dang bod kyi sa khul tshang ma krung go'i kha 'bral du mi rung ba'i sa khul sha stag red/ nga zos rtsa khrims la brtsi 'jog zhu dgos pa dang / tang dang srid gzhung gi 'go khrid la brtsi 'jog dgos pa/ spyi tshogs kyi snying 'jags mthun sgril la nus pa 'don dgos pa/ mi rigs mthun sgril bcas byed dgos/ phyin chad nga tsho'i dpal 'byor thad dgon pa so so'i dpal 'byor gyis gtso bo byas te rgyal khab nas srid byus don 'khyol gyi dngul phran bu yod/srid byus don 'khyol ma byung ba rnams la mang nyung la ma bltos par da dung gnang gi re da/ yin na yang srid byus don 'khyol 'di dus nam yang gnang rgyu zhig min / sngon chad gtor bshig byung ba rnams la de'i tshab 'jal ba zhig red/ ngas kyang krung dbyang la rim pa zhu rgyu byung / sngon ma ma'o kru'u zhi'i skabs chos byed mi lnga stong tsam la rgyal khab nas phogs dang / 'gro gron gtong gi yin zhes zhal bzhes gnang nas lag len yang ngo ma bstar ba red/ de tsho'i gras da lta yang krung dbyang nas dgongs bzhes gnang ste chos rang byed mkhan gyi mi khag gcig la dgon sde so so'i gnas tshul la bltas nas mang nyung la ma bltos par rgyal khab nas phogs la sogs gnang rgyu gnang ba red/ de mang nyung dang rgya che chung gtan 'khel med kyang / rtsa don thog rgyal khab nas chos rang byed mkhan khag gcig la 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gnang rgyu gtan 'khel yod/ mang nyung dang rgya che chung gtan 136

'khe la med/ de ni rtsa don chos rang nyams len byed mkhan dang slob spyong byed mkhan tsho la yin/ 'di ni dgon pa tsho'i yong sgo gcig chags yod/ gnyis nas da cha tshang mar yod bzhin pa'i mang tshogs kyis dad 'bul zhus pa'i 'gyed dang mang ja yin/ da lta dgon pa tshang ma de rang la brten nas bsdad yod/ de ni phyin chad yong gi red la srid byus dang yang mthun pa yin/ 5)yin na'ang gtan 'khel ba zhig med/ da lta phan gyi gnas tshul la bltas na nyung du nyung du 'gro gi yod/ nyung du 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ sngon ma chos sgo phye ba'i dgon pa nyung nyung zhig las med/ mang phyogs nas kyang 'bul dngos tshang ma dgon pa gcig rang la 'bul gyi yod/ der brten dgon pa gcig la mtshon na mang po yong gi yod/ da cha dgon pa gang sar mang du phyin yod/ lung pa so sor dgon pa yod stabs 'bul rgyu yang de dag la 'bul gyi yod cing / cha snyoms byed skabs mang tshogs kyi lo gcig ring chos phyogs la btang ba'i dngul de nyung du phyin med kyang / grwa pa so so'i lag pa'i nang 'bab rgyu'i dngul 'bor nyung du nyung du 'gro gi yod/ der brten tang gi srid byus la dgon pas dgon pa gso ba zhes brjod kyi yod kyang / don la lag len bstar skabs rtog tsam khag po yod/ skad cha stong pa dgon pas dgon pa gso dgos zhes bshad na/ slo mthun nga phod kyis rkyal khog stong pas rang 'tsho zin mi thub gsungs pa nang bzhin red/ de la mthun rkyen zhig ma bskrun tshe dgon pas dgon pa gso rgyu zhes pa ni bshad pa tsam zhig red ma gtogs don la lag len 'khel mi thub zhig pa red/don tshan dang gnyis phud pa'i don tshan gsum par gang yod ce na/ thon skyed las ka dang / dpal 'byor gyi las ka byed dgos/ thon skyed kyi las ka gang zhig byed dgos she na/ zhing 'brog gi sa khul la yod pa'i dgon pa tshor sa zhing gi mthun rkyen dang / yang na rtswa thang gi mthun rkyen de 'dra sa gnas kyi srid gzhung gis thabs shes byas te thag gcod byas na/ grwa pa nyung nyung yin pa tshos so so rang 137

nyid kyi thon skyed rtsag rtsig dang / yang rtsa kha yod na sems can phyugs zog nyar nas 'brog las byed chog 'on kyang dgon pa cu nga che bar nga tsho'i bsam par byas na khe las kyi sde khag 'dzugs dgos/ de'i nang sang rgyag pa dang / bsgo grwa 'dzugs pa/ gter kha 'don pa/ zhing las de tsho'i thog dgon pa nas ma rtsa btang ste dgon pa'i nang gi dpal 'byor las ka byed shes mkhan de 'dra las lnga'i nang zhugs dgos pa dang / yang spyi tshogs thog gi chos dad yod la phyogs gcig nas dpal 'gyor gyi gnas tshul la 'jon thang yod mkhan de 'dra gdan 'dren zhus nas khe las kyi sde khag gnyer dgos/ dpe mtshan bkra shis lhun po'i gangs rgyan lta bu byed dgos/ yang dgon pa phan tshun mnyam las byed dgos/ dpal 'byor gyi las ka zhes pa 'di phan tshun 'brel ba chen po zhig byung na nus pa de bas che ba yod/ der brten phan tshun gcig gis gcig la 'brel ba yag po byed dgos/kha sang rnam pa tsho tshogs 'du tshogs nas se 'bras dga' gsum gyis gangs rgyan la ma rtsa phran bu 'jog gi yin/ mnyam las byed kyi yin zhes gsungs pa 'di ngas bltas na se 'bre dga' gsum gyis bkra shis lhun por brtse dung yod pa dang / yid ches yod pa masan yod/ dper na nga tsho'i dngos yod gnas tshul la rang re'i bar mnyam las bya rgyu 'di bya ba bzang po zhig red la/ nga zos bltas na yang 'di yag po red bsam gyi 'dug nga tshos se 'bras dga' gsum la zhabs 'degs phran bu zhu thub na nga tsho yang dga' po yong ba 'dug yin na yang 'brel ba byed stangs gang 'dra zhig byed da lta 'dir brel zing gis byung ma song bas rim pas blta rgyu yin/ phyogs mtshungs dgon pa gzhan dag tshos kyang so so rang gi ma rtsa 'dzugs thub na yag po yod par ma zad/ phan tshun mnyam las kyang byed dgos/ nga tshos rgyal khab la'ang re 'bod zhus pa yin/ rgyal khab nas khral dang / bu lon gtong rgyu'i zog phran bu lta rtog yod pa'i srid byus shig lag len bstar dgos/da lta rgyal nang la mtshon na slob grwas khe las gnyer ba dang / dmag dpung gis 138

kyang khe las gnyer gyi yod/ de bzhin dbang po skyon can gyi khe las la khral sogs chag yang gi srid byus lag len bstar gyi yod/ der brten nga tsho'i zos byed dgon sde tshor yang gong dang phyogs mtshungs kyi srid byus lag len bstar dgos/gang yin zhe na/ spyi tshogs rnying par mtshon na dgon sde de dag mang che ba srid gzhung gi gsos nas bsdad yod/ spyi tshogs gsar par de dag med pa bzos pa red / med pa bzos pa'i rjes su mang tshogs la grwa pa dang dgon pa dgos kyi yod pa red/ der brten 'di ni spyi phyogs kyis bskur ba'i khur po zhig red ma gtogs chos byed mkhan kha shas shig gi khe phan ma red/ spyi don gyi khur po zhig yin la rgyal khab kyi khur po yang yin/ der brten rgyal khab la nga tshor dmigs bsal lta rtog gnang dgos pa'i re skul zhus yod/ de ltar ma byas na nga tshos rgyal khab nas dngul zhu rgyu red/ nga tshor lta rtog ma byas na nor srid nas nga tsor dngul sprod dgos/ nga tsho la ni gcig pa red/ ma red dam/ nga phos gang drags ci drags byas pa 'di la khral sogs kyi thog dmigs bsal ma btang ba dang / dngul bun gtong rgyu de tsho'i thog lta rtog ma byas na nor srid nas nga tsho dgon pa so sor lo re ga tshod gnang gi yod kyang ldang ba zhig gnang rogs gnang / nga zo las ka byed mi dgos pa dang / tshong yang rgyag mi dgos par dngul mar zhus nas 'o 'o zhes bsdad rgyu 'di dum bde po red/ tshong la khe bzang yong min thog bsam slo gtong mi dgos pa dang / dka' ngal brgyab nas yar rgyug mar rgyug bcas byed mi dgos pa yong rgyu red/ dgon pa tsho'i bza' rgyu 'grigs na gzhan dag mi dgos/ yang dgon par dmigs bsal srid byus sprad song na/ dgon pa'i dmigs bsal srid byus kyi 'bag de gyon nas mi gzhan la rnyog dra bzo rgyu nyen kha yod/ dper na khrang ha de yin rgyu dbang po skyon can gyi ming thog red/ kho rgya che thag chod/ khrang ha gi sgo byang 'di 'khyer nas khral sgrod mi dgos pa'am/yang na khral phran bu las sprod mi dgos shing / don snying kho la da res krang tun 139

gyi kung si'i gtso bo de khrang ha ang dang po red/ der brten phyin chad dgon pa so so la dpe cha bzhag na/ nga tsho bkra shis lhun po dgon pas gangs rgyan kung si btsugs yod/ 'di bkra shis lhan po'i 'tsho rten rang bzhin la btsugs pa'i nyer len la brten nas ngas mdzub khrid byed kyi yod/ der brten mi 'ga' res nga la mi dga' ba byas te ming 'dogs la tshong pa rgyags pa zhes btags yod/ tshong pa rgyags pa zhes ming btags kyang rung ma btags kyang rung nga ni de nas sgor dog gcig kyang len rgyu ma byung la/ ngas de'i nang ma rtsa sgor gcig kyang bzhag med/khe bzang byung ba nas sgor gcig kyang blangs med/ de ni rgyal khab kyi rtsis khra nas gsal po chags yod/ bkod pa ni gtong gi yod/ bkod pa ma btang na ga la 'grigs/ bogeng u yon gyi tsung li byas nas/ (rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid slon/) gsham 'og gyi dpal 'byor sde khag bar tshang mar rgyab skyor gnang dgos zhes zhus/ rgyab skyor thob rjes srid rlon gyis gsham 'og la rim pas bkod pa ma btang nami 'grigs/ las 'gan yod tsang bkod pa ma btang rang btang red/ngas phogs kyi thog nas khe phan len rgyu ma byung la/ dpal 'byor gyi thog nas khe phan yang len rgyu ma byung /dpal 'byor gyi las ka zhes pa 'di tshang mas gtsang ma gnang na ma gtogs/mjug tu dpal 'byor thog gi skad cha 'di mang po zhig yong gi yod/ kho sha rgyags pa song tsang lag par 'gos na yag po rtsa ba nas med/ der tshang mas gzab gzab gnang dgos/ gang yin zhe na/ dgon pa sogs la rgyal khab nas dmigs bsal lta rtog gnang dgos pa red/ gang byung ba'i dngos po yongs rdzogs gtso bo dgon sde so so'i grwa pa'i 'tsho ba dang / dgon pa'i nyams gso'i thog bed spyod gtong dgos pa dang gcig gnyis nas dgon pa so so rang gi bya ba gcig pu ma yin par spyi phogs nang gi bya ba yang gnang dgos/ spyi tshogs la sman pa'i bya ba ma gnang na nga sar sangs rgyas kyis phar phyin drug gsungs yod pa de'i dang por sbyin pa 1 40

gsungs yod/ thog mar zang zang sbyin pas sems can rnams/ /'khor du bsdus nas chos kyis tshim byed shog /ces gsungs pa ltar 'gro ba sems can la phar sbyin pa btang nas 'khor du bsdus pa ma gtogs/ bza' rgyu yod pa de dag so so rang gis za gin bsdad na der sbyin pa brjod kyi ma red/ nga pho bod sog sa khul gyi skyon che shos shig la dpal 'byor yag po byung song na lha khang dang /sku mang po bzhengs pa ma gtogs/ spyi ltogs la sman pa'i bya ba rgya chen po zhig gnang gi yod pa ma red/ yag shos bod la zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga sogs 'di 'dra'i dus chen khag la sprang ston zhes rtsam pa dang dngul 'dra sprod pa de 'dra zhig ma gtogs med/ da lta nga rang tsho'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs rtsa ba yag po med la nus pa'ang med/ phyin chad nus pa bzang du phyin song na nga ltos spyi tshogs la sman pa'i bya ba byed dgos/ nga ltos spyi tshogs la sman pa'i bya ba gang zhig byed dgos she na/ slob grwa 'dzugs rgyu dang / sman khang 'dzugs rgyu/ rgas gso khang 'dzugs rgyu/ dwa phrug gso skyong khang 'dzugs rgyu/ de bzhin lung par sa yom dang / gangs skyon/ chu log sad ser/ mu ge sogs rang byung gi gnod 'tshe byung nas mi mang la dka' ngal yod dus tshang mas rgyab skyor byed dgos/'di 'dra'i spyi tshogs la sman pa'i bya ba byas na mi mang chos kyang dgon pa dang grwa pa la dad pa sngar las shugs che ru 'gro rgyu yin/ chos la dad pa med mkhan tshos nga rang tshor ming gang zhig btags yod ce na/ gzhan brten srin 'bu zer gyi yod / de ni so so rang gis ngal rtsol ma byas par mi gzhan gyi ngal rtsol byas pa'i 'bras bu za mkhan la zer ba yin/ nga rang mos thon skyed dang / dpal 'byor gyi las ka tog tsam byas nas gzhan la sman pa'i bya ba byas na/ gzhan brten srin 'bu zer ba'i zhwa mo 'di phud thub pa dang / da lta'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas gnas tshul dang yang mthun pa zhig yong gi red ces ngas snga phyi bar gsum du zhus yod/141

rnam pa sa la las dgon pa nyams gso byed dgos pa dang / gcig byed dgos / gnyis byed dgos zhes gsung skabs klad pa'i nang gang zhig yod/ sngon ma spyi tshogs rnying pa'i de rang cha tshang bskyar gso byung na snyam pa dgongs kyi yod na/de ni dus skabs dang mi mthun pa red/ nga ltos bsrung dgos pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa red ma gtogs/ srid kyi thog nga tshos srung thub kyi ma red la/ srung na 'grigs kyi yang ma red/ 'di nga phos nges par shes pa dgosdo/ pa yin/ nga tsho'i 'go khrid ni krung go'i gung khran tang red/ nga mos spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lam thog shugs rgyag dgos pa ma gtogs/ sngon chad kyi chos srid zung 'brel gyi 'go khrid dang / gang ltar 7rgyal ba yab sras kyis 'go khrid byas/ gsham du chos srid zung 'brel gyi ming snying rje po zhig btags yod kyang / gang ltar bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi ming zhig yod/ der brten sngon ma nang bzhin byed kyi yin zer na yong gi ma red/ der brten bsam slo 'di la phran bu 'gyur ba btang nas spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang phran bu mthun pa gnang dgos/ de dag tshang ma thugs la 'jags pa gnang rogs/de ring 'dir se 'bras dang lha sa khul gyi dgon sde khag gi thugs 'gan bzhes mkhan tshang ma phebs yod pa 'di'i thog ngas dge 'dun pa tshor sems pa drang po'i sgog nas zhu rgyur zing cha yong ba 'di rtsa ba nas yag po mi 'dug de la brten nas da cha rim pa khag tshang ma grwa par lta tshul sdug tu phyin yod/ tha na mi khag gcig gis bod rang btsan yin zhes skad rgyag gi yod pa red/ de tsho'i gras gang 'dra byed grabs yod dam/ mi kha shas shig gis skad brgyab nas bod rang btsan yong chog chog de 'dra'i las sla po rtsa ba nas med/ rgya gar nas khong tsho'i sku tshab yong ba red/ ngas khong tshor bka' mol zhus pa yin/ khyed rang tshos bod rang btsan yin zhes ji ltar byed rtsis yod dam/ nga rang tsho bka' mol zhig gnang do/ zhes rang btsan byas na gang 'dra byed dam/ dper na/ bod rang btsan byas na a 142

ri dang / su'u len khong tshos bod rang btsan yong ched krung gor dmag brgyab ste bod krung go'i lag pa nas 'phrog ste bod rang btsan bya rgyu'i dus tshad cig yong gi red dam/ 'di 'dra rtsa ba nas yong gi ma red/ su'u len dang a ris krung gor bod kyi ched du dmag brgyab zer ba rtsa ba nas srid kyi ma red/ gnyis pa rgya gar gyis krung gor dmag brgyab ste bod 'di len gyi red dam/ rgya gar gyis krung go glags 'khel gyi red dam/ 'di yang re ba med pa zhig yin/ gna' snga mo bod rang gis yar langs te dmag rgyag gi yod/ deng sang de ltar gang nas yong / krung gor mi dung phyur bcu yod/ nga tso yongs rdzogs bsdoms na khri bzhi brgya tsam las med pas ji ltar byas te glags 'khel gyi red dam/ yang zhi ba la re ba brgyab ste khyed rang tshos 'dzam gling spyi tshogs la re ba byas na 'dzam gling spyi tshogs kyi gros chod ci 'dra zhig yod kyang / 'dzam gling spyi phyogs kyi sgrig yig nang don dag gal che ba yin na bde 'jags u yon lhan khang nang gros bsdur byed dgos kyi yod/ bde 'jags u yon lhan khang gi nang du rgyun las rgyal khab lnga yod/ de'i nang gi gcig gis rogs pa byas kyang gros bsdur byas te gros chod 'jog dam/sa pas lnga'i nang la krung go yod/ krung go la gros bsdur ma byas par yong thabs med/ der brten 'dzam gling spyi tshogs nas kyang 'gyur ba gtong rgyu yod pa ma red/ de ltar red dam ma red ces dris pa yin pas de rang red brjod kyi 'dug 'o na khyed rang chos rang btsan ji ltar byas te len gyi yin / nga tsho'i lung par gnas tshul 'di yong gi yod pa red/ 'o na gang 'dra byas te rang btsan yong gi red shod dang / ngas byas na khyed rang ོ re stong de 'dra 'chang nas ma sdod/ don chung ba rang skyong 'di rtog tsam rag pa byas nas/bod kyi mnga' khongs 'di skyid pa zhig dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa gso thub pa zhig byung na/ zang nge zing nge mang po med pa byas nas bsdad na nga ni 'di yag pa 'dug don du yang 'khyol thub pa yin/143

khyed rang tsho'i re stong gis sngon chad rnyog dra mang po zhig byung ba dang / da dung rnyog dra bzos na nga rang ོ bsam tshul 'ga' re mthun pa dang / 'ga' re mi mthun pa 'di 'dra red/ der brten krung dbyang nas dgon sde khag gi nang nas dang thog se 'bras tsho la bcos sgrig yag po byed dgos gsungs nas nga mgo na ste bsdad yod/ se 'bras la bcos sgrig bya rgyu 'di las sla po min/ gang 'dra byed dgos sam/ nga tshos las ka tshang ma rim bzhin bya rgyu dang / nga rang la nus pa gang yod pa rnams bton nas bod dang bod rigs sa khul smos ci/ tha na sog po'i sa khu la dang bcas par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa sor chud dang /dgon pa tsho dgon pa'i bzo lta ldan pa zhig dang / grwa pa tsho grwa pa'i bzo lta ldan pa zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed thub pa zhig chab srid thog kyang tshang ma rgyal gces dang nying 'jags mthun sgril yod pa zhig byas nas spyi tshogs la phan pa'i nus pa 'don thub pa dang / rgyun 'dzin gyi nus pa 'don thub pa/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas dang slob gas la sogs pa yar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro ba/ spyi phyogs bde 'jags dang / mi mang gi bde skyid gong du 'phel ba bcas la nus pa 'don thub pa byed dgos pa'i 'gan 'khri nga rang la gnang byung zhing / ngas kyang 'bad brtson zhu gi yod/ 'di tshang ma'i thugs la 'jags pa gnang rogs/ rnam pa hrū dgon pa dang sa khul so sor phebs rjes so so'i dgon pa yag po yong ba gnang dgos pa las/ zang nge zing nge rtsa ba nas ma gnang rogs/zang nge zing nge gnang na dge mtshan rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ chos dang / mi tshe / so so bcas la dge mtshan gang yang med/ ngas zhus pa 'di dag mang che ba'i dgongs par 'gro rgyu yang / 'ga' re'i thugs la 'gro dang mi 'gro yong gi red/ 'on kyang so sos dgongs po yag po zhig bzhes na mkhyen gyi red/ de ring tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan gyi nang la khams pa dang / a mdo ba mang po yod /ngas dbus skad kyi thog nas zhus pa yin/ la las gsan pa dang la las ma gsan 144

pa yong gi red/ yin na yang skad cha 'di rnams rjes su bod yig thog phyog/sa bsgrig byas nas khungs so sor 'bul rgyu yin/ tang gi chos lugs srid byus la 'gyur ba gtan nas med/na ning ston mjug bod la phran bu g.yon gyi lhags pa zhig bskyar du langs yod kyang de ni gnas skabs shig red/ mi 'ga' res krung dbyang gi dbu khrid zos gsungs pa der go ba log sgrub byas yod/ bod du yod pa'i mi 'ga' re'i sna khug rdzi gsang po yod/ de skabs krung dbyang gi rtsa ba'i bod kyi srid byus thugs gtan yag po zhig 'khel med stabs dbu khrid tshos phyogs tshang ma 'dogs sgo med pa'i bka' mol yar tsam 'gro ba lta bu zhig gsung gi yod/ der brten mi 'ga' re rji gsang drags nas 'o da krung dbyang gi srid byus phran bu 'gyur ba min nam bsam nas / lam sang g.yon gyi na tsha 'phar te bod nang na ning ston mjug nas g.yon gyi rlung 'tshub ldang ba dang / nga tsho gzhis ka rtser yang rlung 'tshub tsam byas yod / 'on kyang rtsa ba'i rang bzhin la 'gyur ldog rtsa ba nas yong gi ma red/ sa khul kha shas kyi mi 'ga' re la g.yon gyi bsam klo yod kyang rtsa ba'i cha nas g.yon phyogs la 'gro thabs yod pa ma red/ krung go'i rtsa ba'i srid byus 'gyur stabs mi re gnyis kyis de kha tshur bsgyur thub thabs med/ 'dzam gling thog la tha na su'u len gyis kyang chos lugs gnon pa'i srid byus lo bdun cu tham pa la ga len bstar yod/ nga tsho krung gos lo nyi shu tham pa lag len bstar nas tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa nas bsgyur bcos btang ba red/ su'u len gyi lo bdun cu tham pa'i srid byus de nye char nga tsho'i srid byus nor 'dug ces phran bu bzang du gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces/ bsgyur bcos a log rgyag mkhan gyi kha spu can tsho la ltor po cob kyis lag pa btang / mjal 'phrad yang gnang /rgyal po'i bla ma kha spu can rdzig po de 'dra yod pa dang yang mjal/ chos phyogs kyi byed sgo de pho ltod du btang ste de ltar byed kyi yod/ de ltar 'dzam gling rang 145

gzhin la brten nas 'gyur ba yong gi yod pas krung go bskyar du g.yon la 'gro thabs rtsa ba nas yod pa ma red/ lung pa 'ga' rer skabs re rlung 'tshub tsam 'tshub tsam de 'dra yong gi yod kyang rtsa ba'i cha nas langs thabs med/ de ni 'dzam gling gi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin pas tshang ma thugs bde po gnang rogs/ngas re ba zhu rgyur tshang mas chos dang mthun pa yag po zhig gnang rogs/chos dang mthun pa yag po zhig ma byas na nga ni sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa 'di dngos gnas drang gnas red bsam gyi 'dug sangs rgyas kyis nga'i bstan pa 'di ni seng ge dang 'dra ba zhig yin pas/ phyi rol gyi srog chags sus kyang 'jig pa dang 1 brlag pa/ gnod pa la sogs pa byed mi thub/ 'on kyang seng ge tha ma rang gi lus la nad byung ste shi nas rul 'gro gi red gsungs yod/ sngon chad dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur dang / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs nga tsho tshang mar rdung rdeg chen po byung yod kyang nga tsho chos la dad pa shugs chen po yod stabs / des rkyen byas te nga tsho'i chos dad med pa bzo thub med/ 'on kyang da lta mi 'ga' res chos kyi 'bag 'di gyon nas chos kyi las ka mang po ma byas par ba re bo re'i ngang sdod pa 'edi ni dad log skye ba'i rgyu dang / de bzhin grwa chas gyon nas srang lam ga nga sar 'khyam 'gro ba de rigs mig la 'gro po zhig rtsa ba nas mi 'dug 'ga' zhig ltad mo lta bar 'gro ba dang / la la zhabs bro rgyag sgar 'gro ba de rigs tshang mar bzo lta zhig bzos na ma gtogs rtsa ba nas 'grigs pa mi 'dug grwa pas chang 'thung ba da nga / tha mag 'then pa/ da gon pa'i nang mi thar re dzor re nyar ba/ tha na spud la sogs pa dgon pa'i nang nyar ba sogs de 'dra byas na gang 'dra zhig yong gi red dam/ da dung grwa pa yin khul gyis grwa chas gyon nas bsdad na dge mtshan gang 'dug gam/ ngas byas na mang po de tsam med kyang spus dag po zhig dgos/ mang po byung yang spus ka med na zhabs 'dren red / sngon ma nang bzhin gyi shin tu dam po de 'dra yang de sang gi dus dang mthun 146

gyi ma red/ yin na yang gang ltar dus dang mthun pa'i sgrig gzhi dam tsam zhig ma byung na rtsa ba nas 'grigs thabs med/dgon pa 'ga' re la ngas sngon chad kyang zhus yod/ rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims nang chos la dad pa byas na'ang rang dbang dang / dad pa ma byas na'ang rang dbang yin pa dang / de ring dad pa byas te sang nyin dad pa ma byas na'ang rang dbang yin 1 de ring ma byas par sang nyin byas na'ang rang dbang yin/ 'di ni gtan 'khel ba zhig red/ yin na'ang dgon pa'i nang chos byed mi sna'i ming zhig 'khur nas chos la dad pa mi byed pa 'di 'grigs kyi ma red/ khyod rang chos la dad pa byed 'dod med na dgon pa nas phyir 'then byed dgos/ chos byed mi sna'i go gnas 'di 'khur nas krang zha'i (chab gros ) nang 'dzul te chos la ma red mdog mdog byed pa 'di ngas byas na 'grigs kyi e yod snyam/ ngas rtsed mo dang sbrags nas thung kran pu'u krang de ni bla ma phyed ka zhig red ces brjod dgos don pu'u krang des bla ma dang dgon par 'gan 'khyer gyi yod pas yin/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur nang gang zhig byas kyang 'grigs snyam pa dang / lhag par nang bstan mthun tshogs dang 'brel ba de 'dra'i nang nas chos la ma red mdog mdog byas na gang 'dra chags kyi red dam/ nang bstan mthun tshogs nang zhugs mkhan tshos kyang dgongs pa yag po zhig bzhes ang / rjes su gnas stangs de hrū phran bu bzang du btang na ma gtogs nang bstan mthun tshogs zhes pa 'di chos kyi mthun tshogs red/ chos la ma red mdog mdog dang / klad par bcings 'grol btang yod mdog mdog gi skabs re gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas tha mag kyang 'then pa 'di 'dra ni cang yin 'gro/ 'di yag po rang mi 'dugangs kha sang yang zhus pa yin/ mi zer ba 'di la las 'gan zhig bskur ba'i rjes la skabs re tog tsam 'gan 'khyer nas byas na ma gtogs/ la'o ha 'o ran mi bzang po sha stag byas pas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug yang skabs re la'o ha'e 147

ran mi ngan pa 'dra byas na ma gtogs mi 'grigs/ 'on kyang deng sang spyi tshogs nas dga' bsu zhu sa 'di la'o ha'o ran red/ yin na yang nga ni la'o ha'o ran zer ba'i mi bzang po 'di rtsa ba nas yong gi med/ ngas rnam pa mo de ring gdan 'dren zhus nas phyogs chen zhal ngo gsar pa nges dus lcags rgyugs de dzag zer btsugs nas phyogs gtam gtong gi yod pa ltar/ de ring ngas tshogs gtam btang nas rim pas bzo lta bzo gi yin zhes zhus pa yin/ nga la krung dbyang gis las 'gan 'di gnang ba'i rjes la nga rang la mtshon nas las ka 'di ha cang rnyog dra yin/ mi tshang mar kha mkhas po bshad nas bsdad na ha cang stabs bde po red/de min/ 'di red/ 'di ma red/ gnyis red/ gsum red/ lnga red/bcu red ces brjod dgos dus mi 'ga' re'i sna khug dang / 'ga' re'i kha/'ga' re'i mig sogs la phog thug 'gro rgyu las med/ nga rang sger la mtshon na las ka 'di rnyog dra dang dka' ngal yang chen po 'dug skabs re mi tshang mas nga la tshogs gtam ga tong ba dang / kha gtong gi 'dug yin na yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di dus ngan rnyigs ma lnga nyag phra ba'i dus la slebs skabs so so rang gis ma byas rang byas red/ mgo'i klad par phub cig gyon nas u tshugs rgyag rgyu red/ de ring ngas mdor bsdus zhus pa 'di dag tshang ma'i dgongs par 'jags pa gnang dgos/da nas bzung nga pho bka' mol zhu rgyu dang / tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu/ yi ge bzo rgyu sogs las ka rab dang rim pa zhig yod pa las/ stabs bde po zhig med / nga tshos zhu rgyu byung / bod rigs sa khul gyi chos lugs kyi las don 'di thag gcod yag po zhig byung na spyi tshogs kyi gnad don ma mthar yang brgya cha lnga bcu thag gcod thub kyi red/ dpe cha bzhag na/ pe cing du yin na slob grwa che ba kha shas shig gis rngam ston khrom skor byas song na mi tshang mas slob grwa des byas song zhes brjod kyi yod kyang / sogeng krang kha shas mar phyin nas skad cha bshad de 148

mig 'dzugs thag gcod byas na 'grig gi yod pa red/ bod la masan na grwa pa kha shas shig gis rngam ston khrom skor byas na mi hrū ha las kyi yod pa red/ spyi tshogs kho rang de 'dra zhig yin/ bod kyi dgon pa de dag la spyi phogs kyi nus pa rte cang chen po yod/ de dag rgyal gces chos gces can zhig tu bsgyur thub na nus pa ha cang chen po bon rgyu red/ de dag phyin chad dgongs par 'jags pa gnang rogs/ nga tsho rim bzhin yang nas yang du mjal rgyu red/ de ring zhu rgyu 'di tsam yin/ rnam pa chos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di nyid nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel dang / tang gi gcig gyur gyi mtshungs med 'go khrid 'og tu nga cho bod dang bod rigs kyi sa khul dang / tha na sog po'i sa khul la sogs pa tshang ma yar rgyas gong 'phel gyi nang chos byed mi sna tshos nus chen po bton nas sa gnas de dag spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon dang /dngos po'i dpal yon ldan pa dang / mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes rig ldan pa'i sa khul gsar pa bzang po zhig tu 'gyur ched tshang ma'i nus pa 'don rogs gnang zhes re 'dun zhu rgyu yin//bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'di tsam gyis chog pa byas/ de ring bla ma dang /dge bshes/ grub mtha' khag tshang ma nas dgongs 'char gsungs pa de tsho yag po byung song / phyin chad gong du gang zhus pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ris med kyi thog nas go bsdur zhu rgyu yin pas de'i thog tsha nga mas thugs dogs ma gnang rogs / nga rang dge lugs pa yin kyang ngas chos lugs gzhan dag la phyogs ris byas te zur nas bltas te bsdad mi yong / grub mtha' ris med bya rgyu yin/de ni phyogs gcig nas tang gi srid byus kyang red/ phyogs gzhan nas deng skabs grub mtha' gzhan dag tsho gang ci'i thad zhan pa yod pa de dag nges par du nyams pa sor chud yag po yong ba bya rgyu ma gtogs/ ngas phyogs ris rtsa ba nas zhus mi yong thugs g.yeng ma gnang rogs/ zhes bka' stsal ba bcas so 149
